tei:div.tei:p: r+sharwaldi jerdo/byebyebye dze+erte
na dzosprub rgyal
dgag lan spyin gyi sgra dbyangs/'ba' don grub rgyal gyis brtsams/zhang kang then mā dpe skrun kung si/
dgag lan spyin gyi sgra dbyangs/'ba' don grub rgyal gyis brtsams/zhang kang then mā dpe skrun kung si/

dkar chag dgag lan sprin gyi sgra dbyangs/ (1)bod kyi spyi skad gtan 'bebs byed pa'i bsam 'char (3 8)bod kyi spyi skad gtan 'bebs la yang bskyar gleng ba/ (85)rma rgyab tsho drurga gi lo rgyus rags bsdus/ (101)bod kyi skung yig byis pa dgyes glu/ (135)

dkar chag dgag lan sprin gyi sgra dbyangs/ (1)bod kyi spyi skad gtan 'be+ebs byed pa'i bsam 'char (38)bod kyi bye skad gtan 'be+ebs la yang bskyar gleng ba/ (85)rma rgyab tsho drurga gi lo rgyus rags bsdus/ (101)bod kyi skung yig byes pa dgyes glu/ (135)

— grub mtha'i phyogs 1nga gi lta ngan la dgag pa dz+ren gyi sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/de yang dpal yul dar thang dgon gyi rtsom deb 〈 a mra'i ljon shing //gi rtsom sgrig pa/ a ma ma gtogs rmya ngo mi shes pas kun la mthun sgril med cing / go kha ma gtogs sa ngo mi shes pas mi rigs kyi mdun lam mi mthong ba/ phrag dog gi rwa rtses kun la snun cing / phyogs lhung gi me stes mthong tshad sreg pa/ mos gus dang byams snying ye nas rgyud la skye ma myong ba'i grwa rgyags snang mtho o rgyan brtson 'grus zer ba des/rgan nor sde chen pos mdzad pa'i〈 mgo log rig gnas lo rgyus 〉deb gnyis pa'i nang du/ spyir bon chos gnyis kyi gzhung lugs la 'dra sa mang po yod pa dang / khyad par bon

— grub mtha'i phyogs lhung gi lta ngan la dgag pa sprin gyi sgra dzodabyangs zhes bya ba/ de yang dpal yul dar thang dgon gyi rtsom deb〈 a mra'i ljon shing 〉gi rtsom sgrig pa/ a ma ma gtogs myi ngo mi shes pas kun la mthun sgril med cing / go kha ma gtogs sa ngo mi shes pas mi rigs kyi mdun lam mi mthong ba/ phrag dog gi rwa rtses kun la snun cing / phyogs lhung gi me lces mthong tshad sreg pa/ mos gus dang byams snying ye nas rgyud la skye ma myong ba'i grwa rgyags snang mtho o rgyan brtson 'grus zer ba des/rgan nor sde chen pos mdzad pa'i〈 mgo log rig gnas lo rgyas〉deb gnyis pa'i nang du/ ‘‘spyir bon chos gnyis kyi ༄ gzhung lugs la 'dra sa mang po yod pa dang / khyad par bon 1

po'i lta sgom spyod gsum pa'i gzhung lugs dang / snga 'gyur rnying ma'i rdzogs pa chen po'i chos skor la tshig don gnyis kyi cha nas gcig mtshungs kyi rnam pa shin tu mang bas na/ 'di gnyis kyi khungs gcig gam/ yang na phan tshun shan zhugs pa yin sogs dpyad gzhi shin tu che/’’zhes dpyad sgo tsam phye ba la/ khor pha‘‘dga' ldan po'i’’shi mying nas bzung ba lta bu'i khong khro gting nas langs tshoshing / khro gtam drag pos khar ci yong gis/ ‘‘nor sde khyi rgan/ rmongs rgan/ bon rgan/ blun rgan/nor skyong’’sogs 'brog pas sa rtsod byed dus kyi 'khon lugs dang byis pa rtse rnga 'khyog dus kyi 'dzing lugs lta bu zhig byas song la/ khro gtam de bsgrags rjes/ grwa slob mkhas blun skya ser pho mo kun gyis gtam snyan zhig thos pa dang 'dra bar/ ‘‘ha ha/ o rgyan brtson 'grus mkhas gi re/ nor sde la bsdigs yod gi re/’misogs zhib 'jug med pa'i byung rgyal mang du smra/ kho bos dgag yig— de thengs shig bklags pas bden pa su la yod pa shes mod/ ‘‘gnyan pos kha ma grag 2

po'i lta sgom spyod gsum pa'i gzhung lugs dang / snga 'gyur rnying ma'i rdzogs pa chen po'i chos skor la tshig don gnyis kyi cha nas gcig mtshungs kyi rnam pa shin tu mang bas na/ 'di gnyis kyi khungs gcig gam/ yang na phan tshun shan zhugs pa yin sogs dpyad gzhi shin tu che/ ’zhes dbe+ed sgo tsam bye ba la/ khor pha ‘dga' ldan po'i shi m+bing nas bzung ba lta bu'i khong khro gting nas langs shing / khro gtam drag pos khar ci yong gis/ ‘nor sde khyi rgan/ rmongs rgan/ bon rgan/ blun rgan/nor skyong’sogs 'brog pas sa rtsod byed dus kyi 'khon lugs dang byes pa rtse rnga 'khyog dus kyi 'dzing lugs lta bu zhig byas song la/ khro gtam de bsgrags rjes/ grwa slob mkhas blun skya ser pho mo kun gyis gtam snyan zhig thos pa dang 'dra bar/ ‘ha ha/ khro rgyan brtson 'grus mkhas gi re/ nor sde la bsdigs yod gi re/ sogs zhib 'jug med pa'i byung rgyal mang du smra/ kho bos dgag yig— de thengs shig bklags pas bangen pa su la yod pa shes mod/ ‘gnyan pos kha ma grag 2

po'i lta sgom spyod gsum pa'i gzhung lugs dang / snga 'gyur rnying ma'i rdzogs pa chen po'i chos skor la tshig don gnyis kyi cha nas gcig mtshungs kyi rnam pa shin tu mang bas na/ 'di gnyis kyi khungs gcig gam/ yang na phan tshun shan zhugs pa yin sogs dpyad gzhi shin tu che/’’zhes dpyad sgo tsam phye ba la/ khor pha‘‘dga' ldan po'i’’shi mying nas bzung ba lta bu'i khong khro gting nas langs tshoshing / khro gtam drag pos khar ci yong gis/ ‘‘nor sde khyi rgan/ rmongs rgan/ bon rgan/ blun rgan/nor skyong’’sogs 'brog pas sa rtsod byed dus kyi 'khon lugs dang byis pa rtse rnga 'khyog dus kyi 'dzing lugs lta bu zhig byas song la/ khro gtam de bsgrags rjes/ grwa slob mkhas blun skya ser pho mo kun gyis gtam snyan zhig thos pa dang 'dra bar/ ‘‘ha ha/ o rgyan brtson 'grus mkhas gi re/ nor sde la bsdigs yod gi re/’misogs zhib 'jug med pa'i byung rgyal mang du smra/ kho bos dgag yig— de thengs shig bklags pas bden pa su la yod pa shes mod/ ‘‘gnyan pos kha ma grag 2

gong / /blun pos lag ma snga/ /’’zhes pa'i dpe ltar/ kho bo la gleng ba'i skabs su ma babs par 'dod nas da bar du bzhagayin na'ang / mkhas pa tshor dgag rin med pas ngal ba ma mdzad cing / blun po dag chu sna gar khrid kyis khro gtam de mthar thug gi bden par zhen nas mu mthud du phyogs lhung gi 'chal gtam mang du smra na/ da ni spyir 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi zhi bde dang / sgos su krung hwa mi rigs kyi gcig gyur/ khyad par du bod mi rigs nang khul gyi mthun sgril la gnod pa'i bsam spyod dag 'gog pa ni shin tu 'os shing skabs su babs so snyam nas gtam gyi sbyor ba 'di byas so/ /de yang o rgyan brtson 'grus kyi khro gtam de'i phag na gab pa'i lta ngan ni shin tu gsal te/ khos bod mi rigs kyi nang na chos lugs gzhan pa dang rig gnas gsar bar slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug gnang mkhan re mchis tshe/ de dag btsan po gnyad+ngha / po re min geshis/ thams cad mu stegs pa'i gras su brgyabs nas bod mi rigs kyi nang nas rgyang 'phud 3

gong / /blun pos lag ma snga/ /’zhes pa'i dpe ltar/ kho bo la gleng ba'i skabs su ma babs par 'dod nas da bar du bzhagayin na'ang / mkhas pa tshor dgag rin med pas ngal ba ma mdzad cing / blun po dag chu sna gar khrid kyis khro gtam de mthar thug gi bden par zhen nas mu mthud du phyogs lhung gi 'chal gtam mang du smra na/ da ni spyir 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi zhi bde dang / sgos su krung hwa mi rigs kyi gcig gyur/ khyad par du bod mi rigs nang khul gyi mthun sgril la gnod pa'i bsam spyod dag 'gog pa ni shin tu 'os shing skabs su babs so snyam nas gtam gyi sbyor ba 'di byas so/ /de yang o rgyan brtson 'grus kyi khro gtam de'i phag na gab pa'i lta ngan ni shin tu gsal te/ khos bod mi rigs kyi nang na chos lugs gzhan pa dang rig gnas gsar bar slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug gnang mkhan re mchis tshe/ de dag btsan po gnyaji / po re min goshis/ thams cad mu stegs pa'i gras su brgyabs nas bod mi rigs kyi nang nas rgyang 'phud

gong / /blun pos lag ma snga/ /’’zhes pa'i dpe ltar/ kho bo la gleng ba'i skabs su ma babs par 'dod nas da bar du bzhagayin na'ang / mkhas pa tshor dgag rin med pas ngal ba ma mdzad cing / blun po dag chu sna gar khrid kyis khro gtam de mthar thug gi bden par zhen nas mu mthud du phyogs lhung gi 'chal gtam mang du smra na/ da ni spyir 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi zhi bde dang / sgos su krung hwa mi rigs kyi gcig gyur/ khyad par du bod mi rigs nang khul gyi mthun sgril la gnod pa'i bsam spyod dag 'gog pa ni shin tu 'os shing skabs su babs so snyam nas gtam gyi sbyor ba 'di byas so/ /de yang o rgyan brtson 'grus kyi khro gtam de'i phag na gab pa'i lta ngan ni shin tu gsal te/ khos bod mi rigs kyi nang na chos lugs gzhan pa dang rig gnas gsar bar slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug gnang mkhan re mchis tshe/ de dag btsan po gnyad+ngha / po re min geshis/ thams cad mu stegs pa'i gras su brgyabs nas bod mi rigs kyi nang nas rgyang 'phud 3

gtong bsam pa de red/ /de bas/ gong gsal rgan nor sde chen pos ban bon gyi khungs gcig gam/ snyam pa'i dbe+ed sgo tsam phye ba la yang khor shin tu ma bzod pas khro gtam drag pos/ bon po'i bshad tshul dang 'dra kha'i nang ba'i bshad tshul rnams chos can/ khyod kyi khungs bon po yin par thal/ zhes dang / yangabon po'i kham chen sogs dang sher phyin rgyas pa dag chos can/ khungs gcig pa yin par thal/ zhes dang / sher mdo nas bshad pa'i lta spyod dag gi khungs bon po yin par thal zhes dang / ‘ bon lta chos can/ dbu ma chen po'i lta ba dang 'dra bar thal/ zhes sogs su 'phen par byed//yin na'ang / o brtson lags/ de la khyod kyis ban khungs bon yin par thal zer na'ang rung / bon khungs ban yin par thal zer na'ang chog ngas khyod la 'dod lan kho nas bzlog ste/ de dag gi khungs gcig yin par 'dod do zer na khyod kyis ci zer/ ma grub na/ de dag gi khungs gcig

gtong bsam pa de red//de bas/ gong gsal rgan nor sde chen pos‘‘ban bon gyi khungs gcig gam/ ’’snyam pa'i dpyad sgo tsam phye ba la yang khor shin tu ma bzod pas khro gtam drag pos/ ‘‘bon po'i bshad tshul dang 'dra kha'i nang ba'i bshad tshul rnams chos can/ khyod kyi khungs bon po yin par thal/’’zhes dang / yang‘‘bon po'i kham chen sogs dang sher phyin rgyas pa dag chos can/ khungs gcig pa yin par thal/’’zhes dang / ‘‘sher mdo nas bshad pa'i lta spyod dag gi khungs bon po yin par thal ’’zhes dang / ‘‘bon lta chos can/ dbu ma chen po'i lta ba dang 'dra bar thal/’’zhes sogs su 'phen par byed//yin na'ang / o brtson lags/ de la khyod kyis ban khungs bon yin par thal zer na'ang rung / bon khungs ban yin par thal zer na'ang chog ngas khyod la‘‘'dod’’lan kho nas bzlog ste/ de dag gi khungs gcig yin par 'dod do zer na khyod kyis ci zer/ ma grub na/ de dag gi khungs gcig 4

yin par thal/ bstan pa gcig yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/bstan pa gcig yin par thal/ ston pa gabyug yin pa'i phyir/ma grub na/ ston pa gcig yin par thal/ shāka gshen gcig la gcig sprul yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ ban lugs snga 'gyur rnying ma ba'i paṇa ṭi ta chen po 'ju mi pham phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis/ gshen yul 'ol mo gling chen du/ /ston pa gshen rab mi bor bstan/ /bon gyi theg pa rim dgu gsungs/ /skye 'gro thams cad bde la bkod/ / ces dang /ban lugs ri bo dge ldan pa'i mkhas dbang chen po sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos/ ‘‘zhang zhung yul na bon 'dul bar/ /dgongs te gshen rab mi bor sprul/ /bon gyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis bskyangs/ /theg pa rim pa dgu ru gsungs/ /gson po rnams kyi lha sgo phye/ /gshin po rnams kyi dur sgo bcad/ /'gro rnams g.yung drung lam la bkod/ / ces dang / bon mdo gzer mig las/ lha'i bu dam pa dog dkar khyod/ /'di nas 'dzam gleng lho phyogs kyi/ /rgya gar wa ra na ṅga ru/ /rgyal po shāka 5

yin par thal/ bstan pa gcig yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/bstan pa gcig yin par thal/ ston pa gcig yin pa'i phyir/ma grub na/ ston pa gcig yin par thal/ shāka gshen gcig la gcig sprul yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ ban lugs snga 'gyur rnying ma ba'i paṇa ṭi ta chen po 'ju mi pham phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis/ ‘‘gshen yul 'ol mo gling chen du/ /ston pa gshen rab mi bor bstan/ /bon gyi theg pa rim dgu gsungs/ /skye 'gro thams cad bde la bkod/ /’’ces dang /ban lugs ri bo dge ldan pa'i mkhas dbang chen po sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos/ ‘‘zhang zhung yul na bon 'dul bar/ /dgongs te gshen rab mi bor sprul/ /bon gyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis bskyangs/ /theg pa rim pa dgu ru gsungs/ /gson po rnams kyi lha sgo phye/ /gshin po rnams kyi dur sgo bcad/ /'gro rnams g.yung drung lam la bkod/ /’’ces dang / bon mdo gzer mig las/ ‘‘lha'i bu dam pa dog dkar khyod/ /'di nas 'dzam gling lho phyogs kyi/ /rgya gar wa ra na si ru/ /rgyal po shāka 5

gi sras su 'khrungs/ /nga min chos pos bsgyur ba yi/ /bon las 'chos pa'i log bslu la/ /yang dag chos zhes bya bar bsgyur/ / ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /ha ha/ o brtson lags/mgo yom 'khor ram/ khyod la phyogs ris dang zhe sdang che bas/bon mdo dang sde srid khas mi len yang / khyod rang gi brgyud bla 'ju mi pham la khyod kyis ji ltar bya rgyu/ 'dis phal cher khyod la mi tshe gang bor yang 'dang rgyag rgyu zhig bzos yod shas che'o/ /yang kho na re/ rnying ma dang bon po'i khungs gcig na/bon po dang rnying ma gnyis rtsod pa mi 'thad par thal lta sgom spyod pa 'dra ba'i phyir/ zhes 'phen pa la lan 'di ltar gdab par bya ste/ khyod kyis bon po dang rnying ma gnyis rtsod pa mi 'thad par thal/ zer ba la/ ci'i phyir/ lta sgom spyod pa 'dra ba'i phyir zer na ma khyab/ ces lan btab na khyod kyis ci zer/ khyod kyi rang lugs ltar na dpa' ris rab gsal dang 'ju mi pham/ sgos steng blo bzang dang rdo sbis dge bshes 6

gi sras su 'khrungs/ /nga min chos pos bsgyur ba yi/ /bon las 'chos pa'i log bslu la/ /yang dag chos zhes bya bar bsgyur/ /’’ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /ha ha/ o brtson lags/mgo yom 'khor ram/ khyod la phyogs ris dang zhe sdang che bas/bon mdo dang sde srid khas mi len yang / khyod rang gi brgyud bla 'ju mi pham la khyod kyis ji ltar bya rgyu/ 'dis phal cher khyod la mi tshe gang bor yang 'dang rgyag rgyu zhig bzos yod shas che'o/ /yang kho na re/ rnying ma dang bon po'i khungs gcig na/‘‘bon po dang rnying ma gnyis rtsod pa mi 'thad par thal lta sgom spyod pa 'dra ba'i phyir/’’zhes 'phen pa la lan 'di ltar gdab par bya ste/ khyod kyis‘‘bon po dang rnying ma gnyis rtsod pa mi 'thad par thal/’’zer ba la/ ci'i phyir/ ‘‘lta sgom spyod pa 'dra ba'i phyir’’zer na ma khyab/ ces lan btab na khyod kyis ci zer/ khyod kyi rang lugs ltar na dpa' ris rab gsal dang 'ju mi pham/ sgis steng blo bzang dang rdo sbis dge bshes 6

dag kyang rtsod pa mi 'thad par thal te/ lta sgom spyod pa 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /der thal/ lta sgom spyod pa 'dra na rtsod pa mi 'thad pa khyod rang gi khas len yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/shin tu rtsangs pa'i rig pa 'di tsam la yang blo'i 'jug pa mi 'gro ba 'di snying re rje/ 'di na yang rang rmas kyi mtshon cha lag na thogs pa'i‘‘mkhas pa’’gcig yang khyod kyis/ bon pos shi bo'i dge rtsar rlom nas g.yag lug bsad par bshad pa 'di ci/ khyod kyis spyir bon po zer ba de gang la ngos 'dzin gyin yod/ gna' snga mor phyi rol ba'i grub mtha' khag cig bod yul du dar ba'am yang na bod rang gi gdod ma'i dmar mchod byed pa'i chos lugs de la bon po'i ming btags nas/ phyis kyi bon thams cad de la ngos 'dzin no zer na ni/ khyod shin tu 'khrul la/ phyis kyi ston pa gshen rab kyi g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa de ni dmar mchod lta ci/ srog gcod kyang mi rung ba shin tu gsal te/ 〈 'phrul gshen theg pa'i dam tshig 〉las/ ‘‘sha khrag dmar 7

dag kyang rtsod pa mi 'thad par thal te/ lta sgom spyod pa 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /der thal/ lta sgom spyod pa 'dra na rtsod pa mi 'thad pa khyod rang gi khas len yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/shin tu rtsangs pa'i rig pa 'di tsam la yang blo'e 'jug pa mi 'gro ba 'di steng re rje/ 'di na yang rang rmas kyi mtshon cha lag na thogs pa'i mkhas pa gcig yang khyod kyi sa/ bon pos shi bo'i dge rtsar zlom nas g.yag lug bsad par bshad pa 'di ci/ khyod kyis spyor bon po zer ba de gang la ngos 'dzin gyin yod/ gna' snga mor phyi rol ba'i grub mtha' khag cig bod yul du dar ba'am yang na bod rang gi gdod ma'i dmar mchod byed pa'i chos lug sa de la bon po'i ming btags nas/ phyis kyi bon thams cad de la ngos 'dzin no zer na ni/ khyod shin tu 'khrul la/ phyis kyi ston pa gshen rab kyi g.yung drung bon rmi bstan pa de ni dmar mchod lta byu/ srog gcod kyang mi rung ba shin tu gsal te/ 〈 'phrul gshen theg pa'i dam tshig //las/ sha khrag dmar 7

mchod spyod lam la 'galo/ ṣe/nga / zhes dang / ston pa gshen rab kyis/ ston pa'i las ni snying rje yin/ /snying rje'i don gyis sems can 'drong / /lus dang srog gi don phyir yang / /'gro ba sems can don mi 'bor/ / zhes dang / yang grub mtha' la ris su ma chad pa'i rtogs pa mtho zhing / bcu phrag rig pas thugs rgyud phyug pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po mtshan brjod par dka' ba don gyis smos na/ 7 ngag dbang bde legs rab rgyas tshang gis kyang / bon ni dge sgrub lha mchod 'dre 'dul mo rtsis byed pa sogs yin par deb ther dag na gsal/ zhes dang / gshen bstan 'dzin pa'i bon la dkar nag phye ba ni rang bzo'am phyogs lhung gi gtam rgyun 'byams pa zhig go zhes sogs su gsungs yod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na kha cig gis chos lugs yin na thams cad rmongs dad yin par 'dod pa dang / khyod kyis bon po yin na thams cad dmar mchod pa yin par 'dod pa gnyis la khyad par sru rtse tsam yang med pa 'di khyod kyis shes par byos 8

la spangs par yang mdzod cig/ yang khyod kyis/ ‘‘mgo log gis mi shi ba'i tshe bza' ba'i ched du g.yag lug bshas’’zer ba 'di ci/ mi shi ba'i lo der sdig pa la 'dzem zhing bsha' srol med zer nas g.yag lug mi bsha' ba'i goms srol bzang bo zhig mgo log spyi dang khyad par du sog ru ma zhang la mngon sum gyis dar yod pa las/ mi shi ba'i tshe g.yag lug mang po bsha' ba'i goms srol zhig khyod rang la yod na ma gtogs bod gangs can na'ang shin tu dkon no// yang khyod kyis/ 'bru rigs dang zas sna dkon dus g.yag lug bshas na 'os 'os chog chog tu ston pa 'di ci/ rang lto'i don du gzhan srog bcad na chog pa'i bcas pa 'di khyod la sus byas/ yang khyod kyis bon po tshos shi bo'i dge rtsar rlom nas g.yag lug bsad par bshad la/ de ltar na bon po tshos g.yag lug bsad pa de shi bo la e phan snyam nas bsad pa yin pas bzang na ngan na gzhan don du yinaho9

la spangs par yang mdzod cig/ yang khyod kyis/ ‘‘mgo log gis mi shi ba'i tshe bza' ba'i ched du g.yag lug bshas’’zer ba 'di ci/ mi shi ba'i lo der sdig pa la 'dzem zhing bsha' srol med zer nas g.yag lug mi bsha' ba'i goms srol bzang bo zhig mgo log spyi dang khyad par du sog ru ma zhang la mngon sum gyis dar yod pa las/ mi shi ba'i tshe g.yag lug mang po bsha' ba'i goms srol zhig khyod rang la yod na ma gtogs bod gangs can na'ang shin tu dkon no// yang khyod kyis/ 'bru rigs dang zas sna dkon dus g.yag lug bshas na 'os 'os chog chog tu ston pa 'di ci/ rang lto'i don du gzhan srog bcad na chog pa'i bcas pa 'di khyod la sus byas/ yang khyod kyis bon po tshos shi bo'i dge rtsar rlom nas g.yag lug bsad par bshad la/ de ltar na bon po tshos g.yag lug bsad pa de shi bo la e phan snyam nas bsad pa yin pas bzang na ngan na gzhan don du yinaho9

la spangs par yang mdzod sbug /yang khyod kyis/ mgo log gis mi shi ba'i tshe bza' ba'i ched du g.yag lug bshas zer ba 'di ci/ mi shi ba'i lo der sdig pa la 'dzem zhing bsha' srol med zer nas g.yag lug mi bsha' ba'i goms srol bzang bo zhig mgo log spyi dang khyad par du sog ru ma zhang la mngon sum gyis dar yod pa las/ mi shi ba'i tshe g.yag lug mang po bsha' ba'i goms srol zhig khyod rang la yod na ma gtogs bod gangs can na'ang shin tu dkon no/ / yang khyod kyis/ 'bru rigs dang zas sna dkon dus g.yag lug bshas na 'os 'os chog chog tu ston pa 'di ci/ rang lto'i don du gzhan srog bcad na chog pa'i bcas pa 'di khyod la sus byas/ yang khyod kyis bon po tshos shi bo'i dge rtsar zlom nas g.yag lug bsad par bshad la/ de ltar na bon po tshos g.yag lug bsad pa de shi bo la e phan snyam nas bsad pa yin pas bzang na ngan na gzhan don du yin 9

pa shes thub la/ khyod kyis rang la zas sna dkon tshe rang lto'i ched du g.yag lug bshas pa de rang don kho nar nges pas/gzhan don du bsad pa dang rang don du bsad pa gnyis la dge ba'i phan yon dang sdig pa'i nyes dmigs kyi tshad ji 'dra yin pa khyod grwa ba zhig gis los shes/ mi shes na phyogs lhung gi dri ma dor cing / dad gus kyi spu long g.yos te/ gcig la gcig sprul gyi mchog gi sprul sku ston pa bla med shāka gshen gnyis kyi bka' la ltos dang shin tu rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /—yang khyod kyis/ ‘mgo log la dmar mchod byed pa'i goms srol yod par bshad pa ni mngon sum gyi rdzun du snang ste/ nor sde bon rgan khyod kyis de ltar byed na ma gtogs mgo log la de 'dra'i srol rnged par ma zad dmar mchod gtong mkhan zhig byung ba'i bo rgyus tsam yang med pa'i phyir ro/ /rdza myu ra sprul sku sogs kyis dmar mchod rgyun bcad par grags pa de ci zhe na/ de ni dmar mchod dngos yin par thal lo/ zhes zer ba la 'di ltar dpyad par bya ste/ mgo 10

pa shes thub la/ khyod kyis rang la zas sna dkon tshe rang lto'i ched du g.yag lug bshas pa de rang don kho nar nges pas/gzhan don du bsad pa dang rang donardzodu bsad pa gnyis la dge ba'i phan yon dang sdig pa'i nyes dmigs kyi tshad ji 'dra yin pa khyod grwa ba zhig gis los shes/ mi shes na phyogs lhung gi dri ma dor cing / dad gus kyi spu long g.yos te/ gcig la gcig sprul gyi mchog gi sprul sku ston pa bla med shāka gshen gnyi sa kyi bka' la ltos dang shin tu rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /yang khyod kyis/ ‘‘mgo log la dmar mchod byed pa'i goms srol yod par bshad pa ni mngon sum gyi rdzun du snang ste/ nor sde bon rgan khyod kyis de ltar byed na ma gtogs mgo log la de 'dra'i srol med par ma zad dmar mchod gtong mkhan zhig byung ba'i lo rgyus tsam yang med pa'i phyir ro/ /rdza mu ra sprul sku sogs kyis dmar mchod rgyun bcad par grags pa de ci zhe na/ de ni dmar mchod dngos yin par thal lo/’’zhes zer ba la 'di ltar dpyad par bya ste/ mgo 10

log 'di bod mi rigs kyi rgyud pa e yin/ yin na bod mi rigs la gna' snga mor dmar mchod byed pa'i goms srol zhig byung bar ma zad/ ston pa gshen rab gtsos ban bon gnyis kyis dmar mchod de'i rgyun bcad pa'i lo rgyus kyang ban bon mkhas pas mgren gabyug tu smra na/ mgo log gcig pu la dmar mchod kyi lo rgyus tsam yang med pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/gal te mgo log 'di bod mi rigs kyi rgyud pa min pa'i sgrub byede 'dra med na/ a lcags 'bru'i brgyud pare grags pa'i mgo log la'ang dmar mchod kyi srol rgyun zhig sngar byung myong bar khyod kyis rtswa za za dang sman 'thung 'thung gyis shig yang khyod kyis mgo log la dmar mchod gtong mkhan zhig byung ba'i lo rgyus tsam yang med par dam bcas nas/ de'i myur/ rdza mu ra sprul sku sogs kyis dmar mchod kyi rgyun bcad par smra la/ dmar mchod de yang dmar mchod dngos yin par khas blangs pa 'di ci/ mgo log la dmar mchod kyi ming tsam yang med na/ rdza mu ra sprul sku sogs kyis ci zhig 11

log 'di bod mi rigs kyi rgyud pa e yin/ yin na bod mi rigs la gna' snga mor dmar mchod byed pa'i goms srol zhig byung bar ma zad/ ston pa gshen rab gtsos ban bon gnyis kyis dmar mchod de'i rgyun bcad pa'i lo rgyus kya nga ban bon mkhas pas mgrin gcig tu smra na/ mgo log gcig pu la dmar mchod kyi lo rgyus tsam yang med pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/gal te mgo log 'di bod mi rigs kyi rgyud pa min pa'i sgrub byed 'dra med na/ a lcags 'bru'i brgyud par grags pa'i mgo log la'ang dmar mchod kyi srol rgyun zhig sngar byung myong bar khyod kyis rtswa za za dang sman 'thung 'thung gyis shig yang khyod kyis mgo log la dmar mchod gtong mkhan zhig byung ba'i lo rgyus tsam yang med par dam bcas nas/ de'i mur/ rdza mu ra sprul sku sogs kyis dmar mchod kyi rgyun jibacad par smra la/ dmar mchod de yang dmar mchod dngos yin par khas blangs pa 'di ci/ mgo log la dmar mchod kyi ming tsam yang med na/ rdza mu ra sprul sku sogs kyis ci zhig 11

bcad/ dmar mchod dngos de dmar mchod ma yin nam/rang tshig nang 'gal gyi 'ug pa'i rdzun gtam lta bu 'di la dgag lan yang sprad thabs mi 'dug pas re zhig 'jog /nor sdes dmar mchod byed min mi shes la/ khyod kyis ni dmar mchod gtong kho thag ste/ khyod kyi khro gtam de'i mjug tu/ sor rtog ye shes snang mtha' khros pa'i sku/ /bstan srung rgya mtsho'i dbang bo tsi ma ra/ /dmar nag khrag zhag 'khyil ba'i dur khrod nas/ /ha ha'i gad rgyang dang bcas sdong grogs mdzod/ / ces bstan srung tsi ma ra de/ mi ros gang ba'i dur khrod du dmar nag khrag zhag la dbyes nas ha ha'i gad rgyang sgog pa zhig tu brjod pas/ des khyod la sdong grogs byed dgos na khyod kyis nges par du de la dgyes pa'i mchod rdzas kyis mchod pa 'bul ba las 'os med pas/ 'di ni khyod la rig pa yag pas rtogs kyang rtogs la khyod la phod pa che bas de ltar bsgrub kyang nges so /yang khyod kyis/ nor sdes bris pa'i gdan rabs 'ga' 12

zhig gi mchod brjod du/ ring nas 'dris pa'i zhes dang /slar yang dang / da dung zhes pa rnams kyi tshig nus kyis dbyangs can ma dang rig byed ma ngo shes kyi mi bzhin du sngar ring mo nas 'dris shing / zhal gzigs dang ngag gi dngos grub sngar nas thob yod par khas blangs nas/ slar yang zhal gzigs dang ngag gi dpal stsol zhes 'dod don gsol ba'i don du rge dgos pas/ de ni rdzun dang ngo tsha med pa'i gtam du snang ste/ ming tshig yi ge'i mtshan nyid tsam la'ang rang blo'i 'jug pa rmongs pa'i phyugs rdzi mi nag gi gral gong du dug gsum gyi dregs pa rgyas shing / dad brtson dran pa la sogs pa'i yon tan til tsam med pa'i rgad po khyod 'dra zhig la zhal gzigs dang dngos grub thob pa yod par ni mdo rgyud gang las ma gsungs pa'i phyir/ gal te de 'dra yod na rgyu 'bras la mi bden pa'i skyon du 'gyur ro/ /’’zhes bris 'dug pa la 'di ltar rgol bar bya ste/khyod kyis/ lha mo dbyangs can mas nor sde la zhal 13

zhig gi mchod brjod du/ ring nas 'dris pa'i zhes dang /be+er yang dang / da dung zhes pa rnams kyi tshig nus kyis dbyangs can ma dang rig byed ma ngo shes kyi mi bzhin du sngar ring mo nas 'dris shing / zhal gzigs dang ngag gi dngos grub sngar nas thob yod par khas blangs nas/ slar yang zhal gzigs dang ngag gi dpal stsol zhes 'dod don gsol ba'i —don du go dgos pas/ de ni rdzun dang ngo tsha sked pa'i gtam du snang ste/ ming tshig yi ge'i mtshan nyid tsam la'ang rang blo'i 'jug pa rmongs pa'i phyugs rdzi mi nag gi gral gong du dug gsum gyi dregs pa rgyas shing / dad brtson dran pa la sogs pa'i yon tan til tsam sked pa'i rgad po khyod 'dra zhig la zhal gzigs dang dngos grub thob pa yod par ni mdo rgyud gang las ma gsungs pa'i phyir/ gal te de 'dra yod na rgyu 'bras la mi bden pa'i skyon du 'gyur ro/ / zhes bris 'dug pa la 'di ltar rgol bar bya ste/khyod kyis/ lha mo dbyangs can mas nor sde la zhal 13

gzigs dang dngos grub mi gnang3bas khyab ces khyab mtha' 'god e phod/ phod na/ lha mo dbyangs can ma chos can / sangs rgyas ma yin par thal/ thugs rje la nye ring yod pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ lha mo dbyangs can ma chos can/ thugs rje la nye ring yod par thal/ nor sde la zhal gzigs dang dngos grub mi gnang ba'i phyir/ der thal/ nor sde la dbyangs can ma'i zhal gzigs dang dngos grub thob pa mdo rgyud gang las kyang ma gsungs pa ni khyod rang gi sgrub byed yang dag yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gal te de 'dra yod na rgyu 'bras la mi bden pa'i skyon du 'gyur ba 'di sgod rang gi sgrub byed de'i rting gnon yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags khas/gal te snyan tshig tu bris pa rnams dngos gnas de ltar yin dgos na/ khyod rang gi khro gtam de'i mchod brjod du/mtshan tsam lan cig yid la dran pas kyang / /thar 'dod blo yi rmongs pa'i myun sel ba'i/ /rgyal kun ye shes phung bo mañdzu shri/ /snying dbus pad+ma'i ge sar bzhad par rol/ / zhes rje 14

gzigs dang dngos grub mi gnangad+ngha bas khyab ces khyab mtha' 'god e phod/ phod na/ lha mo dbyangs can ma chos can/sangs rgyas ma yin par thal/ thugs rje la nye ring yod pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ lha mo dbyangs can ma chos can/ thugs rje la nye ring yod par thal/ nor sde la zhal gzigs dang dngos grub mi gnang ba'i phyir/ der thal/ nor sde la dbyangs can ma'i zhal gzigs dang dngos grub thob pa mdo rgyud gang las kyang ma gsungs pa ni khyod rang gi sgrub byed yang dag yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gal te de 'dra yod na rgyu 'bras la mi bden pa'i skyon du 'gyur ba 'di khyod rang gi sgrub byed de'i rting gnon yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags khas/gal te snyan tshig tu bris pa rnams dngos gnas de ltar yin dgos na/ khyod rang gi khro gtam de'i mchod brjod du/‘‘mtshan tsam lan cig yid la dran pas kyang / /thar 'dod blo yi rmongs pa'i mun sel ba'i/ /rgyal kun ye shes phung bo mañdzu shri/ /snying dbus pad+ma'i ge sar bzhad par rol/ /’’zhes rje 14

gzigs dang dngos grub mi gnangad+ngha bas khyab ces khyab mtha' 'god e phod/ phod na/ lha mo dbyangs can ma chos can/sangs rgyas ma yin par thal/ thugs rje la nye ring yod pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ lha mo dbyangs can ma chos can/ thugs rje la nye ring yod par thal/ nor sde la zhal gzigs dang dngos grub mi gnang ba'i phyir/ der thal/ nor sde la dbyangs can ma'i zhal gzigs dang dngos grub thob pa mdo rgyud gang las kyang ma gsungs pa ni khyod rang gi sgrub byed yang dag yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gal te de 'dra yod na rgyu 'bras la mi bden pa'i skyon du 'gyur ba 'di khyod rang gi sgrub byed de'i rting gnon yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags khas/gal te snyan tshig tu bris pa rnams dngos gnas de ltar yin dgos na/ khyod rang gi khro gtam de'i mchod brjod du/‘‘mtshan tsam lan cig yid la dran pas kyang / /thar 'dod blo yi rmongs pa'i mun sel ba'i/ /rgyal kun ye shes phung bo mañdzu shri/ /snying dbus pad+ma'i ge sar bzhad par rol/ /’’zhes rje 14

btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mtshan tsam lan gcig la dran pas kyang rmongs mun sel bar 'dod dgos pas/ de ltar na khyod kyis da lta da dung thos pa lhur len pa'i dgos pa ci/khyod kyis da dung thos pa lhur len pa'i ngang tshul 'dir bltas na/ yang min na 'jam pa'i dbyangs la de 'dra'i nus pa med par thag gis chod la/ yang min na khyod kyi mi tshe gang bo rab byung btsun pa'i lus blangs kyang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mtshan tsam zhig lan gcig tsam la'ang yid la dran ma myong ba'i nang mtshang rul ba de da lta nyid du phyir mngon pa kho thag chad do/ / yang bod mkhas pas‘‘gangs ljongs bsil ba'i reg byas dbyangs lha mo/ /grang bas nyen te kho bo'i snying dbus su/ /dri za'i 'jig rten rdzogs pa'i snyan tshig glu/ /len pa'i zol gyis bag phab gnas sam snyam/ /’’zhes pa'i rab rtog gi rgyan 'di yang / khyod ltar na lha mo dbyangs can ma de dngos gnas gangs ljongs grang reg gis tshe srog chad la khad du 'dod 15

btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mtshan tsam lan gcig la dran pas kyang rmongs myun sel bar 'dod dgos pas/ de ltar na khyod kyis da lta da dung jos pa lhur len pa'i dgos pa ci/khyod kyis da dung thos pa lhur len pa'i ngang tshul 'dir balhas na/ yang min na 'jam pa'i dbyangs la de 'dra'i nus pa med par thag gis chod la/ yang min na khyod kyi mi tshe gang bo rab byung btsun pa'i lus blangs kyang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mtshan tsam zhig lan gcig tsam la'ang yid la dran ma myong ba'i nang mtshang rul ba de da lta nyid du phyir mngon pa kho thag chad do/ / yang bod mkhas pas‘ gangs ljongs bsil ba'i reg byas dbyangs lha mo/ /grang bas nyen te kho bo'i snying dbus su/ /dri za'i 'jig rten rdzogs pa'i snyan tshig glu/ /len pa'i zol gyis bag phab gnas sam snyam/ / zhes pa'i rab rtog gi rgyan 'di yang / khyod ltar na lha mo dbyangs can ma de dngos gnas gangs ljongs grang reg gis tshe srog chad la khad du 'dod 15

dgos pas/ de lta na 'u cag gi shes rab lha mo'i sku tshe la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i bca' ba rim gro zhig dang lhan du da lo'i dgun kha'i grang reg gis mi skyon pa'i rtsag rgan(slog pa)dron po zhig dbyangs can ma la bzo rgyu'ang khyod mkhyen lags/ /yang khyod kyis rgan nor sde la/ rang nyid sngags par zlom pa ni ngo tsha ste/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len sna gcig kyang mi ldan pa'i steng rgyud sde spyi dang bye brag gi dam tshig sna gcig tsam srung ba phar zhog ming tsam bgrang ba la yang kha gnam du gdangs te sdod dgos pa'i blun rgan khyod 'dra ba la sngags kyi rig pa 'dzin pa'i ming don mi 'jug pas so/ / zhes bris 'dug la/nor sde'i rgyud na bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len sna gcig kyang sked pa de/ khyod kyis nor sde phra gsal me long gi nang du bzhag ste bltas pas mthong ngam/ yang na khyod kyi ye shes kyi spyan gyis gzigs pas rtogs pa 'a gas/ ston pa shākya thub pas nga dang nga 'dra ba ma gtogs gang zag gi tshod gang zag 16

gis mi thug gsungs pas/ yang min na ston pa'i gsung de 'khrul zhing / yang min na khyod ston pa shākya dang 'dra ba'i sangs rgyas dngos shig yin par thal lo/ /ha ha ha/o brtson chos can/ sangs rgyas yin par thal/ gang zag gi tshod thug pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ khro brtson chos can/ gang zag gi tshod thug par thal/ nor sde'i tshod thug pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ o brtson chos can/ nor sde'i tshod thug lar thal/nor sde'i rgyud na yon tan med pa'i tshod thug pa'i phyir/ der thal/ nor sde'i rgyud na bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len sna gcig tsam yang med pa khyod kyis mkhyen pa'i phyir ro/ /des na/ lha mo dbyangs can ma ni thugs rje la nye ring yod pas rigs drug gi nang du mar 'phongs la/ khyod kyis gang zag gi tshod thug pas lha mo dbyangs can ma'i khri steng nas mar ltos dang / rgyu 'bras la shin tu 'phrod pa'i bden don zhig khyod la thob nges so zhes pa 'dis khro rgyan brtson 'grus kyi khro gtam de'i 17

tshig don gyi cha la cung tsam dgag pa de tsam gyis chog par bgyi la/ da ni o rgyan brtson 'grus kyi khro gtam de'i phyogs lhung dang log rtog gi lta ngan la dhi ba gnad du 'phangs nas dgag lan slong bar bya ste/ dang po/ khyod kyi〈 khro gtam〉de'i nang du/ 'bru rigs dang zas sna dkon tshe g.yag lug bshas na 'os 'os chog chog lta bu zhig tu bstan 'dug pa 'di ci zhig yin/ 'di nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i lta ba zhig yin nam phyi rol mu stegs pa'i lta ba zhig yin/ lar khyod rang nyid phyi nang gi grub mtha' gang la zhugs yod pa mi shes pas lan smos shig/gnyis pa/ khyod kyis mgo log la dmar mchod kyi lo rgyus tsam yang med par dam bcas rjes/ slar yang rdza mu ra sprul skus dmar mchod kyi rgyun bcad par smra la/ dmar mchod de yang dmar mchod dngos yin par bshad 'dug pa 'di ci/khyod kyi snga tshig gi rdzun rkub de phyi tshig gis brtol ba ji ltar 'geb rgyu/ lan thongs shig /18

tshig don gyi cha la cung tsam dgag pa de tsam gyis chog par bgyi la/ da ni o rgyan brtson 'grus kyi khro gtam de'i phyogs lhung dang log rtog gi lta ngan la j-i ba gnad du 'phangs nas dgag lan slong bar bya ste/ dang po/ khyod kyi〈 khro gtam //de'i nang du/ 'bru rigs dang zas sna dkon tshe g.yag lug bshas na 'os 'os chog chog lta bu zhig tu bstan 'dug pa 'di ci zhig yin/ 'di nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i lta ba zhig yin nam phyi rol mu stegs pa'i lta ba zhig yin/ lar khyod ra nga nyid phyi nang gi grub mtha' gang la zhugs yod pa mi shes pas lan sgos shig /gnyis pa/ khyod kyis mgo log la dmar mchod kyi lo rgyus tsam yang sked par dam bcas rjes/ slar yang rdza myu ra sprul skus dmar mchod kyi rgyun bcad par spru la/ dmar mchod de yang dmar mchod dngos yin par bshad 'dug pa 'di ci /khyod kyi snga tshig gi rdzun rkub de phyi tshig gis brtol ba ji ltar 'geb rgyu/ lan thongs shig /18

gsum pa/ khyod kyis bon po tshos shi bo'i dge rtsar rlom nas g.yag lug bsad par bshad 'dug pa 'di ci/ khyod kyis ston pa gshen rab kyi zhal dngos su gsungs pa'i shi bo'i dge rtsar g.yag lug bsad na chog ces pa'i bka' shog 'dzar gcig gam yang na tshig 'bru phyed tsam zhig ston rgyu e yod/ med na khyod kyis spobs pa chen pos de ltar smra ba'i rgyab rten gang yod smos shig / bzhi ba/ ban bon gnyis kas phyi nang gi khyad par skyabs 'gros 'byed pa dang / lta ba bkar bta gas kyi phyag rgya bzhi khas len pa/ ston pa bstan pa lta ba gsum gyi sgo nas kyang ban bon grub mtha' mi 'gal bar gcig tu song ba dag khyod kyi phyogs lhung gi snang ngor ji ltar rgyab 'gal dang ltag sprod du gyur ba lags//lnga ba/ snod bcud chags tshul gyi thad nas/ bon pos‘‘grub ni spyi mthun las las grub/ /’’ces pa dang / ‘‘'di ltar snang ba'i dngos po kun/ /rgyu rkyen rten 'brel stobs las 19

gsum pa/ khyod kyis bon po tshos shi bo'i dge rtsar zlom nas g.yag lug bsad par bshad 'dug pa 'di ci/ khyod kyis ston pa gshen rab kyi zhal dngos su gsungs pa'i shi bo'i dge rtsar g.yag lug bsad na chog ces pa'i bka' shog 'dzar gcig gam yang na tshig 'bru phyed tsam zhig ston rgyu e yod/ med na khyod kyis spobs pa chen pos de ltar smra ba'i rgyab rten gang yod smos shig / bzhi ba/ ban bon gnyis kas phyi nang gi khyad par skyabs 'gros 'byed pa dang / lta ba bkar btags kyi phyag rgya bzhi khas len pa/ ston pa bstan pa lta ba gsum gyi sgo nas kyang ban bon grub mtha' mi 'gal bar gcig tu song ba dgakhyod kyi phyogs lhung gi snang ngor ji ltar rgyab 'gal dang ltag sprod du gyur ba lags/ /lnga ba/ sdod bcud chags tshul gyi thad nas/ bon pos grub ni spyi mthun las las grub/ / ces pa dang / ‘‘'di ltar snang ba'i dngos po kun/ /rgyu rkyen rten 'byel stobs las 19

byung / /’’zhes pa dang / gzhan yang / gdul bya 'dul byed mtshungs ldan du skyes pa dang / sa chu me rlung gis 'jig rten grub par bshad pa/ de yang stong gsum du 'dod cing chags gnas 'jig stong bzhir nges pa/ mi rnams 'od gsal lha las chad pa dang 'gro ba rigs drug tu gyes par bshad pa rnams rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i bka' chos gang dang 'gal ba'i lan thobs shog /drug pa/ ston pa gshen rab kyi skye bzhes sogs mdzad pa bcu gnyis dang / dang po thugs bskyed tshul/ bar du tshogs bsags tshul/ tha ma sangs rgyas tshul dag kha che'i ston pa dang ye shes kyi ston pa sogs la mi mtshungs par ston pa shākya thub pa dang gcig mtshungs kho nar gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan ci//bdun pa/ bon lugs kyi bslab pa gsum dang thos bsam sgom gsum/ phar phyin drug dang bon sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong du 'dod pa dag khyod kyis ji ltar ban lugs dang 'gal bar 'grel rgyu//20

byung / / zhes pa dang / gzhan yang / gdul bya 'dul byed mtshungs ldan du skyes pa dang / sa chu me rlung gis 'jig rten grub par bshad pa/ de yang stong gsum du 'dod cing chags gnas 'jig stong bzhir nges pa/ mi rnams 'od gsal lha las chad pa dang 'gro ba rigs drug tu gyes par bshad pa rnams rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i bka' chos gang dang 'gal ba'i lan thobs shog /drug pa/ ston pa gshen rab kyi skye bzhes sogs mdzad pa bcu gnyis dang / dang po thugs bskyed tshul/ bar du tshogs bsags tshul/ tha ma sangs rgyas tshul dag kha che'i ston pa dang ye shes kyi ston pa sogs la mi mtshungs par ston pa shākya thub pa dang gcig mtshungs kho nar gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan ci//bdun pa/ bon lugs kyi bslab pa gsum dang thos bsam sgom gsum/ phar phyin drug dang bon sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong du 'dod pa dag khyod kyis ji ltar ban lugs dang 'gal bar 'grel rgyu//20

brgyad pa/ bon pos dge sdig las bde sdug 'byung bar bshad pa dang dge sdig las 'jig rten khams sna tshogs su 'phel bar bshad pa/ mar gyur sems can du 'dod cing skye ba snga phyi ru 'dod pa/ las 'bras chud mi za bar 'dod pa dag kyang khyod kyis rgyal ba shākya'i dgongs pa dang 'gal bar ji ltar bsgrub rgyu/ / dgu ba/ bden pa gnyis kyi skabs/ bon pos kun rdzob tu ni dngos rnams zhen pas yod/ /dam pa'i don du chags pa spangs pas sked/ / ces pa dang / ban lugs pas chos rnams kun rdzob 'khrul blo'i shes ngor yod/ /don dam ma 'khrul blo ngor yod pa min/ / zhes pa gnyis khyod kyi ngor dung dkar ser snang gi tshul du ji ltar 'gyur ba lags/ /bcu ba/ lta ba'i mchog dbu ma'i thad nas/ ston pa gshen rab kyi zhal dngos nas/ snang stong gnyis la bka' stsal te/ snang na snang du rung ste mtshan dang dbye bya dgas pa/stong na stong du rung ste gzung 'dzin yul las 'das/ snang 21

stong gnyis ka'i don bstan dbu ma'i lam du bde'o/ //zhes sogs su gsungs pa 'di khyod kyis ban lugs pa'i dbu ma dang 'gal zlar ji ltar go ba len rgyu/ /bcu gcig bon po'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum dang lta sgom dag thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas ban lugs rnying ma ba'i de dag dang gcig tu gsungs yod pa de khyod kyis ji ltar rgol rgyu/ 'dir khyod kyis sngar rgan nor sde la bkod pa'i sgrub byed ‘zer lugs dbyibs mtshungs pa tsam gyis gcig tu mi 'grub/ ces pa de yang skyar 'god par byed kyang / des rdog mi non te/ tshig don gnyis ka'i cha nas zer lugs dbyibs mtshungs na mtshungs pa yin pas khyab pa'i phyir na lan smos shig / bcu gnyis/ ban bon gnyis kyi chos lugs kyi mthar thug gi lta ba ni/ gnyis kas stong nyid snying rje'i snying bo can zhig tu brjod kyang2/ khyod kyis 'di yang me chu lta bu zhig tu ji ltar go ba len gyin yod/ / 22

stong gnyis ka'i don bstan dbu ma'i lam du bde'o/ /’’zhes sogs su gsungs pa 'di khyod kyis ban lugs pa'i dbu ma dang 'gal zlar ji ltar go ba len rgyu//bcu gcig bon po'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum dang lta sgom dag thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas ban lugs rnying ma ba'i de dag dang gcig tu gsungs yod pa de khyod kyis ji ltar rgol rgyu/ 'dir khyod kyis sngar rgan nor sde la bkod pa'i sgrub byed‘‘zer lugs dbyibs mtshungs pa tsam gyis gcig tu mi 'grub/’’ces pa de yang skyar 'god par byed kyang / des rdog mi non te/ tshig don gnyis ka'i cha nas zer lugs dbyibs mtshungs na mtshungs pa yin pas khyab pa'i phyir na lan smos shig / bcu gnyis/ ban bon gnyis kyi chos lugs kyi mthar thug gi lta ba ni/ gnyis kas stong nyid snying rje'i snying bo can zhig tu brjod kyangasta/ khyod kyis 'di yang me chu lta bu zhig tu ji ltar go ba len gyin yod// 22

stong gnyis ka'i don bstan dbu ma'i lam du bde'o/ /’’zhes sogs su gsungs pa 'di khyod kyis ban lugs pa'i dbu ma dang 'gal zlar ji ltar go ba len rgyu//bcu gcig bon po'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum dang lta sgom dag thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas ban lugs rnying ma ba'i de dag dang gcig tu gsungs yod pa de khyod kyis ji ltar rgol rgyu/ 'dir khyod kyis sngar rgan nor sde la bkod pa'i sgrub byed‘‘zer lugs dbyibs mtshungs pa tsam gyis gcig tu mi 'grub/’’ces pa de yang skyar 'god par byed kyang / des rdog mi non te/ tshig don gnyis ka'i cha nas zer lugs dbyibs mtshungs na mtshungs pa yin pas khyab pa'i phyir na lan smos shig / bcu gnyis/ ban bon gnyis kyi chos lugs kyi mthar thug gi lta ba ni/ gnyis kas stong nyid snying rje'i snying bo can zhig tu brjod kyangasta/ khyod kyis 'di yang me chu lta bu zhig tu ji ltar go ba len gyin yod// 22

bcu gsum/ bon po tsho'i gzhung na/ sha khra dmar mchod spyod lam la 'gal te/ / zhes pa dang / khyed la mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /'bras kyi bshos bu rgyan can dang / /rin chen 'bru yi g.yag lug ra/ / zhes pa dang / khyed la mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /rin chen gtsang ma'i snod bzang du/ /dkar mngar 'bru bcud bshos sangs dang / /g.yag lug bya ra'i gzugs 'gros dang / / zhes sogs su 'byung ba dag khyod kyis dmar mchod kyi tshig tu ji ltar go ba blangs pa yin// bcu bzhi/ khyod kyi 'dod pa ltar na/ bon chos de ban chos las phar bsgyur bar 'dod la/ de lta na da lta ban chos de mchog tu gyur cing bon chos de khyod kyis tha shal du smra don ci/ bsgyur sa'i chos de mchog pa dang bsgyur ba'i chos de zhan par 'jog na/ sngon rgya gar gyi nang ba'i chos de mchog tu gyur la da lta khyod kyis nyams su len bzhin pa'i chos 'di tha shal du 'gyur ba'i mgo mtshungs kyi rig pa zhig byis pas 'ur rdo bskor ba bzhin khyod kyi klad steng du 'bab pas rgol 23

ba rtsoms shig /bco lnga/ rdo sbis dge bshes shes rab rgya mtshos/ lha mo dbyangs can ma la gsol ba 'debs dus/ ‘‘dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /’’zhes dbyangs can ma sangs rgyas dngos yin par gsungs la/ snyan dgon sprul sku gsung rab pas/ /skyabs 'gro'i sdom du sangs rgyas ni/ /‘‘kun la thugs rje nye ring med/ /phan btags ma btags don mdzad phyir/ /’’zhes gsungs 'dug yin na'ang / khyod kyis lha mo dbyangs can mas nor sde gtan nas rjes su mi 'dzin par dam bcas 'dug pa la bltas na/ yang min na rdo sbis dge bshes kyis lha mo dbyangs can ma sangs rgyas yin par gsungs pa de 'khrul zhing / yang min na sprul sku gsung rab pas sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje la nye ring med zhu ba de rdzun la/de min na khyod kyis dbyangs can mas nor sde rjes su mi 'dzin par bshad pa de nor nyen che bas/ 'di la yang khyod kyi lan zhig shin tu nyag / 24

ba rtsoms shig /bco lnga/ rdo sbis dge bshes shes rab rgya mtshos/ lha mo dbyangs can ma la gsol ba 'debs dus/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes dbyangs can ma sangs rgyas dngos yin par gsungs la/ snyan dgon sprul sku gsung rab pas/ /skyabs 'gro'i sdom du sangs rgyas ni/ / kun la thugs rje nye ring med/ /phan btags ma btags don mdzad phyir/ / zhes gsungs 'dug yin na'ang / khyod kyis lha mo dbyangs can mas nor sde gtan nas rjes su mi 'dzin par dam bcas 'dug pa la bltas na/ yang min na rdo sbis dge bshes kyis lha mo dbyangs can ma sangs rgyas yin par gsungs pa de 'khrul zhing / yang min na sprul sku gsung rab pas sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje la nye ring med zhu ba de rdzun la/de min na khyod kyis dbyangs can mas nor sde rjes su mi 'dzin par bshad pa de nor nyen che bas/ 'di la yang khyod kyi lan zhig shin tu nyag / 24

bcu drug rje btsun tsong kha pa chen pos/ bon po'i bla ma dang mkhas grub chen po mnyam med shes rab rgyal mtshan mchog la.e ma ho/ bde chen rgyal bo kun bzang rgyal ba 'dus/ /kun mkhyen dbang po shes rab smra ba'i seng / /'dzam gling mkhas mang gtsug rgyan mnyam med pa/ /shes rab rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / zhes rje rin po ches bon po'i chos lugs la dad pa dag snang dang bon po'i bla ma la zhal dngos su gsol 'debs gnang 'dug pa 'di/ khyod kyi lta ba dang 'gal bas/ khyod kyis rje rin po che la de ltar byas na mi 'os mi rung tshul gyi dgag lan ji ltar mdzad rgyu/ / bcu bdun/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ ston pa gshen rab mi bo ni/ /de nas 'og min pho brang gnas nas ni/ /'gro ba sems can don la byon tshul te/ /'od zer kha dog sna lnga cir yang snang bar sprul/ /'od zer rab tu spros pas 'jig rten khams rnams khyab/ / ces slob dpon rin po ches ni spyir bon bstan de na—nga ba'i bstan par 'dod dzi5

cing / gshen rab khong yang nang ba sangs rgyas kyi ston par khas len pa ni khong gi zhal gsung de las kyang nga tshos bde blag tu rtogs thub pa red/ yin na'ang / slob dpon gyi gsung de khyod o brtson gyi lta ba dang shin tu 'gal te/ khyod kyis bon chos de mu stegs pa'i chos su smra zhing gshen rab khong mu stegs pa'i ston par 'dod pa 'di khyod rang gi dam bca' yin pas/ khyod dang slob dpon shin tu 'gal/ 'o na da lta khyod kyis slob dpon rin po che khas blangs na/ khyod rang gi lta ngan de 'dor dgos shing / khyod rang gi lta ngan de dor na/ khyod mkhas pa'i gral nas 'bud dgos pas/ de sngar khyod kyis nor sde la‘‘mkhas par 'dod pas mkhas pa'i gral nas bud/ /mi’ces zur za byas pa la/ da lta khyod nor sde'i sngun nas ngo re tsha/ gal te khyod kyis slob dpon rin po che khas ma blangs na/ yang de sngar khyod kyis snga 'gyur rnying ma'i mkhas grub dam pa re zung bzhugs yod zer ba dag gis khyod rang nyid la'ang yid tshim pa'i gsol ston zhig byed nges 26

cing / gshen rab khong yang nang ba sangs rgyas kyi ston par khas len pa ni khong gi zhal gsung de las kyang nga tshos bde blag tu rtogs thub pa red/ yin na'ang / slob dpon gyi gsung de khyod o brtson gyi lta ba dang shin tu 'gal te/ khyod kyis bon chos de mu stegs pa'i chos su smra zhing gshen rab khong mu stegs pa'i ston par 'dod pa 'di khyod rang gi dam bca' yin pas/ khyod dang slob dpon shin tu 'gal/ 'o na da lta khyod kyis slob dpon rin po che khas blangs na/ khyod rang gi lta ngan de 'dor dgos shing / khyod rang gi lta ngan de dor na/ khyod mkhas pa'i gral nas 'bud dgos pas/ de sngar khyod kyis nor sde la mkhas par 'dod pas mkhas pa'i gral nas bud/ / ces zur za byas pa la/ da lta khyod nor sde'i srun —nas ngo re tsha/ gal te khyod kyis slob dpon rin po che khas ma blangs na/ yang de sngar khyod kyis snga 'gyur rnying ma'i mkhas grub dam pa re zung bzhugs yod zer ba dag gis khyod rang nyid la'ang yid tshim pa'i gsol ston zhig byed nges 26

pa ma yin nam/ des na da lta khyod kyis/ slob dpon bka' la mi 'gal zhing / /rang gi dam bca' mi 'chor bar/ /ban bon grub mtha' me chu bzhin/ /sgrubs dang khyod la mkhas pa zer /zhes kha mtshar gyi tshul du'ang dgag lan slong bar byed do/ /bco brgyad/ thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas/ bon zhes smad kyang gal la thug pa'i dus/ /bon po ju thig can la blang dor 'dri/ /bon ltar gyer la dga' zhing gto thabs sogs/ /bon gyi cho gas phan par kun gyis re/ / zhes rgyun par bon po la smad pa byed kyang gal chen po la thug dus su/bod gangs can pa kun gyis bon po la blang dor 'dri zhing bon po'i bcos thabs kyis phan par re ba byed kyin 'dug gsungs pa 'di khyod kyis khas len nam mi len/ khas len na khyod kyis kyang rgyun par bon po la smad khul byas kyang gal la thug tshe bon po'i bcos thabs la snying nas re bzhin yod pa'i bya byed nang 'gal can de khyod kyis ma mos lu gu len len gyis la/ khas mi len na thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi 27

pa ma yin nam/ des na da lta khyod kyis/ slob dpon bka' la mi 'gal zhing / /rang gi dam bca' mi 'chor bar/ /ban bon grub mtha' me chu bzhin/ /sgrubs dang khyod la mkhas pa zer/ /zhes kha mtshar gyi tshul du'ang dgag lan slong bar byed do/ /bco brgyad/ thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas/ ‘‘bon zhes smad kyang gal la thug pa'i dus/ /bon po ju thig can la blang dor 'dri/ /bon ltar gyer la dga' zhing gto thabs sogs/ /bon gyi cho gas phan par kun gyis re/ /’’zhes rgyun par bon po la smad pa byed kyang gal chen po la thug dus su/bod gangs can pa kun gyis bon po la blang dor 'dri zhing bon po'i bcos thabs kyis phan par re ba byed kyin 'dug gsungs pa 'di khyod kyis khas len nam mi len/ khas len na khyod kyis kyang rgyun par bon po la smad khul byas kyang gal la thug tshe bon po'i bcos thabs la snying nas re bzhin yod pa'i bya byed nang 'gal can de khyod kyis ma mos lu gu len len gyis la/ khas mi len na thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi 27

ma'i gsung de khyod kyis nges par du nor 'khrul can du dgag dgos pas/ da ni khyod lkug pa'i brtul zhugs bzung ste 'dug khom ga la yod/ de sngar khyod kyis nor sde la‘‘rdzogs pa chen po'i chos rnams zhib par bshad na gsang sgrog gi nyes par 'gyur bas ’’sogs nyams rdzig rdzig tu bshad pa la/ da ni dngos gnas khyod la gsang tshig re yod na'ang 'phud ran yin pas/ myi kha 'dzam gling nas ma 'jog par lan smos shig/bcu dgu/ 'ju mi pham phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis/ ‘‘gshen yul 'ol mo gling chen du/ /ston pa gshen rab mi bor bstan/ /’’ces dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos/ ‘‘zhang zhung yul na bon 'dul bar/ /dgongs te gshen rab mi bor sprul/ / ’ces ston pa shāka gshen gnyis phan tshun sprul sku yin par gsungs pa 'di/ khyod kyis khas e len/ khas len na de snga yan chad khyod kyis ston pa sangs rgyas gshen rab kyi sku gsung thugs rten dang bcas pa'i g.yung drung bon gyi bstan 28

ma'i gsung de khyod kyis nges par du nor 'khrul can du dgag dgos pas/ da ni khyod lkug pa'i brtul zhugs bzung ste 'dug khom ga la yod/ de sngar khyod kyis nor sde la rdzogs pa chen po'i chos rnams zhib par bshad na gsang sgog gi nyes par 'grur bas sogs nyams rdzig rdzig tu bshad pa la/ da ni dngos gnas khyod la gsang tshig re yod na'ang 'phud ran yin pas/ rmya kha 'dzam gling nas ma 'jog par lan smos shig /bcu dgu/ 'ju mi pham phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis/ gshen yul 'ol mo gling chen du/ /ston pa gshen rab mi bor bstan/ / ces dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos/ ‘ zhang zhung yul na bon 'dul bar/ /dgongs te gshen rab mi bor sprul/ / ces ston pa shāka gshen gnyis phan tshun sprul sku yin par gsungs pa 'di/ khyod kyis khas e len/ khas len na de snga yan chad khyod kyis ston pa sangs rgyas gshen rab kyi sku gsung thugs rten dang bcas pa'i g.yung drung bon gyi bstan 28

pa la bcings pa'i ngan sems dang log lta'i sdeg sgrib chen pos khyod dmyal bar lhung nges yin pas/ khyod kyis nges par du da lta nyid nas dmyal ba'i rgyu khong khro dang phrag dog nga rgyal/ phyogs lhung / log lta sogs sngar byas kyi spyod ngan khong du dug song ba ltar phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi bgyid pa'i dam bca' ji ltar bya rgyu lags/ khas mi len na khyod kyis nges par du mi pham dang sde srid 'gog dgos la/ khyod kyis mi pham dang sde srid khogs sam/ ngas bltas na/ khyod sangs rgyas ma song bar du khyod kyis mi pham dang sde srid 'gog mi thub la/ gal srid khyod sangs rgyas par gyur kyang /de dus kyi mi rnams da lta'i khyod kyi phyogs khrung gi bsam pa lta bu zhig gis khyer tshe/ khyed kyi bka' yang bden par 'dzin min mi shes pas/ 'di la yang khyod kyis ji ltar bya rgyu yin lags/ mkhas pa rin po che / /nyi shu/ rgan nor sdes bon rdzogs gnyis ka'i chos la 'dra sa mang bas dpyad gzhi che bar smra ba tsam la yang / khyod kyis29

‘‘rgyal ba mtsho 'khrungs dbang bo'i bstan pa gser sbyang btso ma lta bu'i yang snying 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lta sgom spyod gsum la smod pa ma bzod par ’’zhes sogs khong khro snying nas langs shing khro gtam drag tu bsgrags mod/ bon rdzogs gnyis phan tshun khungs gcig gam shan zhugs pa gang yin mi shes pa'i dpyad sgo tsam phye ba la de 'dra'i khong khro langs rin zhig ga la yod/ de bas khyod khong khro langs na langs rin yod shag shag cig ni/ rang re bod gangs can pa kun gyis gal la thug dus bon po la re bar 'dod pa'i thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma dang / shāka gshen gnyis phan tshun sprul sku yin par smra ba'i mi pham dang sde srid gnyis/bon bstan la dag snang dang bon bla la gsol 'debs gnang ba'i rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po/ gzhan yang bon po'i grub mthas bshad tshul rnams rgyal ba shākya'i bka' dang bstan bcos nas bshad pa dang don 'dra bar gsungs pa'i spyan snga ba blo gros rgyal mtshan dang / bon po'i yul lha gzhi bdag 30

‘rgyal ba mtsho 'khrungs dbang bo'i bstan pa gser sbyang btso ma lta bu'i yang snying 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lta sgom spyod gsum la smod pa ma bzod par zhes sogs khong khro snying nas langs shing khro gtam drag tu bsgrags mod/ bon rdzogs gnyis phan tshun khungs gcig gam shan zhugs pa gang yin mi shes pa'i dpyad sgo tsam phye ba la de 'dra'i khong khro langs rin zhig ga la yod/ de bas khyod khong khro langs na langs rin yod shag shag cig ni/ rang re bod gangs can pa kun gyis gal la thug dus bon po la re bar 'dod pa'i thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma dang / shāka gshen gnyis phan tshun sprul sgu yin par spra ba'i mi pham dang sde srid gnyis/bon bstan la dag snang dang bon bla la gsol 'debs gnang ba'i rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po/ gzhan yang bon po'i grub mthas bshad tshul rnams rgyal ba shākya'i bka' dang bstan bcos nas bshad pa dang don 'dra bar gsungs pa'i spyan snga ba blo gros rgyal mtshan dang / bon po'i yul lha gzhi bdag 30

srung ma rnams la bsang zhing mchod par byed pa'i be+e ro tsa na dang rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po dag gis ni/ khyod kyi lta ba dang rgyab 'gal sha stag tu gsungs 'dug pas/ khyod khro na khro rgyu de na gda' 'o/ /da dung de bas kyang khyod kyi snying la lag rnyob byed pa lta bu zhig ni/ kun mkhyen sher 'od dang stag tshang lo tsā bas bon theg pa dgu ba rnying ma'i rdzogs chen dang mthun par gsungs pa 'di dang / thu'u bkwan rin po ches bon rdzogs gnyis thugs nang gshin po yod par smra ba 'di dang /da dung de bas kyang gzhan gyis bltas na dgod spro zhing khyod rang gis bltas na ngu spro ba zhig ni/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas rang nyid kyi zhal dngos nas ston pa gshen rab nang ba'i ston par khas blangs nas gshen rab kyi che ba brjod pa de dang / yang khong gi zhal nas‘ sngon tshe bskal bzang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /da lta'i ston pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi bstan/ /ji gsungs thams cad 'gro don yin pa'i phyir/ /bon dang chos zhes dbye ba ga la yod/ /snyoms par mi 'jog 31

phrag dog rtsod pa 'di/ /mtha' phug bod yul phung ba'i gzhi ru 'gro/ /de phyir bon chos ma rtsod rang sar zhog /’’ces gsungs pa 'di ste/ khyod kyis bon chos 'dra bar gsungs pa kun gyis rgyal ba mtsho 'khrungs dbang bo'i bstan pa la smod par 'dod na/ mtsho 'khrungs dbang bo rang nyid kyis bon chos 'dra bar gsungs 'dug pas/ mtsho 'khrungs dbang bo rang nyid kyis rang nyid kyi bstan par smod pa lta bu zhig tu gyur 'dug pa 'di/ gzhan gyis bltas na khong dgod 'chor zhing / khyod rang nyid kyis bltas kyin bltas kyin bsam gyin bsam gyin bgad na ngo tsha zhing ngus na snying gzer ba zhig ma yin nam/ ‘‘mkhas pa’’lags/ /mdor na/ khyod kyis da lta da dung bon chos 'dra bar smra ba kun gyis rgyal ba mtsho 'khrungs dbang bo'i bstan pa la smod par 'dod kyin yod na/ khyod kyis rtsa ba bskyur nas rtse mo dang gnyan po bskyur nas gnyom po la mi 'tham par thog mar mtsho 'khrungs dbang bo rang nyid kyis rang nyid kyi bstan 32

phrag dog rtsod pa 'di/ /mtha' phyug bod yul phung ba'i gzhi ru 'gro/ /de phyir bon chos ma rtsod rang sar zhog / ces gsungs pa 'di ste/ khyod kyis bon chos 'dra bar gsungs pa kun gyis rgyal ba mtsho 'khrungs dbang bo'i bstan pa la smod par 'dod na/ mtsho 'khrungs dbang bo rang nyid kyis bon chos 'dra bar gsungs 'dug pas/ mtsho 'khrungs dbang bo rang nyid kyis rang nyid kyi bstan par smod pa lta bu zhig tu gyur 'dug pa 'di/ gzhan gyis bltas na khong dgod 'chor zhing / khyod rang nyid kyis bltas kyin bltas kyin bsam gyin bsam gyin bgad na ngo tsha zhing ngus na snying gzer ba zhig ma yin nam/ ‘mkhas pa lags/ /mdor na/ khyod kyis da lta da dung bon chos 'dra bar smra ba kun gyis rgyal ba mtsho 'khrungs dbang bo'i bstan pa la smod par 'dod kyin yod na/ khyod kyis rtsa ba bskyur nas rtse mo dang gnyan po bsgyur nas gnyom po la mi 'tham par jog mar mtsho 'khrungs dbang bo rang nyid kyis rang nyid kyi bstan

pa la smod pa de khogs la/ de nas khyod kyis rje tsong kha pa dang slob dpon bai ro tsa na/ kun mkhyen sher 'od dang stag tshang lo tsā ba/ rgyal dbang lnga ba dang sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/'ju mi pham dang thu'u bkwan rin po che sogs kyang rim gyis khogs/ gzhan yang shar skal ldan rgya mtshos/ gzhan chos lugs grub mtha' sna tshogs la/ /yid g.yo ba'i dad pa skyes na rab/ /de min kyang dag snang sbyong ba dang / /don med par mi smod dam bca' yin/ / zhes pa 'di dang / yang〈 bde mchog rtsa rgyud 〉las/ sems can mos pa bsam mi khyab/ / sangs rgyas rol ba bsam mi khyab/ /rang gi gzhung dang ma mthun yang / /smad cing spang bar mi bya ste/ /nam zhig go bar smon lam thobs/ / zhes pa 'di dang / khyad par du bdag cag gi ston pa rin po che shākya thub pas/ ‘‘gang dag sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la rjes su chags pa'ang med la/ myu stegs can gyi chos la khong khro ba'ang ma mchis pa de dag dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa'o/ / zhes gsungs pa 'di dag kyang /33

khyod kyis gzha na gyi chos lugs grub mtha' la bzung ba'i phrag dog dang phyogs lhung gi lta ngan dang shin tu 'gal bas/ khyod kyis 'di dag kyang lung dang rigs pa'i skya bar nas ma 'bor bar mthar chags su khogs dang ngas khyod la mkhas pa zer zhing ngas khyod la 'gyod bshags bya/gal te khyod kyis gong gsal gyi mkhas pa dag mi khogs shing / kho bo'i 'dri tshig nyi shu bo la'ang dgag lan mi rnyed na/de sngar khyod kyis rang nyid mkhas par rlom zhing thams cad dgag snang skye ba'i bsam spyod dag gzur gnas mkhas pa'i gral la mi mdzes shing / khyod kyis rang nyid btsun par rlom yang / rang nyid nga rgyal zhe sdang phrag dog phyogs lhung log lta sogs kyis khyer ba'i bsam spyod dag grwa btsun bzang bo'i gras la mi mdzes pas/ khyod da lta nyid du mkhas btsun gnyis kyi sa nas mar song la/ thog ma'i las dang po'i skabs kyi thos pa rgya chen po yun ring du lhur len par mdzod cig gu//

khyod kyis gzhan gyi chos lugs grub mtha' la bzung ba'i phrag dog dang phyogs lhung gi lta ngan dang shin tu 'gal bas/ khyod kyis 'di dag kyang lung dang rigs pa'i skya bar nas ma 'bor bar mthar chags su khogs dang ngas khyod la mkhas pa zer zhing ngas khyod la 'gyod bshags bya/gal te khyod kyis gong gsal gyi mkhas pa dag mi khogs shing / kho bo'i 'dri tshig nyi shu bo la'ang dgag lan mi rnyed na/de sngar khyod kyis rang nyid mkhas par rlom zhing thams cad dgag snang skye ba'i bsam spyod dag gzur gnas mkhas pa'i gral la mi mdzes shing / khyod kyis rang nyid btsun par rlom yang / rang nyid nga rgyal zhe sdang phrag dog phyogs lhung log lta sogs kyis khyer ba'i bsam spyod dag grwa btsun bzang bo'i gras la mi mdzes pas/ khyod da lta nyid du mkhas btsun gnyis kyi sa nas mar song la/ thog ma'i las dang po'i skabs kyi thos pa rgya chen po yun ring du lhur len par mdzod cig gu//34

smras pa/ bon rdzogs lta sgom gcig pa'i dpyad sgo 'ji/ /nor sde rgad pos chung ma'i rum nas rnyed/ /mtsho 'khrungs rang gis rang bstan bshigs 'dra 'di//nyal rogs pus mo'i bar nas khyod kyis rnyed / /bden rdzun mi brtag zhen pas kha tshon gcod//legs nyes mi dpyad khro bas dmod 'dzing byed//snang mtho yo brtson mgar ba'i bu glos khrod/ /srid pa'i phyir skor nga dang 'phrad pas lan//rgad po nor sde rjes su mi gzung bas/ /tshangs pa'i bu mo 'khor ba'i sa la 'gyel/ /nor sde'i rgyud kyi yon tshad gzigs pa khrod//skad cig nyid la sa bcu'i go 'phang brnyes//'tshig pa thu'u bkwan g.yag la za ba khrod/ /35

smras pa/bon rjags lta sgom gcig pa'i dpyad sgo 'ji/ /nor sde rgad pos chung ma'i rum nas rnyed/ /mtsho 'khrungs rang gis rang bstan bshigs 'dra 'ji/ /nyal rogs pus mo'i bar nas khyod kyis rnyed/ / bden rdzun mi brtag zhen pas kha tshon gcod//legs nyes mi dpyad khro bas dmod 'dzing byed//snang mabo yo brtson mgar ba'i bu glos khrod/ /t+pad pa'i phyir skor nga dang 'phrad pas lan/ /rgad po nor snge rjes su mi gzung bas/ /tshangs pa'i bu mo 'khor ba'i sa la 'gyel/ /nor sde' rgyud kyi yon tshad gzigs pa khrod/ /be+ed cig nyid la sa babyu'i go 'phang brnyes/ /'tshig pa thu'u bkwan g.yag la za ba khrod/ /35

long lcag nor sde'i rta bor brabs na yang // shāka gshen phan tshun sprul ba'i ske dbyug 'di/ /'jam mgon mi pham bla mas khrod la sprad//ces pa 'di ni/ mar gyur sems can la snying rje sgom dus bod rigs kyi bon po rigs drug gi nang du bgrang min la the tshom skye zhing / sdang ba'i dgra bo rang mdun gyi nam mkhar sgom/ tshe gsod 'dod kyi phaṭa sgra phangs med du gtong ba/ phyogs lhung gi me lces snying tsha rgyas shing / zhe sdang gi 'khor lo ril ril du bsgril ba'i grwa rgyags snang mtho o rgyan brtson 'grus zer ba des/ yang dag pa'i lung rigs kyi sgrub byed mi 'god par/ khar ci yong gis‘‘nor sde khyi rgan/ blun rgan/glang rgan/ bon rgan/ nor skyong’’sogs tshig rtsub kho nas bkang ba'i khro gtam spel ba la/ dri ba gnad du 'phangs nas dgag lan slong ba'i phyir du/ lha dang mi dang ri ljon dang tha na dmyal khams na'ang sangs rgyas kyi sprul ba yod par smra ba'i rang lugs kyis ston pa gshen shāka gnyis sprul skur 36

long lcag nor sde'i rta bor brabs na yang // shāka gshen phan tshun sprul ba'i ske dbyug 'di/ /'jam mgon mi pham bla mas khrod la sprad//ces pa 'di ni/ mar gyur sems can la snying rje sgom dus bod rigs kyi bon po rigs drug gi nang du bgrang min la the tshom skye zhing / sdang ba'i dgra bo rang mdun gyi nam mkhar sgom/ tshe gsod 'dod kyi phaṭa sgra phangs med du gtong ba/ phyogs lhung gi me lces snying tsha rgyas shing / zhe sdang gi 'khor lo ril ril du bsgril ba'i grwa rgyags snang mtho o rgyan brtson 'grus zer ba des/ yang dag pa'i lung rigs kyi sgrub byed mi 'god par/ khar ci yong gis‘‘nor sde khyi rgan/ blun rgan/glang rgan/ bon rgan/ nor skyong’’sogs tshig rtsub kho nas bkang ba'i khro gtam spel ba la/ dri ba gnad du 'phangs nas dgag lan slong ba'i phyir du/ lha dang mi dang ri ljon dang tha na dmyal khams na'ang sangs rgyas kyi sprul ba yod par smra ba'i rang lugs kyis ston pa gshen shāka gnyis sprul skur 36

long lcag nor sde'i rta bor zabs na yang / / shāka gshen phan tshun sprul ba'i ske dbyug 'ji/ /'jam mgon mi pham bla mas khrod la sprad/ /ces pa 'di ni/ mar gyur sems can la snying rje sgom dus bod rigs kyi bon po rigs drug gi nang du bgrang min la the tshom skye zhing / sdang ba'i dgra bo rang mdun gyi nam mkhar sgor/ tshe gsod 'dod kyi phaṭa sgra phangs med du gtong ba/ phyogs lhung gi me lces snying tsha rgyas shing / zhe sdang gi 'khor lo ril ril du bsgril ba'i grwa rgyags snang mtho o rgyan brtson 'grus zer ba des/ yang dag pa'i lung rigs kyi sgrub byed mi 'god par/ khar ci yong gis nor sde khye rgan/ blun rgan/glang rgan/ bon rgan/ nor skyong sogs tshig rtsub kho nas bkang ba'i khro gtam spel ba la/ dri ba gnad du 'phangs nas dgag lan slong ba'i phyir du/ lha dang mi dang ri ljon dang tha na dmyal khams na'ang sangs rgyas kyi sprul ba yod par smra ba'i rang lugs kyis ston pa gshen shāka gnyis sprul skur 36

'dod cing / sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje la nye ring med par smra ba'i rang lugs kyis dbyangs can mas nor sde rjes su 'dzin 'os par kha tshon gcod nus pa'i ldong rigs kyi snying stobs can/ 'ba' don grub rgyal lam ming gzhan dbyangs can rdo rje'i go cha zhes bya bas yul lha a mye rma rgyal gyi nye 'dabs mgo log mi rigs dge thon slob grwa'i lcang glang rnam par bzhad pa'i dga' tshal du sbyar ba 'dis kyang / bod gangs can gyi yul la grub mtha'i phyogs lhung gi ku co ngan pa gtan nas thos pa med pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // 37

'dod cing / sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje la nye ring med par smra ba'i rang lugs kyis dbyangs can mas nor sde rjes su 'dzin 'os par kha tshon gcod nus pa'i ldong rigs kyi snying stobs can/ 'ba' don grub rgyal lam ming gzhan dbyangs can rdo rje'i go cha zhes bya bas yul lha a bye rma rgyal gyi nye 'dabs mgo log mi rigs dge thon slob grwa'i lcang glang rnam par bzhad pa'i dga' tshal du sbyar ba 'dis kyang / bod gangs can gyi yul la grub mtha'i phyogs lhung gi ku co ngan pa gtan nas thos pa med pa'i rgyur gyur cig / //

bod kyi spyi skad gtan 'bebs byed pa'i thad la bton pa'i bsam 'a char/ gleng gzhi/ de yang bod kyi spyi skad gtan 'be+ebs byed pa'i ched du/bod mdo dbus khams gsum gyi mkhas pa mang bos rang rang gi bsam 'char rnams gcig la gcig 'gran gyi tshul du phan tshun brje res byas dang byed myus su mchis la bsam 'char de dag kyang phan tshun mthun pa dang mi mthun pa sna tshogs su mchis so/ /'on kyang / kho tsho tshang ma'i dmigs yul ni bod kyi mi rigs yig rigs skad rigs gsum po gabyug gyur yong ba kho na'i ched yin pas/ kho tsho'i bsam 'char de dag ci tsam mi 'dra ba'am ci tsam rgyab 'gal du gyur kyang / nga tshos de 38

bod kyi spyi skad gtan 'bebs byed pa'i thad la bton pa'i bsam 'char gleng gzhi/ de yang bod kyi spyi skad gtan 'be+ebs byed pa'i ched du/bod mdo dbus khams gsum gyi mkhas pa mang bos rang rang gi bsam 'char rnams gcig la gcig 'gran gyi tshul du phan tshun brje res byas dang byed mus su mchis la bsam 'char de dag kyang phan tshun mthun pa dang mi mthun pa sna tshogs su mchis so/ /'on kyang / kho tsho tshang ma'i dmigs yul ni bod kyi mi rigs yig rigs skad rigs gsum po gcig gyur yong ba kho na'i ched yin pas/ kho tsho'i bsam 'char de dag ci tsam mi 'dra ba'am ci tsam rgyab 'gal du gyur kyang / nga tshos de 38

dag la phyogs res red dang phrag dog red/ kha bral gtong snyam red la sogs kyi zhwa nag bskon te gtam yang bshad dbang med par bzo ga la rung / 'byung 'gyur bod kyi spyi skad de yang phyogs yongs nas legs 'grub yong ba zhig byed dgos na/ nga tshos nges par du da lta nyid nas bsam 'char mi 'dra ba dang mi mthun pa/ rgyab 'gal ba mang po zhig bsdu len byed dgos te/ 'byung 'gyur bod kyi spyi skad yang dag pa de ni da lta'i bsam 'char mi 'dra ba 'di dag gi rmang gzhi'i steng nas gtan 'be+ebs byed dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /der brten/ phran gyis kyang 'byung 'gyur bod kyi spyi skad gtan 'be+ebs byed par cung tsam e phan snyam pa'i kun slong gis/ 'dir bod kyi skad cha rang ngos kyi steng gi thog mtha' bar gsum gyi thad nas bsam 'char 'ga' 'don khul bya rgyu yin pas/ rgya che'i mkhas pa rnams kyis snyigs dor bcud len byed par zhu/

dag la phyogs res red dang phrag dog red/ kha bral gtong snyam red la sogs kyi zhwa nag bskon te gtam yang bshad dbang med par bzo ga la rung / 'byung 'gyur bod kyi spyi skad de yang phyogs yongs nas legs 'grub yong ba zhig byed dgos na/ nga tshos nges par du da lta nyid nas bsam 'char mi 'dra ba dang mi mthun pa/ rgyab 'gal ba mang po zhig bsdu len byed dgos te/ 'byung 'gyur bod kyi spyi skad yang dag pa de ni da lta'i bsam 'char mi 'dra ba 'di dag gi rmang gzhi'i steng nas gtan 'bebs byed dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /der brten/ phran gyis kyang 'byung 'gyur bod kyi spyi skad gtan 'bebs byed par cung tsam e phan snyam pa'i kun slong gis/ 'dir bod kyi skad cha rang ngos kyi steng gi thog mtha' bar gsum gyi thad nas bsam 'char 'ga' 'don khul bya rgyu yin pas/ rgya che'i mkhas pa rnams kyis snyigs dor bcud len byed par zhu/ 39

gcig dang thog bod skad gcig gyur yin tshul/de yang dang jog gi bod mi rigs kyi skad cha de nges par du gcig gyur yin srid rgyu red/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ bod yig la 'phul dang ming gzhi/ mgo dang 'dogs can/ dbyangs dang mtha' rten bcas yod pa rnams nga tshos sbyor klog byed tshe/ de dag re re la klog tshul rmi sgra gdangs mi 'dra ba re yod dgos pa ni nges can yin na yang / deng sang lha sa ba rnams kyis ji ltar bklags kyang de dag gi sgra gdangs gtan nas dag par mi thon la/ a mdo ba rnams kyis de dag gi sgra gdangs rang rang so sor yang dag par sbyor klog byed thub lugs 'di la bltas na/ bod yig 'di thog mar slob dpon thon mis a mdo'i yul skad gzhir bzhag ste gsar bzo gnang bar thag gis chod thub bo/ /'o na/ slob dpon thon mi ni lha sa'i mi zhig yin pa la/khos a mdo'i yul skad gzhir bzhag ste bod yig bzo dgos 40 —

gcig dang thog bod skad gcig gyur yin tshul/de yang dang thog gi bod mi rigs kyi skad cha de nges par du gcig gyur yin srid rgyu red/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ bod yig la 'phul dang ming gzhi/ mgo dang 'dogs can/ dbyangs dang mtha' rten bcas yod pa rnams nga tshos sbyor klog byed tshe/ de dag re re la klog tshul gyi sgra gdangs mi 'dra ba re yod dgoXs pa ni nges can yin na yang / deng sang lha sa ba rnams kyis ji ltar bklags kyang de dag gi sgra gdangs gtan nas dag par mi thon la/ a mdo ba rnams kyis de dag gi sgra gdangs rang rang so sor yang dag par sbyor klog byed thub lugs 'di la bltas na/ bod yig 'di thog mar slob dpon thon mis a mdo'i yul skad gzhir bzhag ste gsar bzo gnang bar thag gis chod thub bo//'o na/ slob dpon thon mi ni lha sa'i mi zhig yin pa la/khos a mdo'i yul skad gzhir bzhag ste bod yig bzo dgos 40

pa'i rgyu mtshan gang la thug zer na/ gnad don 'dis ni nga tshor lo ngo stong dang sum brgya lhag gi snga rol gyi gsang ba'i mdud rgya chen po zhig da lta nyid du dkrol bar ram 'degs byed thub pa red/ tshang mas ltos dang / slob dpon thon mi ni lha sa'i lho phyogs kyi yul du sku 'khrungs par mkhas rnams glu brgya ngag gabyug ltar yin la/ khong dgung lo bco lnga nas rgya gar du phyin te lo bdun 'gor rjes phyir yong nas lo gsum gyi nang du/ yang yul lha sa nas bod yig gsar bzo mdzad pa'ang phal cher bzhed pa gcig mtshungs red/ de ltar na/ slob dpon thon mi ni lha sa ba zhig yin pa la/ khong rgya gar nas phyir phebs rjes/ de 'dra'i dus thung ngu zhig gi nang du/ am skad kyi 4ga stangs shes mi shes byed zhor du/ da dung u tshugs kyis am skad gzhir bzhag ste bod yig gsar bzo mi byed pa ni gnag rdzis kyang rtogs sla'o/ /de'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ thon mi ni lha sa ba zhig yin pa dang 41

pa'i rgyu mtshan gang la thug zer na/ gnad don 'dis ni nga tshor lo ngo stong dang sum brgya lhag gi snga rol gyi gsang ba'i mdud rgya chen po zhig da lta nyid du dkrol bar ram 'degs byed thub pa red/ tshang mas ltos dang / slob dpon thon mi ni lha sa'i lho phyogs kyi yul du sku 'khrungs par mkhas rnams glu brgya ngag gcig ltar yin la/ khong dgung lo bco lnga nas rgya gar du phyin te lo bdun 'gor rjes phyir yong nas lo gsum gyi nang du/ yang yul lha sa nas bod yig gsar bzo mdzad pa'ang phal cher bzhed pa gcig mtshungs red/ de ltar na/ slob dpon thon mi ni lha sa ba zhig yin pa la/ khong rgya gar nas phyir phebs rjes/ de 'dra'i dus thung ngu zhig gi nang du/ am skad kyi klog stangs shes mi shes byed zhor du/ da dung u tshugs kyis am skad gzhir bzhag ste bod yig gsar bzo mi byed pa ni gnag rdzis kyang rtogs sla'o/ /de'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ thon mi ni lha sa ba zhig yin pa dang 41

pa'i rgyu mtshan gang la thug zer na/ gnad don 'dis ni nga tshor lo ngo stong dang sum brgya lhag gi snga rol gyi gsang ba'i mdud rgya chen po zhig da lta nyid du dkrol bar ram 'degs byed thub pa red/ tshang mas ltos dang / slob dpon thon mi ni lha sa'i lho phyogs kyi yul du sku 'khrungs par mkhas rnams glu brgya ngag gcig ltar yin la/ khong dgung lo bco lnga nas rgya gar du phyin te lo bdun 'gor rjes phyir yong nas lo gsum gyi nang du/ yang yul lha sa nas bod yig gsar bzo mdzad pa'ang phal cher bzhed pa gcig mtshungs red/ de ltar na/ slob dpon thon mi ni lha sa ba zhig yin pa la/ khong rgya gar nas phyir phebs rjes/ de 'dra'i dus thung ngu zhig gi nang du/ am skad kyi klog stangs shes mi shes byed zhor du/ da dung u tshugs kyis am skad gzhir bzhag ste bod yig gsar bzo mi byed pa ni gnag rdzis kyang rtogs sla'o/ /de'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ thon mi ni lha sa ba zhig yin pa dang 41

khos am skad kyis bod yig gsar bzo byas par 'dra ba 'dis ni da gzod nga tshor de dus kyi bod mdo dbus khams gsum gyi skad cha ni gcig gyur yin par mtshon la/ skad cha de yang am skad 'di kho na yin par yang dag pa'i sgo nas ra sprod byung ba red/de bzhin du/ rje btsun sa skya bsod nams rtse mo yang lha sa ba zhig yin na yang / khong gis mdzad pa'i〈 byis 'jug 〉/gi yi ge'i klog stangs de am skad kyi klog stangs dang tag tag gcig mtshungs yin pa 'dis kyang / sngon chad bod kyi skad cha de gcig gyur yin par mtshon thub/ gzhan yang / si tu gtsug lag chos kyi snang bas kyang a mdo dang rgyal mo rong sogs byang shar gyi cha rnams su 'khod pa'i skye bo dag la'ang gna' bo'i dus su bod yul dbus nas byung ba'i klog tshul ma nyams pa yin par grags pa'i klog tshul dang / de dag gi yul skad bcas la'ang gyong nyams che tsam las 'phul rten sogs kyi sgra zur dag par 'don pa 42

'byung bar mngon sum gyis grub (1)ces gsungs shing / de ltar na/ da lta'i a mdo dang rgyal rong gi 1ga tshul dag mo 'di ni gna' bo'i lha sa'i klog tshul ma nyams pa yin par bshad pa yin pas/ ngo ma bshad na/ lha sa'i skad cha ngo ma ni da lta'i a mdo dang rgyal rong gi skad cha 'di yin par thag gis chod la/ de ltar gna' snga mo'i sgra dag pa'i bod kyi spyi skad de yang gna' bo'i lha sa'i skad cha ste da lta'i am skad 'di ma gtogs gzhan gang yang 'jog rgyu med pas/ de dus kyi bod skad de gcig gyur yin par phyogs yongs nas tshad mas grub bo/ / —gnyis/ bod kyi spyo skad sel jor byung tshul/ 'o na/ dang thog bod skad gcig gyur yin na/ da lta phan tshun brda yang 'phrod dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ spyir btang du bod chol kha gsum du gyes rjes/ yul dang yul/ tsho ba dang tsho ba phan tshun bar la sa kha thag ring bas chod de zla 43

'byung bar mngon sum gyis grub’’(1)ces gsungs shing / de ltar na/ da lta'i a mdo dang rgyal rong gi klog tshul dag mo 'di ni gna'‘bo'i lha sa'i klog tshul ma nyams pa yin par bshad pa yin pas/ ngo ma bshad na/ lha sa'i skad cha ngo ma ni da lta'i a mdo dang rgyal rong gi skad cha 'di yin par thag gis chod la/ de ltar gna' snga mo'i sgra dag pa'i bod kyi spyi skad de yang gna' bo'i lha sa'i skad cha ste da lta'i am skad 'di ma gtogs gzhan gang yang 'jog rgyu med pas/ de dus kyi bod skad de gcig gyur yin par phyogs yongs nas tshad mas grub bo/ / gasnyes/ bod kyi spyi skad sil thor byung tshul/ 'o na/ dang thog bod skade gcig gyur yin na/ da lta phan tshun brda yang 'phrod dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ spyir btang du bod chol kha gsum du gyes rjes/ yul dang yul/ tsho ba dang tsho ba phan tshun bar la sa kha thag ring bas chod de zla 43

bden dpang byasamidang byed mus su mchis// 'dir rgya mis bod skad kyi sgra mi thon pa de/ bod kyi skad cha sil thor byung rkyen dang 'brel ba yod dam zer na/ 'brel ba ha cang che ste/ de yang kong jo rnam gnyis bod du phebs te gces su rung ba'i bod rgya mi rigs 'di gnyis kyi 'brel ba sha rus gcig pa'i nye 'brel du gyur pa nas bzung / yul lha sa'i skad la rgya nag gi skad cha'i shan zhugs kyis 'gyur ldog chen po zhig byung mgo brtsams pa red/ 'o na/ kong jo rnam gnyis bod du phebs pa tsam gyis lha sa'i skad la de 'dra'i 'gyur ldog chen po zhig byung thub bam zer na/ 'di lta ste/ 〈 dbon zhang rdo ring dang thang bod bar gyi 'brel ba 〉las ‘spyi lo634la slebs tsa na/ thang rje'i sras mo zhig btsan po'i btsun mor slong ba'i pho nya thog mar rgya yul la brdzangs/de dang de'i lan— du thang gis kyang h+phun ta'e khā(7yīlkostso k+ṣu)zhes pa zhig bod du mngags/ de nas bzung dar ma 'u dum btsan 46

po'i ring la bod kyi rgyal khams ni gcig gyur nas sil bur thor bar gyi lo ngo nyis brgya lhag gi ring la/ bod rgya'i bar pho nya 'gro 'ong ha lam thengs chig brgya dgu bcu lhag byas shing /thengs gcig la mi nyung yang bcu tsam dang mang dus brgya tsam re mchis pa dang / skabs 'gar lo gcig la thengs gsum bzhi re phar 'gro tshur 'ong byas/ pho nya de rnams kyi khrod nas mi la la zhig pha ga'i yul du lo bcu phrag du mar bsdad cing / la la ni yul de ru 'das’’(3)zhes pa dang / yang de nyid las/ ‘‘kong jo rnam gnyis kyi 'khor mang bo dang snga phyi bar gsum gyi pho nya ba rnams kyis rgya'i lag rtsal mngon par 'phags pa rnams bod la bskyal pas bod kyi thon skyed dang bzo bkod kyi lag rtsal rig gnas sogs sngar las gong du 'phel ba dang / nyo tshong byed res dang legs skyes 'bul res byas pas yul gyi gya nom rgyu nor sogs brje res byas pa/ bod kyi gzhon nu blo gsal rnams rgyar brdzangs te rig pa'i gnas la sbyangs pa/ rgya'i yon tan pa mang bo bod 47

du phyin nas bod kyi rig gnas bslabs shing btsan po'i yig sgyur dang skad sgyur gyi lo tsā byas pa/ rgya'i ha shang mang po bod dang / bod kyi btsun pa mang po rgyar phyin pas dam chos mang du bsgyur cing chos bshad pa/ thang gi skar rtsis dang sman dpyad/ sgyu rtsal sogs bod kyis bslabs pas rang nyid kyi rig gnas bang mdzod lhag par phun sum tshogs par song’’(pizhes 'byung lasde/ yang〈4bka' chem ka khol ma 〉las/ ‘‘lha gcig gi 'khor du skyes pa lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis lon pa lnga brgya tham pa/ bu mo lo bcu drug 'gro ba lnga brgya tham pa dang stong tham pa skyel mi la btang’’(5)zhe sa gsungs pa sogs la bltas na/ skabs de'i lha sa grong khyer na/ kong jo rnam gnyis gtso byas pa'i rgya rigs brgya stong mang po zhig mi rabs nas mi rabs bar gnas yod la/ de dag gis bod skad ma shes bar du ngag bsdams nas bsdad pa ga la yin/ der brten/ de 'dra'i rgya rigs mang po'i khrod na/ sgra mi dasgrog pa'i bod skad bshad pa'i khor 48

yug cig nges par du yod srid rgyu red/ de 'dra'i khor yug de yang bod kyi rig gnas dpal 'byor gyi lte ba lha sa grong khyer dang / chab srid dbang 'dzin gyi lte gnas rgyal po'i pho brang na gnas la/ de 'dra'i skad cha de yang bod kyi chos srid gcig lcogs kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po dang khri lde gtsug brtan gyi btsun mo kong jo rnam gnyis kyi kha na nyin mtshan med par bshad kyin 'dug pas na/ de 'dra'i skad cha de la mi dag mi 'grig zer phod pa'i mgo nag bod mi gcig kyang yod srid rgyu ma red/ de la pho brang gi rgyal blon skor zhig gis/kong jo sogs kyis lhag bsam rnam dag gis bod skad sbyangs pa la dga' mgu dang skul 'ded byed ched/ mi dag mi 'grig mi gsung la/ yang la la zhig gis/ de dag gi sgra mi dag par 'dod kyang / rgyal po'i bka' la 'jigs nas ci yang ma gsung / yang bod 'bangs mang che ba zhig gis/ rgya bza' kong jo ni rgya nag rgyal po'i sras mo/ bod rgyal btsan po'i btsun mo/ rje btsun sgrol ma'i rnam sprul yin pas/ mos 49
