bshad pa'i skad cha ni yang dag pa yin snyam te mang pos de'i rjes su slob kyang srid do/ / de'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ kong jo rnam gnyis gtsos rgya rigs mang po'i ngag gi sgra mi dag pa'i bod skad de/ tshong ba bzang bo'i tshong brin pa bzhin du jog mar pho brang gi rgyal blon rnams la lob cing / de nas lha sa grong khyer nas lha sa'i 'brog khyal thams cad dang / rim gyis sa gshis dang 'grim 'grul gyi dbang gis khams phyogs su khyab pa'ang phyogs kun nas rtogs sla'o/ / da dung sgrub byed cig bkod na/ dper na/ rgya nag pa rnams kyis skyabs 'gro dang dmigs brtse ma/ dkar mjes a yig sogs 'don tshe yang /1spyoza1 3mebatshe/rī༅ཿṭ+wā ra 1 1me07/rī༅sgo.oṃ1 1me0skyarī11yodashāyo — )(07/sgo༅yodachayo4khye42/dza lo 6ṣ+ṭha72khye01sgo/ 1khye:me

⑫0zalkordelngaṭ+wākhyer+ṣa oṃ ྈltokhyetsho/ sgrejo⑫lnga༅zarko(khyer+ṣa— 2sgo2༷/be+eṣ+ṭha/4thotshorlu spyo lnga.oṃstsathobatsho.oṃ6/malko0khruzokhye—chaྈ—6r+pāsgo me0ṣ+ṭhar zalho—dze+etshoḥ2oṃ'i ces klo ga la/ lha sa'i skad kyis kyang sgra gdangs de kho na nyid du klog par byed pas na/ lha sa'i skad la rgya nag gi skad gdangs kyi shan zhugs yod pa mngon sum gyis rtogs thub bo/ / der brten/ spyir bod gangs can gyi skad la 'gyur ldog byung rkyen ni yul dus zung gi tshad bkag dang rgya gar nag skad kyi shan zhugs/ skad gsar bcad rim pa'i shugs rkyen sogs mang du mchis na yang / yul lha sa'i skad la 'gyur ldog byung rkyen ni gtso bo rgya nag gi skad kyi shan zhugs yin par nges la/ de nas bzung bod skad la khams skad/ am skad/ lha sa'i skad sogs su sil thor byung ngo / /

༈ stsamopaṃlkozaṣ+ṭhaṭ+wākhristsa lgu༄/ ltokhyetsho/ci7 lko⑫phyadh+raṭ+wārke'ikhrikoṇ+ḍaṃ2r+sākhu.oṃkhri7k+ṣaphothotshon+t+raṣ+ṭhaspo.oṃstsazlobatsho.oṃm+bi/stolko0khram+mu miram̐chaskra༈'i pholkome0rnyer+sharke paṃnywar+hakhye༅ཿkhu.oṃ'i cesahoklog la/ lha sa'i skad kyis kyang sgra gdangs de kho na nyid du klog par byed pas na/ lha sa'i skad la rgya nag gi skad gdangs kyi shan zhugs yod pa mngon sum gyis rtogs thub bo/ / der brten/ spyir bod gangs can gyi skad la 'gyur ldog byung rkyen ni yul dus zung gi tshad bkag dang rgya gar nag skad kyi shan zhugs/ skad gsar bcad rim pa'i shugs rkyen sogs mang du mchis na yang / yul lha sa'i skad la 'gyur ldog byung rkyen ni gtso bo rgya nag gi skad kyi shan zhugs yin par nges la/ de nas bzung bod skad la khams skad/ am skad/ lha sa'i skad sogs su sil thor byung ngo / /51

gsum/ bod skad rbal thor byung ba'i mjug 'azas dang bod la spyi skad gtan 'bebs byed dgos tshul/1 skad cha'i thad nas ba shad na/ da lta dbus skad/khams skad/ am skad/ rong skad/ 'brog skad sogs mang du byung zhing / yul skad kyi shan shugs che drags pa'i dbang gis/phan tshun go brda yang bde mor gtan nas sgod thub kyi med pa red/ gal te phan tshun bgro gleng re byed dgos tshe nges par du phan tshun mgo thod pa gtugs te yi ge 'bri res byed pa dang / yang na mi rigs gzhan rmi skad cha bkol pa gang rung zhig ma byas na/ bod rang skad kyi steng nas phan tshun go brda legs por spyod mi thub pa'i 'u thug thabs zad dang /ngo tsha/ bye g.ya' ba'i gnas su lhung 'dug la/ da dung de bas kyang ha las dgos pa zhig ni/ deng sang gi bod skad 'di yin te/ da lta bod kyi sa phyogs gang du song na'ang / las byed pa tsho smos ci dgos/ tha na 'brog rgan tshos kyang mgo mju ga 52

gsum/ bod skad sil thor byung ba'i mjug 'bras dang bod la spyi skad gtan 'bebs byed dgos tshul/1 skad cha'i thad nas ba shad na/ da lta dbus skad/khams skad/ am skad/ rong skad/ 'brog skad sogs mang du byung zhing / yul skad kyi shan shugs che drags pa'i dbang gis/phan tshun go brda yang bde mor gtan nas sprod thub kyi med pa red/ gal te phan tshun bgro gleng re byed dgos tshe nges par du phan tshun mgo thod pa gtugs te yi ge 'bri res byed pa dang / yang na mi rigs gzhan gyi skad cha bkol pa gang rung zhig ma byas na/ bod rang skad kyi steng nas phan tshun go brda legs por sprod mi thub pa'i 'u thug thabs zad dang /ngo tsha/ skyi g.ya' ba'i gnas su lhung 'dug la/ da dung de bas kyang ha las dgos pa zhig ni/ deng sang gi bod skad 'di yin te/ da lta bod kyi sa phyogs gang du song na'ang / las byed pa tsho smos ci dgos/ tha na 'brog rgan tshos kyang mgo mju ga 52

yongs su tshang ba'i bod skad ngo ma zhig gtan nas bshad thub kyi med pa red/dper na/ bod kyi khrims dpon zhig la mtshon na/ khos yon ga'o rin(ṭhasgom)gyis chas so'u(rnguyo)byas pa ltar na/khyod kyi zhin be+es(2sheme)'di chang can zhin be+es(11lo4bye me) dang hra rin zhin be+es(lkomatsosheme)sogs yin pas/ nga tshos khyod la zhin thi tsi rin byes cig(7/rgor+sā41 shā1)bya rgyu yin/gal te khyod kyi the tu'u(⑫ṭha)bzang na/ si zhin(7be+e/)nas bos chas tho'u zhin(rkespyaṣ+ṭha7/)dang bos chas tho'u zhin(rkespyalobe+e/)nas yug chas tho'u zhin(thospyalobe+e/)du phan(sko//)byas na'ang chog pas drang mor co te(spra4ṅku)byos lta bu sogs zer la/bod kyi sman pa zhig la mtshon na/ ‘khyod kyi nad 'di lan we yan(/7ṭhaphra)yin pas sgor lnga brgya'i ya cin(ga༅)khyer nas kro'u yon (4 cho)byos dang / sang nyin snga dror hwa yan(46skya)dang pis khro(2ྈ)/ zhin ten tho'u( 6rikhye༅)sogs tso(sgo)byas rjes/ phyi dro'i leng ten(khro )thog nas khe to(waza)byed 53

zer ba lta bu dang / yang bod kyi kha lo ba zhig la mtshon na/ da thengs nga lan krig(lngu nyaṣi/)la 'gro ba'i lam du chi khre(༈dz+wasto)yilun the(lkoltad+dha) gad song / ma ta(paṃ7)tshigs song / chi yug('a༈l+le)tshar song /hra khre(blo/1ñtsa)chag song / h+phang zhang phan(skrebo༅)chad song /’’zer ba lta bu sogs ha cang ha cang mtha' yas la/ 'di ltar mu mthud du song tshe/ ma 'ongs pa'i bod skad ni tshig snga phyi sbyor byed kyi phrad gcig pu tsam ma gtogs thams cad rgya skad kho na yin pa'i skad cha gsar ba zhig tu 'gyur 'gro bar gdon mi za'o/ /2 yi ge'i thad nas bshad na/ da lta nga tshos mngon sum du mthong ba'i bod mdo dbus khams gsum gyi tshags par rnams dang / dus deb sna tshogs/ tha na bslab deb dang dpe cha rnams kyi nang du'ang / rang rang gi yul skad dang lung skad kho na'i ming phran sogs bcug ste par bskrun dang khyab bsgrags byed kyin 'dug la/ 'dis ni bod kyi yi ge'i gcig 54

zer ba lta bu dang /yang bod kyi kha lo ba zhig la mtshon na/ da jengs nga lan krig(༅ 1//)la 'gro ba'i lam du chi khre('asto)yi lu na the(nywa55) gad song / ma ta(za ca)tshigs song / chi yug(8 4khye)tshar song /hra khre(blo/)sko)chag song / h+phang zhang phan(7d+ku༅)chad song / zer ba lta bu sogs ha cang ha cang mtha' yas la/ 'di ltar mu mthud du song tshe/ ma 'ongs pa'i bod skad ni tshig snga phyi sbyor byed kyi phrad gabyug pu tsam ma gtogs thams cad rgya skad kho na yin pa'i skad cha gsar ba zhig tu 'gyur 'gro bar gdon mi za'o/ /2 yi ge'i thad nas bshad na/ da lta nga tshos mngon sum du mthong ba'i bod mdo dbus khams gsum rmi tshags par rnams dang / dus deb sna tshogs/ tha na bslab deb dang dpe cha rnams kyi nang du'ang / rang rang gi yul skad dang lung skad kho na'i ming phran sogs bcug ste par bskrun dang khyab bsgrags byed kyin 'dug la/ 'dis ni bod kyi yi ge'i gcig 54

gyur la chag 'jig ha cang chen po zhig bzo bzhin 'dug da dung de bas kyang tshabs che ba zhig ni/ da lta bod mi rigs kyi mthun sgril dang krung hwa rnges rgyal gyi gcig gyur la thugs khur mi byed par rang nyid gcig pu'i grags skam kho na don du gnyer mkhan 'ga' zhig gis/ da lam〈 lha sa'i kha skad tshig mdzod /〉 dang / 〈 lha sa'i kha skad khrog deb // / 〈 a mdo'i kha skad slob deb // dang〈 a mdo'i kha skad tshig mdzod // / da dung 〈 khams skad tshig mdzod /〉dang〈 rgyal rong kha skad tshig mdzod // sogs bsgrigs dang sgrig myus su mchis la/ 'dis bod kyi yi ge'i gcig gyur la gtor brlag ha cang tshabs che ba zhig byas dang byed mus su mchis/ gal te nga tshos rang rang gi〈 kha skad tshig mdzod 〉 dang〈 kha skad bslab deb // de dag bkol spyod byas tshe/ mthar bod dang bod kyi bar du tha na yig thog nas go brda sprod pa'i thabs bkod de yang rang shugs kyis gtan med du bud 'gro ba red/sngon thon rmi rgya mi rigs la mtshon na/ rang rang gi sa 55

cha'i yul skad mtha' yas pa zhig yod na yang / kho tshos〈 pe cin kha skad tshig mdzod /〉/ 〈 hrang he kha skad tshig mdzod 〉/ /〈 zi khron kha skad bslab deb 〉zer ba sogs mi rigs kha thor du gtong ba'i sdug thug gi bya ba 'di 'dra gtan nas bzo gi med pas/ da lta'i nga tshos byas dang byed bzhin pa'i glen rtags 'di dang 'di'i mjug 'bras la bsam blo re btang na/zas za 'dod kyi yi ga'ang 'gag 'gro ba'i gnas su thong srid do/ /3 mi rigs kyi thad nas bshad na/ skad cha sel thor gyi dbang gis mi rigs kha thor du song ba ni bgrang gis mi langs la/ dper na/ bod rang la mtshon na'ang deng sang gi mon pa rigs dang / dbyes rigs/ li su rigs/ 'jang rigs/ la hu'u rigs/ ha nyi rigs/ cin pho rigs/ a khrang rigs/ chang rigs/ phu mi rig sa/ pale rigs/ ci no rigs/tu'u lung rigs/ nu'u rigs/ thu'u ca rigs/ lho ba rigs te/'di dag gi dang jog gi skad cha'i 'byung khungs ni bod dang 56

cha'i yul skad mtha' yas pa zhig yod na yang / kho tshos〈 pe cin kha skad tshig mdzod 〉〉/ 〈 hrang he kha skad tshig mdzod 〉/〈 zi khron kha skad bslab deb 〉〉zer ba sogs mi rigs kha thor du gtong ba'i sdug thug gi bya ba 'di 'dra gtan nas bzo gi med pas/ da lta'i nga tshos byas dang byed bzhin pa'i glen rtags 'di dang 'di'i mjug 'bras la bsam blo re btang na/zas za 'dod kyi yi ga'ang 'gag 'gro ba'i gnas su lhung srid do/ /3 mi rigs kyi thad nas bshad na/ skad cha sil thor gyi dbang gis mi rigs kha thor du song ba ni bgrang gis mi langs la/ dper na/ bod rang la mtshon na'ang deng sang gi mon pa rigs dang / dbyis rigs/ li su rigs/ 'jang rigs/ la hu'u rigs/ ha nyi rigs/ cin pho rigs/ a khrang rigs/ chang rigs/ phu mi rigs/ pa'e rigs/ ci no rigs/tu'u lung rigs/ nu'u rigs/ thu'u ca rigs/ lho ba rigs te/'di dag gi dang thog gi skad cha'i 'byung khungs ni bod dang 56

bod skad yin la/(6)la la zhig deng sang da dung bod yin par mngon sum gyis rtogs thub/ yin na'ang / skad rigs sil thor gyi dbang gis/ deng sang de dag bod red ces bshad na sus kyang khas mi len la/ tha na de dag rang rang gi nang na'ang khas len mkhan ches nyung shas red/ tshul de dang de bzhin du/ da lta'i lha sa'i skad dang khams pa'i skad/ a mdo'i skad de yul skad chen po bzhi dang / nang gses lung ba re la skad cha mtha' yas pa zhig yod pa 'di dag kyang / da lta'i ngang tshul 'di ltar du song tshe/ tha ma de ltar du 'gro bar the tshom med pas/ 'di'i mjug 'bras la sus kyang 'dang rgyag mi phod do/ / —rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir na/ rang re bod mi rigs kyis kyang / sngon thon gyi rgya mi rigs la slob sbyong byas te/ bod rang gi mi rigs yig rigs skad rigs gsum po kha thor du mi 'gro ba'i ched du/ nges par du myur mgyogs kyi sgo nas bod rang la spyi skad yang dag cig gtan 'bebs byed dgos pa 57

bod skad yin la/(6)la la zhig deng sang da dung bod yin par mngon sum rmis rtogs thub/ yin na'ang / skad rigs sil thor gyi dbang gis/ deng sang de dag bod red ces bshad na sus kyang khas mi len la/ tha na de dag rang rang gi nang na'ang khas len mkhan ches nyung shas red/ tshul de dang de bzhin du/ da lta'i lha sa'i skad dang khams pa'i skad/ a mdo'i skad de yul skad chen po bzhi dang / nang gses lung ba re la skad cha mtha' yas pa zhig yod pa 'di dag kyang / da lta'i ngang tshul 'di ltar du song tshe/ tha ma de ltar du 'gro bar the tshom med pas/ 'di'i mjug 'bras la sus kyang 'dang rgyag mi phod do/ / — rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir na/ rang re bod mi rigs kyis kyang / sngon thon gyi rgya mi rigs la slob sbyong byas te/ bod rang gi mi rigs yig rigs skad rigs gsum po kha thor du mi 'gro ba'i ched du/ nges par du myur mgyogs kyi sgo nas bod rang la spyi skad yang dag cig gtan 'be+ebs byed dgos pa 57

ni nga tshor mi rabs gcig gis mi rabs gcig la sprad pa'i rlabs chen kyi 'os 'gan yin pas/ nga tshos 'di'i thad la srog dang bsdos nas 'bad pa byed dgos so/ /'o na/ rang re'i bod mi rigs kyi spyi skad de don dngos yul skad gang zhig byed 'os zhe na/ gnad don 'di la bdag gis gsham du lan 'debs khul byas yod pas gzigs par zhu/ /—bzhi/ lha sa'i skad dang khams skad kyis bod kyi spyi skad mi 'os tshul/da lta'i lha sa'i skad cha 'di la/ rgya nag gi skad cha'i shan zhugs che drags pa'i dbang gis/ da lta bod skad bshad pa dang bod yig klog pa gang gi tshe na yang / mgo 'dogs 'ayul rten sogs kyi sgra gdangs gtan nas dag par thon gyin med pas/ tshul 'di la cung zad zhib tu dpyad na/lha sa'i skad kyis/ ka dang kwa dang dka bka rka lka ska brka 58

ni nga tshor mi rabs gcig gis mi rabs gcig la sprad pa'i rlabs chen gyi 'os 'gan yin pas/ nga tshos 'di'i thad la srog dang bsdos nas 'bad pa byed dgos so/ /'o na/ rang re'i bod mi rigs kyi spyi skad de don dngos yul skad gang zhig byed 'os zhe na/ gnad don 'di la bdag gis gsham du lan 'debs khul byas yod pas gzigs par zhu/ /bzhi/ lha sa'i skad dang khams skad skres bod kyi spyi skad mi 'os tshul/da lta'i lha sa'i skad cha 'di la/ rgya nag gi skad cha'i shan zhugs che drags pa'i dbang gis/ da lta bod skad bshad pa dang bod yig klog pa gang gi tshe na yang / mgo 'dogs 'phul rten sogs kyi sgra gdangs gtan nas dag par thon gyin med pas/ tshul 'di la cung zad zhib tu dpyad na/ lha sa'i skad kyis/ ka dang kwa dang dka bka rka lka ska brka 58

bska bcas yig 'bru dgu po la sgra gdangs gcig ma gtogs gtan nas brjod rgyu med la/ kya dkya bkya rkya skya brkya bskya bdun la'ang sgra gcig ma gtogs med/ de bzhin du/ kra dkra bkra bskra pra spra dpra tra ṭa rnams la'ang sgra gcig ma gtogs med do/ /de bzhin du/ kha khwa mkha 'kha— ṣa lnga dang /khya mkhya 'khya gsum/ khra mkhra 'khra phra 'phra thra drug dag — bag— rga sga brga bsga drug mag — 'ag — lga gsum/ dgya bgya rgya brgya bsgya lnga/ mgya 'gya gnyis/ gra grwa bra dra bzhi/ dgra bgra sgra bsgra sbra lnga/ mgra 'gra 'bra 'dra ḍa lnga/ dang — mang — rnga lnga snga brnga bsnga bdun/ ca gca bca lca dpya spya drug cha mcha 'cha phya 'phya lnga/ ja bya gnyis/ rja baja sbya gsum/ nya nywa mya gsum/gnya mnya rnya snya brnya bsnya dmya rmya smya dgu/ ta gta bta rta lta sta brta blta bsta dgu/ tha mtha 'tha gsum/ da dwa gnyis/ gad—bad— rda sda brda bsda drug mad — 'ad — lda blda zla bzla drug gan — ma/na — rna sna brna bsna snra ṇa brgyad/ pa spa lpa dpa bzhi/ pha 'pha gnyis/ rba sba gnyis/ 'ab — lba gnyis/ rma 59

bska bcas yig 'bru dgu po la sgra gdangs gcig ma gtogs gtan nas brjod rgyu sked la/ kya dkya bkya rkya skya brkya bskya bdun la'ang sgra gcig ma gtogs med/ de bzhin du/ kra dkra bkra bskra pra spra dpra tra ṭa rnams la'ang sgra gcig ma gtogs sked do/ /de bzhin du/ kha khā mkha 'kha — ṣa lnga dang /khya mkhya 'khya gsum/ be+e mkhra 'khra phra 'phra thra drug dag — bag— rga sga brga bsga drug mag — 'ag — lga gsum/ dgya bgya rgya brgya bsgya lnga/ mgya 'gya gnyis/ gra grwa bra dra bzhi/ dgra bgra sgra bsgra sbra lnga/ mgra 'gra 'bra 'dra ḍa lnga/ dang — mang — rnga lnga snga brnga bsnga bdun/ ca gca bca lca dpya spya drug cha mcha 'cha phya 'phya lnga/ ja bya gnyis/ rja brja sbya gsum/ nya pho mya gsum/gnya mnya rnya snya brnya bsnya dmya rmya smyu dgu/ ta gta bta rta lta sta brta blta bsta dgu/ tha mtha 'tha gsum/ da dwa gnyis/ gad —bad — rda sda brda bsda drug mad — 'ad — lda blda zla bzla drug gan — cha/na — rna sna brna bsna snra ṇa brgyad/ pa spa lpa dpa bzhi/ pha 'pha gnyis/ rba sba gnyis/ 'ab — lba gnyis/ rma 59

sma dam — gsum/ tsa gtsa btsa rtsa stsa brtsa rtswa bstsa brgyad/ tsha mtsha 'tsha tshwa bzhi/ rdza brdza gnyis/ mdza 'dza gnyis/ zha gzha bzha zhwa bzhi/ za gza bza zwa bzhi/ g.ya dbya gnyis/ la lwa gnyis/ kla bkla gla bla rla sla bsla bdun/ sha shwa gsha bsha bzhi/sa gas — bas — sra bsra lnga/ ha hwa gnyis sogs sde tshan re gnyis po la khyon yig 'bru nyis brgya bco brgyad(7)yod kyang klog byed kyi sgra gdangs re gnyis ma gtogs med/de bzhin du dbyangs la rjes 'jug zhugs pa'i sgra gdangs las kyang / ar ā gnyis/ ag ags gnyis/ ang angs gnyis/ ab abs gnyis/ am ams gnyis/ al a'i ad as bzhi/ an aṇa gnyis/ i id is ig igs lnga/ ib ibs gnyis/ im ims gnyis/ u ug ugs gsum/ ur u'u gnyis/ ung ungs gnyis/ ub ubs gnyis/ um ums gnyis/ ul u'i ud us bzhi/e ed es eg egs lnga/ er el e'i e'e bzhi/ eng engs gnyis/ eb ebs gnyis/ em ems gnyis/ o og 60

sma dam— gsum/ tsa gtsa btsa rtsa stsa brtsa rtswa bstsa brgyad/ tsha mtsha 'tsha tshwa bzhi/ rdza brdza gnyis/ mdza 'dza gnyis/ zha gzha bzha zhwa bzhi/ za gza bza zwa bzhi/ g.ya dbya gnyis/ la lwa gnyis/ kla bkla gla bla rla sla bsla bdun/ sha shwa gsha bsha bzhi/sa gas— bas— sra bsra lnga/ ha hwa gnyis sogs sde tshan re gnyis po la khyon yig 'bru nyis brgya bco brgyad(7)yod kyang klog byed kyi sgra gdangs re gnyis ma gtogs med/de bzhin du dbyangs la rjes 'jug zhugs pa'i sgra gdangs las kyang / ar ā gnyis/ ag ags gnyis/ ang angs gnyis/ ab abs gnyis/ am ams gnyis/ al a'i ad as bzhi/ an aṇa gnyis/ i id is ig igs lnga/ ib ibs gnyis/ im ims gnyis/ u ug ugs gsum/ ur u'u gnyis/ ung ungs gnyis/ ub ubs gnyis/ um ums gnyis/ ul u'i ud us bzhi/e ed es eg egs lnga/ er el e'i e'e bzhi/ eng engs gnyis/ eb ebs gnyis/ em ems gnyis/ o og 60

ogs gsum/ khro'o or gnyis/ ong khrongs gnyis/ khrob obs gnyis/ om khroms gnyis/ o'i khrol ad as bzhi(8)sogs gdangs tshan nga gcig po la khyon yig 'bru go dgu yod kyang / dngos su klog byed kyi sgra nga gcig ma gtogs med/de ltar sgra gcig pa'i yi ge ka kwa dka bka rka lka ska brka bska dgu la sgra gcig pa'i dbyangs rten i id is ig igs lnga zhugs pa'i dbang du btang na/ sgra gcig pa'i yig 'bru zhe lnga 'byung la/ de bzhin du/ sgra gcig pa'i yi ge kya dkya bkya rkya skya brkya bskya bdun la sgra gcig pa'i dbyangs rten i id is ig igs lnga zhugs pas sgra gcig pa'i yig 'bru so lnga 'byung zhing / sgra gcig pa'i yi ge kra dkra bkra bskra pra spra dpra tra ṭa dgu la de lnga zhugs pas sgra gcig pa'i yig 'bru zhe lnga 'byung ngo / /rigs pa 'di ltar du dpyad tshe/ gong gsal gyi sgra gcig pa'i sde tshan re gnyis po la sgra gcig pa'i dbyangs rten gyi sde tshan nga gcig po zhugs pas/ khyon sgra gcig pa'i 61

ogs gsum/ o'o or gnyis/ ong ongs gnyis/ ob obs gnyis/ om oms gnyis/ o'i ol ad as bzhi(8kyisogs gdangs tshan nga gcig po la khyon yig 'bru go dgu yod kyang / dngos su klog byed kyi sgra nga gcig ma gtogs med/de ltar sgra gcig pa'i yi ge ka kwa dka bka rka lka ska brka bska dgu la sgra gcig pa'i dbyangs rten i id is ig igs lnga zhugs pa'i dbang du btang na/ sgra gcig pa'i yig 'bru zhe lnga 'byung la/ de bzhin du/ sgra gcig pa'i yi ge kya dkya bkya rkya skya brkya bskya bdun la sgra gcig pa'i dbyangs rten i id is ig igs lnga zhugs pas sgra gcig pa'i yig 'bru so lnga 'byung zhing / sgra gcig pa'i yi ge kra dkra bkra bskra pra spra dpra tra ṭa dgu la de lnga zhugs pas sgra gcig pa'i yig 'bru zhe lnga 'byung ngo / /rigs pa 'di ltar du dpyad tshe/ gong gsal gyi sgra gcig pa'i sde tshan re gnyis po la sgra gcig pa'i dbyangs rten gyi sde tshan nga gcig po zhugs pas/ khyon sgra gcig pa'i 61

sde tshan sum stong chig brgya re gnyis 'byung zhing / de la khyon sdom pas yig 'bru nyi khri chig stong lnga brgya gya gnyis yod la/'jigs su rung ba'i grangs ka 'dis ni/ lha sa'i skad du ma zad/ khams skad dang am skad la yang chag 'jig btang dang gtong mus su mchis so/ /gzhan yang‘‘lha sa'i skad kyis bod yig gi mgo 'dogs 'phul rten gyi sgra gdangs mi thon yang / lha sa'i skad la bod kyi〈 rtags 'jug 〉gi dgongs pa dang mthun par sgra gdangs mtho dman gyi dbye ba 'byed rgyu yod pas bod skad kyi bkol spyod la mi gnod do’’zer ba ni rang mgo rang g.yog tu zad de/ bod kyi〈 rtags 'jug 〉gi dgongs pa ni/ 'phul ming dbyangs rten mgo 'dogs deng bcas pa'i sgra rnams cung zad tsam yang ma nyams par brjod thub pa gzhir bzhag gi steng nas/ sgra gdangs mtho dman drag zhan gyi dbye ba 'byed dgos pa yin la/ lha sa'i skad cha la 'phul ming dbyangs rten mgo 'dogs bcas las ming gzhi'i sgra tsam ma 62

sde tshan sum stong chig brgya re gnyis 'byung zhing / de la khyon sdom pas yig 'bru nyi khri chig stong lnga brgya gya gnyis yod la/'jigs su rung ba'i grangs ka 'dis ni/ lha sa'i skad du ma zad/ khams skad dang am skad la yang chag 'jig btang dang gtong mus su mchis so/ /gzhan yang ‘lha sa'i skad kyis bod yig gi mgo 'dogs 'phyul rten gyi sgra gdangs mi thon yang / lha sa'i skad la bod kyi〈 rtags 'jug // gi dgongs pa dang mthun par sgra gdangs mtho dman gyi dbye ba 'byed rgyu yod pas bod skad kyi bkol spyod la mi gnod do zer ba ni rang mgo rang g.yog tu zad de/ bod kyi〈 rtags 'jug // gi dgongs pa ni/ 'phul ming dbyangs rten mgo 'dogs dz+wang bcas pa'i sgra rnams cung zad tsam yang ma nyams par brjod thub pa gzhir bzhag gi steng nas/ sgra gdangs mtho dman drag zhan gyi dbye ba 'byed dgos pa yin la/ lha sa'i skad cha la 'phul ming dbyangs rten mgo 'dogs bcas las ming gzhi'i sgra tsam ma 62

gtogs brjod rgyu med pas na/ bod kyi〈 rtags 'jug 〉/ gi dgongs pa dang mthun thub gang nas yod/yang lha sa'i skad kyis sgra gdangs mtho dman gyi sgo nas yi ge rnams so sor brjod thub zer ba de yang bden par ma mthong ste/ dper na/ ki zhes pa'i sgra 'di la'ang lha sa'i skad du/ 'di dang sgra gcig pa'am phyogs mtshungs pa'i yi ge ki dki bki rki ldi ske brki bsnyi kid kid dkid bkid rkid lkid k+kid brkid bskid kis kis dkis bkis rkis lkis zhis brkis bskes kig kig dkig bkig rkig k+kig skig brkog —bskig kigs kigs dkigs bkigs rkigs lkigs skigs brkigs bskags bcas zhe lnga 'byung la/ de dag las yi ge bzhi ni lha sa'i skad la nga ro bzhi yod zer ba des ngos 'dzin thub pa'i dbang du btang na yang / de'i lhag ma yi ge zhe gcig po la ngos 'dzin byed kyi sgra gdangs so so ba zhig gtan nas med pas/ thabs bkod 'di ha cang thabs zad sdug thug gi bya ba zhig red/63

gtogs brjod rgyu med pas na/ bod kyi〈 rtags 'jug 〉gi dgongs pa dang mthun thub gang nas yod/yang lha sa'i skad kyis sgra gdangs mtho dman gyi sgo nas yi ge rnams so sor brjod thub zer ba de yang bden par ma mthong ste/ dper na/ ‘‘ki’’zhes pa'i sgra 'di la'ang lha sa'i skad du/ 'di dang sgra gcig pa'am phyogs mtshungs pa'i yi ge ki dki bki rki ldi ski brki bski kid kid dkid bkid rkid lkid skid brkid bskid kis kis dkis bkis rkis lkis skis brkis bskis kig kig dkig bkig rkig lkig skig brkig bskig kigs kigs dkigs bkigs rkigs lkigs skigs brkigs bskigs bcas zhe lnga 'byung la/ de dag las yi ge bzhi ni lha sa'i skad la nga ro bzhi yod zor ba des ngos 'dzin thub pa'i dbang du btang na yang / de'i lhag ma yi ge zhe gcig po la ngos 'dzin byed kyi sgra gdangs so so ba zhig gtan nas med pas/ thabs bkod 'di ha cang thabs zad sdug thug gi bya ba zhig red/ 63

khams skad ni/ ‘‘lha sa dang a mdo'i yul skad dang mi 'dra bar/ rang gi nang khul du yang lho byang bar gsum gyi lung skad dang 'brog skad sogs su gyes’’(9)te/ nang phan tshun bar du'ang go brda legs po zhig 'phrod dka' bar 'dug pas/ bod spyi khyab kyis spyad byar 'os pa'i yul skad rang tshugs thub pa zhig gtan nas ma red/ yang khams skad skor zhig gis a mdo'i skad dang 'dra ba'i sgra dag par thon na yang / skor zhig ni lha sa'i skad dang 'dra bar bod skad kyi 'phul rten mgo 'dogs kyi sgra gdangs gtan nas thon gyin med pa red de/ khams skad kyi bod yig gzhi rtsa'i slob de ba cig tu bkod pa ltar na/ ming gzhi la 'phul dang mgo 'dogs zhugs ma zhugs kyi sgra gcig pa'i sde tshan zhe dgu la yig 'bru nyis brgya bco lnga yod la/ dbyangs la rten zhugs ma zhugs kyi sgra gcig pa'i sde tshan nyer brgyad la yig 'bru gya bzhi yod/ de ltar na/ sde tshan zhe dgu po la sde tshan nyer brgyad po zhugs na/ khyon sgra gcig pa'i sde tshan chig stong sum brgya 64

khams skad ni/ lha sa dang a mdo'i yul skad dang mi 'dra bar/ rang gi nang khul du yang lho byang bar gsum gyi lung skad dang 'brog skad sogs su gyes (9〉te/ nang phan tshun bar du'ang go brda legs po zhig 'phrod dka' bar 'dug pas/ bod spyi khyab kyis spyad byar 'os pa'i yul skad rang tshugs thub pa zhig gtan nas ma red/ yang khams skad skor zhig gis a mdo'i skad dang 'dra ba'i sgra dag par thon na yang / skor zhig ni lha sa'i skad dang 'dra bar bod skad kyi 'phul rten mgo 'dogs kyi sgra gdangs gtan nas thon gyin med pa red de/ khams skad kyi bod yig gzhi rtsa'i slob deb cig tu bkod pa ltar na/ ming gzhi la 'phul dang mgo 'dogs zhugs ma zhugs kyi sgra gcig pa'i sde tshan zhe dgu la yig 'bru nyis brgya bco lnga yod la/ dbyangs la rten zhugs ma zhugs kyi sgra gcig pa'i sde tshan nyer brgyad la yig 'bru gya bzhi yod/ de ltar na/ sde tshan zhe dgu po la sde tshan nyer brgyad po zhugs na/ khyon sgra gcig pa'i sde tshan chig stong sum brgya 64

don gnyis yod cing / de la khyon bsdoms pas yig 'bru chig khri brgyad stong drug cu yod(1 )pa red/ des na/ khams pa'i yul skad 'ga' zhig gis kyang bod rang gi 'phul rten mgo 'dogs kyi sgra rnams ma thon pa'i tshab tu/ lha sa'i skad kyi rjes su 'brangs nas rgya nag gi nga ro 'dren thabs bkol te yi ge brgya stong mang bo'i dbye ba 'byed khul byed la/ thabs bkod 'di ni ngo ma thabs zad rjes lus kyi rnam pa zhig yin pa nga tshos gong nas bsgrubs zin pa de rang red /der brten/ nga tshos 'chad nyan dang kha brda byed pa/ 'dri dpyod dang zin tho 'debs pa/ sgra sdud dang rgyang bsgrags la nyan pa/ glog brnyan dang brnyan 'phrin la lta ba sogs sgra'i sgo nas brda sprad bya tshang ma skad cha'i sgra gdangs kho na la brten dgos pas/ nga tshos lha sa'i skad dang khams pa'i skad kyi sgra mi dag pa'i klog stangs kyi skyon chen de bod kyi spyi skad gtan 'be+ebs byed pa'i cha rkyen du blangs na gtan nas 'grig gi med par ra sprod byung ba red/ 65

don gnyis yod cing / de la khyon bsdoms pas yig 'bru chig khri brgyad stong drug cu yod(10 pa red/ des na/ khams pa'i yul skad 'ga' zhig gis kyang bod rang gi 'phul rten mgo 'dogs kyi sgra rnams ma thon pa'i tshab tu/ lha sa'i skad kyi rjes su 'brangs nas rgya nag gi nga ro 'dren thabs bkol te yi ge brgya stong mang bo'i dbye ba 'byed khul byed la/ thabs bkod 'di ni ngo ma thabs zad rjes lus kyi rnam pa zhig yin pa nga tshos gong nas bsgrubs zin pa de rang red /der brten/ nga tshos 'chad nyan dang kha brda byed pa/'dri dpyod dang zin tho 'debs pa/ sgra sdud dang rgyang bsgrags la nyan pa/ glog brnyan dang brnyan 'phrin la lta ba sogs sgra'i sgo nas brda sprad bya tshang ma skad cha'i sgra gdangs kho na la brten dgos pas/ nga tshos lha sa'i skad dang khams pa'i skad kyi sgra mi dag pa'i klog stangs kyi skyon chen de bod kyi spyi skad gtan 'bebs byed pa'i cha rkyen du blangs na gtan nas 'grig gi med par ra sprod byung ba red/ 65

lnga/ a mdo'i skad dang yig skad kyis bod kyi spyi skad 'os tshul/spyir yig thog gi skad cha 'di ni/ bod kyi sngon byon mkhas dbang rnams kyi bka' drin gyis/ ming dang tha snyad/phrad dang rnam dbye/ bya ba'i las tshig sogs bod kyi skad cha'i khyab khungs thams cad brda sprod du gtan la phab zin pas/gal te brda sprod gzhung gi tshig sbyor dang ma 'gal na/ bod mi sus yig thog tu bkod kyang de bod mdo dbus khams gsum gyi mkhas blun sus bltas kyang go brda 'a phrod sha stag yin pas/ bod kyi yig skad 'di ni bod kyi spyi skad gtan 'bebs byed pa'i gzhi 'dzin sa gtso bo'i nang gi gtso bo yin no/ /a mdo'i skad cha la rong skad dang 'brog skad gnyis su phye na'ang / rong 'brog gnyis ka'i bar du phan tshun brda mi 'phrod pa'i skad cha gcig kyang yod pa ma red/ 'on kyang /66

lnga/ a mdo'i skad dang yig skad kyis bod kyi spyi skad 'os tshul/spyir yig thog gi skad cha 'di ni/ bod kyi sngon byon mkhas dbang rnams kyi bka' drin gyis/ ming dang tha snyad/phrad dang rnam dbye/ bya ba'i las tshig sogs bod kyi skad cha'i khyab khungs thams cad brda sprod du gtan la phab zin pas/gal te brda sprod gzhung gi tshig sbyor dang ma 'gal na/ bod mi sus yig thog tu bkod kyang de bod mdo dbus khams gsum gyi mkhas blun sus bltas kyang go brda 'phrod sha stag yin pas/ bod kyi yig skad 'di ni bod kyi spyi skad gtan 'bebs byed pa'i gzhi 'dzin sa gtso bo'i nang gi gtso bo yin no/ /a mdo'i skad cha la rong skad dang 'brog skad gnyis su phye na'ang / rong 'brog gnyis ka'i bar du phan tshun brda mi 'phrod pa'i skad cha gcig kyang yod pa ma red/ 'on kyang /66

rong skad de da lta sgra zur cung nyams pa'i tshul du gnas shing /'brog skad de da lta da dung sgra ha cang dag mo'i tshul du gnas pas na/ 'dir bod kyi spyi skad de am skad byed 'os zhes pa'i am skad de yang gtso bo a mdo'i 'brog skad la bshad pa yin no/ / 'o na a mdo'i 'brog skad 'di la/ klog stangs kyi cha nas dpyad na/ klog stangs kyi yon tan khyad du 'phags pa zhig 'dug pa ste/ a mdo'i 'brog skad kyis yi ge klog pa dang skad cha bshad pa gang yin yang / yi ge'i 'phul dang ming gzhi/ mgo 'dogs dbyangs rten dang bcas pa'i sgra rnams phan tshun ma 'dres par gcig gcig gnyis gnyis su so sor bklag thub cing brjod thub pas bkol spyod kyi rin thang ldan/lo rgyus kyi thad nas brtag na/ a mdo'i 'brog skad 'di/bod rje gnya' khri btsan po'i dus nas brgyud pa'i bod skad yang dag pa yin la/ bod kyi yul dbus lha sa nas byung ba'i 67

rong skad de da lta sgra zur cung nyams pa'i tshul du gnas shing /'brog skad de da lta da dung sgra ha cang dag mo'i tshul du gnas pas na/ 'dir bod kyi spyi skad de am skad byed 'os zhes pa'i am skad de yang gtso bo a mdo'i 'brog skad la bshad pa yin no/ /'o na a mdo'i 'brog skad 'di la/ klog stangs kyi cha nas dpyad na/ klog stangs kyi yon tan khyad du 'phags pa zhig 'dug pa ste/ a mdo'i 'brog skad kyis yi ge k+kog pa dang skad cha bshad pa gang yin yang / yi ge'i 'phul dang ming gzhi/ mgo 'dogs dbyangs rten dang bcas pa'i sgra rnams phan tshun ma 'dres par gcig gcig gnyis gnyis su so sor bklag thub cing brjod thub pas bkol spyod kyi rin thang ldan/lo rgyus kyi thad nas brtag na/ a mdo'i 'brog skad 'di/bod rje gnya' khri btsan po'i dus nas brgyud pa'i bod skad yang dag pa yin la/ bod kyi yul dbus lha sa nas byung ba'i 67

klog tshul ma nyams pa yang yin/ da dung / 'di la bod mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan zhing bod mi rigs kyi skad cha'i khyad chos kyang gnas pas lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan/ khyab che chung gi thad nas dpyad na/ bod mdo dbus khams gsum rmi yul khams mang che ba zhig gis am 'brog gi skad 'di bshad kyin 'dug ste/ mkhas dbang dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyis/ gtsang ba'i skad dang / lho kha'i skad/ khams skad/ a mdo'i skad sogs kyi nang nas mang po zhig nga tshos deng sang ngos 'dzin byas pa'i yig skad dang tag tag mthun po yod pas lha sa'i skad las khyab che gi red (11)ces gsungs la/ slob dpon chen mo dmu dge bsam gtan mchog gis‘‘stod mnga' ris kyi cha nas bzung shar rgyal mo rong gi mtha' bar 'brog skad bshad mkhan zhig yin tshe brda mi 'phrod pa mi dpe zhes gsungs /yang gnya' blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis6 stod mnga' ris kyi 'brog pa tshos bshad pa'i 'brog skad mtsho sngon po'i 'brog 68

klog tshul ma nyams pa yang yin/ da dung / 'di la bod mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan zhing bod mi rigs kyi skad cha'i khyad chos kyang gnas pas lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan/ khyab che chung gi thad nas dpyad na/ bod mdo dbus khams gsum gyi yul khams mang che ba zhig gis am 'brog gi skad 'di bshad kyin 'dug ste/ mkhas dbang dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyis/ ‘‘gtsang ba'i skad dang / lho kha'i skad/ khams skad/ a mdo'i skad sogs kyi nang nas mang po zhig nga tshos deng sang ngos 'dzin byas pa'i yig skad dang tag tag mthun po yod pas lha sa'i skad las khyab che gi red’’(11)ces gsungs la/ slob dpon chen mo dmu dge bsam gtan mchog gis‘‘stod mnga' ris kyi cha nas bzung shar rgyal mo rong gi mtha' bar 'brog skad bshad mkhan zhig yin tshe brda mi 'phrod pa mi dpe’’zhes gsungs/yang gnya' blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis‘‘stod mnga' ris kyi 'brog pa tshos bshad pa'i 'brog skad mtsho sngon po'i 'brog 68

skad dang 'dra ba ni phran rmis dngos su thos myong bas sngon gyi dogs pa lhag med du bsal/ de ltar mnga' ris na 'brog skad bshad pa'i rdzong khag gsum tsam yod pa thos myong la/ rnga ba khul na mdzod dge dang / lung ring dang / rnga ba dang /'dzam thang bcas gtso rdzong khag bzhi dang / 'bar khams dang / shar khog dang / chu chen dang / btsan lha dang / tsha kho sogs rdzong dang sa khyal du'ang 'brog skad bshad mkhan skor dang skor byas nas yod/ dkar mdzes khul du dkar mdzes dang / dar mdo/ li thang / rong brag sde dge nyag rong / brag mgo/ ser shul/ gser rta/ rta'u/ nyag chu kha sogs rdzong khag de dag na'ang mang nyung tshad mi 'dra ba ma gtogs thams cad na 'brog skad bshad mkhan skor dang skor byas nas yod do/ /yang rma chu dang / klu chu dang / bsang chu gsum ni 'brog skad bshad mkhan brgya cha'i dgu bcu'i yan chad la slebs par sems shing / the bo smad dang / co ṣ+pe dang / dpa' ris sogs rdzong khag de dag tu'ang 'brog skad bshad mkhan mi 69

skad dang 'dra ba ni phran gyis dngos su thos myong bas sngon gyi dogs pa lhag med du bsal/ de ltar mnga' ris na 'brog skad bshad pa'i rdzong khag gsum tsam yod pa thos myong la/ rnga ba khul na mdzod dge dang / lung ring dang / rnga ba dang /'dzam thang bcas gtso rdzong khag bzhi dang / 'bar khams dang / shar khog dang / chu chen dang / btsan lha dang / tsha kho sogs rdzong dang sa khul du'ang 'brog skad bshad mkhan skor dang skor byas nas yod/ dkar mdzes khul du dkar mdzes dang / dar mdo/ li thang / rong brag sde dge nyag rong / brag mgo/ ser shul/ gser rta/ rta'u/ nyag chu kha sogs rdzong khag de dag na'ang mang nyung tshad mi 'dra ba ma gtogs thams cad na 'brog skad bshad mkhan skor dang skor byas nas yod do/ /yang rma chu dang / klu chu dang / bsang chu gsum ni 'brog skad bshad mkhan brgya cha'i dgu bcu'i yan chad la slebs par sems shing / the bo smad dang / co ne dang / dpa' ris sogs rdzong khag de dag tu'ang 'brog skad bshad mkhan mi 69

nyung ba zhig yod do/ /mtsho sngon gyi khul lnga na 'brog skad bshad mkhan brgya cha'i brgyad cu slebs thub snyam zhing / yul shul khul gyi chu dmar leb rdzong na'ang 'brog skad bshad mkhan skor cig yod/ gro tshang gi skad ma gtogs pa'i rong pa'am zhing pa'i skad rnams gyong nyams kyi che chung gi tshad ma 'dra ba tsam las 'brog skad kyi zur chag skad yin pa thams cad 'dra/ gro tshang gi skad kyang ha cang go dka' ba rgyal thang dang phyag phreng dang 'dab pa sogs kyi skad lta bu min par cung tsam 'dris par byas na'ang go thub’’(12)ces gsungs/des na/ blo mthun gnya' blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis ni/ am 'brog gi skad cha'i legs cha dang khyab che chung sogs kyi thad la ched du zhib 'jug mi nyung ba zhig byas mthar da gzod sdom tshig 'di bkod pa yin pas yid rton gyi rang bzhin ldan la/ dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las dang dmu dge bsam gtan rnam pa gnyis ni bod kyi tshad ldan gyi mkhas dbang gnyis yin pas rdzun mi smra bar sems/ der brten/70

nyung ba zhig yod do/ /mtsho sngon byu khul lnga na 'brog skad bshad mkhan brgya cha'i brgyad cu slebs thub snyam zhing / yul shul khul gyi chu dmar leb rdzong na'ang 'brog skad bshad mkhan skor cig yod/ gro tshang gi skad ma gtogs pa'i rong pa'am zhing pa'i skad rnams gyong nyams kyi che chung gi tshad ma 'dra ba tsam las 'brog skad kyi zur chag skad yin pa thams cad 'dra/ gro tshang gi skad kyang ha cang go dka' ba rgyal thang dang phyag phreng dang 'dab pa sogs kyi skad lta bu min par cung tsam 'dris par byas na'ang go thub (12)ces gsungs/des na/ blo mthun gnya' blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis ni/ am 'brog gi skad cha'i legs cha dang khyab che chung sogs kyi thad la ched du zhib 'jug mi nyung ba zhig byas mthar da gzod sdom tshig 'di bkod pa yin pas yid rton gyi rang bzhin ldan la/ dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las dang dmu dge bsam gtan rnam pa gnyis ni bod kyi tshad ldan gyi mkhas dbang gnyis yin pas rdzun mi smra bar sems/ der brten/70

a mdo'i 'brog skad 'di ni yul skad gzhan dang gzhan la bsdur na/ bod sa gnas khul du khyab rgya cung che ba'i yu la skad cig yin pa ra ra sprod byed thub pa yin no/ /khyab gdal gtong dka' sla'i thad nas brtag na/'brog phyogs na khyim tshang mang po mnyam sdod byas med par ri lung kun tu 'thor nas bsdad yod stabs/ rgyun par mi mang po lhan du 'dzoms te skad cha bshad pa'ang ha cang nyung ba'i khar dril bsgrags yo byad kyang de bas dkon pas/'brog khul la kho tsho'i skad cha las gzhan pa zhig bsgrags dgos na ha cang dka'/ gal te 'brog skad gtso bor bzung na/ thog mar 'brog pa rnams kyis rang gi skad cha de rang gis bshad shes phyir yang skyar slob shes mi shes byed mi dgos pas/ 'dis ni nga tshor spyi skad khyab gdal dang dril bsgrags byed pa'i bya bar gzhi rtsa'i thog gi gnad don gal chen zhig rang shugs kyis 'grub yod pa red/ rong khog dang grong khyer du/ khyim tshang mang bo mnyam sdod byas yod stabs 71

phan tshun skad cha bshad pa'i go skabs mang la/ dril bsgrags yo byad mang bas dril bsgrags bya ba ni de bas kyang bsgrubs par sla'o/ / drug bod kyi mkhas dbang tshad ldan rnams kyis —bod kyi spyi skad de yul skad gang zhig —byed 'dod yod tshul/ nga tshos bod kyi spyi skad gtan 'bebs byed pa la bod snga rabs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyi bsam 'char gzhi rtsar 'dzin rgyu ni ha cang gal che bas/ 'dir kho tsho'i bsam tshul 'ga' 'god par bya ste/ slob dpon thon mi sam sgo ṭa mchog gis/ rjes 'jug bcu bo ma zhugs na/ /ming gzhan sbyor ba yod mi srid/ /rjes 'jug bcu yi don shes na/ /'bri dang klog dang bshad rnams kyi/ /mtshams sbyor sgra la thogs med cing / /'brel ba smra ba'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /gzhan yang rjes 'jug 72

shes pa yis/ don gyi sbyor ba ma mthong yang / /don dang mthun pa'i sbyor ba shes/ /’’(13)zhes dang / d+ku si tu paṇa chen gyis/ ‘‘rjes 'jug gi yi ge bcu'i bya ba dang gtso bor 'brel ba'i phrad dang rnam dbye la sogs pa'i sgra don gyi 'jug tshul legs par shes na/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams yi ger 'bri ba dang yi ger bris zin pa rnams brjod pa dag par klog pa dang / tshig don rgya cher bgrol nas bshad pa byed pa dang / der ma zad/ bstan bcos sogs rtsom pa dang / gzhan gyi rgol ba tshar gcod pa'i phyir rtsod pa byed pa la sogs pa'i tshe tshig don snga phyi mtshams sbyor ba'i sgra don rnams la blo gros kyi snang ba 'jug par thogs pa med cing tshig dang don snga phyi go log pa dang / mi 'brel ba dang / 'gal ba la sogs pa'i skyon med par 'thad pa dang ldan zhing 'brel chags pa kho na smra ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ba dang / gzhan yang rjes 'jug gi don tshul bzhin shes pa des/yi ger bris pa mthong ba'am gzhan gyis legs par smras pa 73

shes pa yis/ don gyi sbyor ba ma mthong yang / /don dang mthun pa'i sbyor ba shes/ /’’(13)zhes dang / d+ku si tu paṇa chen gyis/ ‘‘rjes 'jug gi yi ge bcu'i bya ba dang gtso bor 'brel ba'i phrad dang rnam dbye la sogs pa'i sgra don gyi 'jug tshul legs par shes na/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams yi ger 'bri ba dang yi ger bris zin pa rnams brjod pa dag par klog pa dang / tshig don rgya cher bgrol nas bshad pa byed pa dang / der ma zad/ bstan bcos sogs rtsom pa dang / gzhan gyi rgol ba tshar gcod pa'i phyir rtsod pa byed pa la sogs pa'i tshe tshig don snga phyi mtshams sbyor ba'i sgra don rnams la blo gros kyi snang ba 'jug par thogs pa med cing tshig dang don snga phyi go log pa dang / mi 'brel ba dang / 'gal ba la sogs pa'i skyon med par 'thad pa dang ldan zhing 'brel chags pa kho na smra ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ba dang / gzhan yang rjes 'jug gi don tshul bzhin shes pa des/yi ger bris pa mthong ba'am gzhan gyis legs par smras pa 73

shes pa yis/ don gyi sbyor ba ma mthong yang / /don dang mthun pa'i sbyor ba shes/ / (1na)zhes dang / si tu paṇa chen gyis/ rjes 'jug gi yi ge bcu'i bya ba dang gtso bor 'brel ba'i phrad dang rnam dbye la sogs pa'i sgra don gyi 'jug tshul legs par shes na/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams yi ger 'bri ba dang yi ger bris zin pa rnams brjod pa dag par klog pa dang / tshig don rgya cher bkrol nas bshad pa byed pa dang / der ma zad/ bstan bcos sogs rtsom pa dang / gzhan gyi rgol ba tshar gcod pa'i phyir rtsod pa byed pa la sogs pa'i tshe tshig don snga phyi mtshams spyor ba'i sgra don rnams la blo gros kyi snang ba 'jug par thogs pa med cing tshig dang don snga phyi go log pa dang / mi 'byel ba dang / 'gal ba la sogs pa'i skyon med par 'thad pa dang ldan zhing 'byel chags pa kho na smra ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ba dang / gzhan yang rjes 'jug gi don tshul bzhin shes pa des/yi ger bris pa mthong ba'am gzhan gyis legs par smras pa 73

thos kyang rung rang nyid kyis de'i don gyi sbyor ba sngar ma mthong ba ste spyod yul du ma gyur pa zhig yin na'ang brjod pa de'i phrad sogs kyi nus pas don dang mthun pa'i sbyor ba gang yang rjes su dpag ste shes par nus pa yin no/ /’’(1cizhes dang / yang sa skya bsod nams rtse mos/ ‘‘gang dang gang la gang btags pas/ /go rim bzhin du gnas nas 'byung / /de la ra mgo lce rtse 'dar/ /la mgo lce klod rgya yang bskyed/ /sa mgo so yi bar nas 'byung / /lhag ma rnams kyang de bzhin shes/ /gal te ma phyin gyur pa ni/ /yi ge phral zhing brjod par bya/ /dper na gra la ga ra 'am/ /sgra la sga ra ji bzhin du/ /de nas 'phul ba bslab par bya/ /gas 'phul thog mar rkan nas dbyung / /das 'phul lce rtse klod pa las/ /ba mas 'phul ba thog mar ni/ /mchu btsum pa las khyad par sna/ /'as 'phul gre ba'i phugs nas dbyung / /'phul zhing brtsegs pa'i yi ge yang / /go rim bzhin dbyung ma phyin na/ /'di yang phral zhing bklag pa 74

ste/ /mkhra la mkha' ra ji bzhin no/ /’’(15)zhes dang /pra ti rin chen don grub kyis/ ‘‘rjes 'jug bcu bo'i don shes pa la dgos pa khyad par can yod de/ rjes 'jug bcu bo dngos dang / de'i rnam 'gyur las byung ba'i rnam dbye phrad dang bcas pa'i tshul/ don gang la tshul ji ltar dgos pa ci'i phyir 'jug pa rnams shes na/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams yi ger 'bri ba dang / bris zin klog pa dang / de'i don gzhan la 'chad pa dang / des mtshon nas rtsom pa dang / rtsod pa la sogs pa rnams kyi tshe/ ming tshig snga phyi 'dren lugs la mkhas pa'i dbang gis/ rjod byed ming tshig snga phyi'i mtshams sbyor ba'i sgra la thogs pa med cing / der ma zad brjod bya don gyi ngo bo dang / khyad par la sogs pa snga phyi mi 'gal bar ston cing gzhan la go ba bde blag tu ster nus pas 'brel ba smra ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /’’(16)zhes gsung ste bod kyi yi ge 'bri klog— bshad pa gang byas kyang / yi ge'i sngon 'jug rjes 'jug mgo can 'dogs can sogs —kyi sgra gzugs dag par 75

ste/ /mkhra la mkha' ra ji bzhin no/ / (15)zhes dang /pra ti rin chen don grub kyis/ ‘‘rjes 'jug bcu bo'i don shes pa la dgos pa khyad par can yod de/ rjes 'jug bcu bo dngos dang / de'i rnam 'gyur las byung ba'i rnam dbye phrad dang bcas pa'i tshul/ don gang la tshul ji ltar dgos pa byu'i phyir 'jug pa rnams shes na/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams yi ger 'bri ba dang / bris zin klog pa dang / de'i don gzhan la 'chad pa dang / des mtshon nas rtsom pa dang / rtsod pa la sogs pa rnams kyi tshe/ ming tshig snga phyi 'dren lugs la mkhas pa'i dbang gis/ rjod byed ming tshig snga phyi'i mtshams sbyor ba'i sgra la thogs pa med cing / der ma zad brjod bya don gyi ngo bo dang / khyad par la sogs pa snga phyi mi 'gal bar ston cing gzhan la go ba bde blag tu ster nus pas 'byel ba smra ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ / (16)zhes gsung ste bod kyi yi ge 'bri klog— bshad pa gang byas kyang / yi ge'i sngon 'jug rjes 'jug mgo can 'dogs can sogs kyi sgra gzugs dag par 75

thon dgo sa tshul bstan cing de bod kyi skad dang yi ge'i spyi'i tshad gzhir bzhag yod pa red/yang si tu paṇa chen gyis‘‘deng sang bod yul dbus dang mtha' 'khob phal cher la rang skad dang yig klog gnyis kar sgra dag par 'don pa med pa la brten nas mkhas pa'i khrod na'ang yig gzugs kyi sdeb dag phyin klog tshul de dang nges par bstun mi dgos bsams’’(17)zhes dang /yang khong gis‘‘skad gsar bcad kyi dus su 'a mtha' phal cher dang da drag ma bris pa'ang de dag gi brjod pa la ha cang ma gsal ba yin par snang ngo’’(18)zhes dang / ‘‘kya khya gya dang / spya phya bya dang / ca cha ja rnams phyogs mtshungs par klog pa dang / bsgya brgya rgya sgya dgya sbya rja rnams mtshungs par klog pa dang / rnga snga dnga' mnga' rnams mtshungs par klog pa sogs 'khrul ba 'byams su klas’’(19)zhes dang / ‘‘de bas na rang nyid kyis sgra dag par bklag ma shes pa'am ma nus na'ang / klog tshul dag pa med do zhes brjod par mi bya'o’’(2༷76

thon dgos tshul bstan cing de bod kyi skad dang yi ge'i spyi'i tshad gzhir bzhag yod pa red/ yang si tu paṇa chen gyis deng sang bod yul dbus dang mtha' 'khob phal cher la rang skad dang yig klog gnyis kar sgra dag par 'don pa med pa la brten nas mkhas pa'i khrod na'ang yig gzugs kyi sdeb dag phyin klog tshul de dang nges par bstun mi dgos bsams (17)zhes dang /yang khong gis skad gsar bcad kyi dus su 'a mtha' phal cher dang da drag ma bris pa'ang de dag gi brjod pa la ha cang ma gsal ba yin par snang ngo (18)zhes dang / ‘ kya khya gya dang / spya phya bya dang / ca cha ja rnams phyogs mtshungs par klog pa dang / bsgya brgya rgya sgya dgya sbya rja rnams mtshungs par klog pa dang / rnga snga dnga' mnga' rnams mtshungs par klog pa sogs 'khrul ba 'byams su klas (19〉zhes dang / de bas na rang nyid kyis sgra dag par bklag ma shes pa'am ma nus na'ang / klog tshul dag pa med do zhes brjod par mi bya'o (2༷〉76

zhes gsungs la/dkar lebs drung yig pad+ma rdo rjes‘skye gnas byed rtsol sgra gdangs sogs/ /ma 'dres so so'i mtshams 'byed phyir/ /slob dpon mkhas nas sbyor klog gces/ /de med deng sang khams 'brog dang / /stod smad lho rong phal cher du/ /klog tshul ma dag rgyun 'byams kyis/ /dga' dga' sgra 'dra sba 'ba' dang / /gda' 'da' rdza dza byed 'brel sogs/ /klog tshul so sor mi 'don cing / /pa'i la pi'i dang ba'i la bi'i rmongs zhen mu 'byams sbyor klog la/ /sdeb sbyor dag 'don mo gnam bu/ / (21)zhes dang /dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyis blo mthun 'ga' zhig gis kha skad dang yig skad zer ba'i ltos med cig yod par brtsis nas/ yi ge'i nang kha skad gzhir bzung nas 'bri dgos pa ma zad/ kha skad kyi nang nas lha sa grong khyer gyi skad de bod sa gnas su khyab che ba'i skad yin pas 'byung 'gyur lha sa grong khyer gyi kha skad de khyab brdal gtong dgos pa/ de 77

gzhir bzung nas yi ge 'bri dgos pa/ sngar yod sum rtags dang / dag yig gi 'gro lugs med pa bzos nas sum rtags kyi gzhung gsar ba dang / dag yig gsar ba bzo dgos pa bcas ni kha phyogs chen po yin pa/ kha phyogs de dang ma mthun pa'i byed stangs shod stangs tshang ma rnying zhen ring lugs dang / phyi bshol byed pa/ ro langs rgyag pa bcas yin pa'i chab srid kyi zhwa mo chen po khyer nas rang nyid dang lta tshul ma mthun pa'i mi la skad cha shod pa'i dbang cha med pa bzo gi yod pa red’’(22)ces dang /yang khong gis‘‘lha sa grong khyer gyi skad de yul skad dang yig skad gcig gyur bya rgyur gzhi 'dzin sa'i rmang gzhi'i yul skad du bzhag nas de rang dar spel gtong rgyu'i u tshugs byas pa de cung zad thal drags pa red bsam gyi 'dug’’(2na)ces dang / 6‘yi ge'i dag cha de lha sa'i kha skad rkyang ba'i thog la bsgyur rgyu'i u tshugs byas pa yin na/ yul skad dang yi ge gcig gyur bzo thub rgyu phar zhog gsar bzos yi ge'i dag 78

gzhir bzung nas yi ge 'bri dgos pa/ sngar yod sum rtags dang / dag yig gi 'gro lugs me+ed pa bzos nas sum rtags kyi gzhung gsar ba dang / dag yig gsar ba bzo dgos pa bcas ni kha phyogs chen po yin pa/ kha phyogs de dang ma mthun pa'i byed stangs shod stangs tshang ma rnying zhen ring lugs dang / phyi bshol byed pa/ ro langs rgyag pa bcas yin pa'i chab srid kyi zhwa mo chen po khyer na sa rang nyid dang lta tshul ma mthun pa'i mi la skad cha shod pa'i dbang cha sked pa bzo gi yod pa red’’(22)ces dang /yang khong gis lha sa grong khyer gyi skad de yul skad dang yig skad gcig gyur bya rgyur gzhi 'dzin sa'i rmang gzhi'i yul skad du bzhag nas de rang dar spel gtong rgyu'i u tshugs byas pa de cung zad thal drags pa red bsam rmi 'dug (2na)ces dang / yi ge'i dag cha de lha sa'i kha skad rkyang ba'i thog la bsgyur rgyu'i u tshugs byas pa yin na/ yul skad dang yi ge gcig gyur bzo thub rgyu phar zhog gsar— bzos yi ge'i dag 78

cha de dang sa gnas gzhan dag gi yul skad bar kha bral che ru 'gro gi red (24ces dang / yul skad dang / yig skad gcig gyur bya rgyu'i gzhi 'dzin sa'i rmang gzhi'i yul skad de lha sa grong khyer rmi yul skad kho nar rtsis na 'greg gi med pa ra sprod gsal po byung yod (25〉ces gsung zhing / khong rnam pa tshos lha sa'i skad dang khams skad skor zhig gis yig klog dang gtam bshad gang byas kyang / yi ge'i 'phul rten mgo 'dogs sogs kyi sgra gdangs gtan nas dag par thon gyin med pa dngos su brjod de/ deng phyin lha sa'i skad kyis bod kyi spyi skad byed pa la nus pa yod rgu bton te sngon 'gog dang bka' bkyon gnang gi yod pa red/ yang si tu paṇa chen gyis khams phyogs kyi mtha' a mdo dang rgyal mo rong sogs byang shar gyi cha rnams 'khod pa'i skye bo dag la'ang gna' bo'i dus su bod yul dbus nas byung ba'i klog tshul ma nyams pa yin par grags pa'i yi ge klog tshul dang / de dag gi yul skad bcas la'ang gyong nyams che 79

tsam las 'phul rten sogs kyi zur dag par 'don pa 'byung bar mngon sum gyis grub’’(26)ces dang /dung dekar blo bzang 'phrin las kyis‘‘gtsang pa'i skad dang / lho kha'i skad/ khams skad/ a mdo'i skad sogs kyi nang nas mang po zhig nga tshos deng sang ngos 'dzin byas pa'i yig skad dang tag tag mthun po yod’’(27)ces dang / yang khong gis‘‘deng sang khams khul dang / co ne/ rgyal rong / mgo log bcas kyi bod rigs sa khul la yang sngon 'byeg yod med dang / mgo can yin min bar la dbye ba gsal po yod’’(28ces gsungs pa las/ kho tshos a mdo'i skad dang khams skad mang shos kyis yi ge'i 'phul rten mgo 'dogs sogs kyi sgra yang dag par 'don thub pa dngos su brjod de/ deng phyin bod kyi spyi skad de yang a mdo'i skad kyis byed 'dod yod pa'i re ba shugs drags su bton yod pa red/der brten/ gong gsal gyi mkhas dbang dang slob dpon chen po thon mi sam bho ṭa dang / rje btsun bsod 80

nams rtse mo/ dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las/ dkar lebs pad+ma rdo rje sogs tshad ldan gyi mkhas dbang 'di dag ni lha sa'i mkhas chen dam pa 'ba' zhig yin na yang / khong rnam pas lha sa'i skad de spyi skad du 'jog 'dod med pa dang / a mdo'i skad de spyi skad du 'jog 'dod yod pa 'dis ni/ nga tshos a mdo'i yul skad 'di bod kyi spyi skad du bzhag na nor 'khrul ci yang med par phyogs yongs nas ra sprod byung yod pa red/ mjug bsdu ba'i katam /gong gsal gyi gnas lugs de dag la bltas na/ nga tshos phyogs gang nas brtags kyang / bod kyi spyi skad de a mdo'i skad dang yig skad gnyis kyis ma byas thabs med lta bu zhig tu snang na yang / de ni shes dman kho bo'i bsam tshul kho na tsam du zad pas/ nor 'khrul dang mi 'dang sa yod nges pa ni smos ma dgos pa zhig yin la/ nga'i bsam 'char gyi steng 81

bod kyi spyi skad gtan 'azebs byed pa'i thad la yang bskyar gleng ba/de yang bod kyi spyi skad gtan 'bebs byed pa'i thad la/bod kyi mkhas pa mang bos rang rang gi bsam 'char rnams gcig la gcig 'gran gyi tshul du phan tshun brje res byas dang byed ba zhin pa 'di ni ji 'dra'i dga' 'os pa zhig red lags/ yin na yang / nga tshos da lta'i bar du rang bstod gzhan smad kyi srol ngan skyong ba tsam las rang gzhan gnyis phan gyi thabs lam legs po zhig ma btsal ba'am ma rnyed pa 'di la shin tu nas kyang yid skyo/ des na thengs 'dir ngas rang bstod gzhan smad kyi phyogs ris spangs shing / snyigs dor bcud len gyi thabs lam spyad nas bod kyi spyi skad gtan 'bebs byed pa'i thad la yang bskyar bsam 'char 'ga' gleng rgyu yin/ 85
