gcig lha sa'i skad kyi bzang cha dang a mdo'i skad kyi zhan cha bshad pa/mig sngar bod kyi yul skad so so'i bzang zhan bsdur na nges par du tshig sbyor gyi thad dang sgra gdangs kyi thad gnyis —po nas bsdur dgos la/ tshig sbyor gyi thad nas bsdur na nges par du da lta bod mdo dbus khams gsum pos phan tshun bde blag ngang go brda sprod thub byed kyi yig skad 'di dang mthun mi mthun blta ba las thabs gzhan gang yang med do/ /'o na lha sa'i skad dang a mdo'i skad gnyis las gang zhig yig skad dang mthun la gang zhig yig skad dang mi mthun pa ni 'og gi gshib bsdur las shes thub ste/ dper na/ bod kyi yig skad du/ ka 'a di su'i slob deb red/kha nga'i red/ka slob deb ci zhig red /86

gcig lha sa'i skad kyi bzang cha dang a mdo'i skad kyi zhan cha bshad pa/mig sngar bod kyi yul skad so so'i bzang zhan bsdur na nges par du tshig sbyor gyi thad dang sgra gdangs kyi thad gnyis po nas bsdur dgos la/ sbyeg sbyor gyi thad nas bsdur na nges par du da lta bod mdo dbus khams gsum pos phan tshun bde blag ngang go brda sprod thub byed kyi yig skad 'di dang mthun mi mthun blta ba las thabs gzhan gang yang med do/ /'o na lha sa'i skad dang a mdo'i skad gnyis las gang zhig yig skad dang mthun la gang zhig yig skad dang mi mthun pa ni 'og gi gshib bsdur las shes thub ste/ dper na/ bod kyi yig skad du/ka 'di su'i slob deb red/kha nga'i red/ ka slob deb ci zhig red/86

kha bod yig sgob deb red/ka khyed rang tsho bod yig bslab mkhan yin nam/kha nga tsho tshang ma bod yig bslab mkhan yin/ka bod yig dang bod skad babe+ebs nas ci zhig byed rgyu yin/ kha rjes mar bod la slebs dus bod rigs dang skad cha shod thub pa'i ched du yin/zhes pa'i tshig sbyor la lha sa'i skad kyi tshig sbyor du/ 〈 lha sa'i kha skad k+kog deb //(89 mi rigs sha 21 pha 8)las/ka 'di su'i slob deb red/kha nga'i red / ka slob deb ga re red/kha bod yig slob deb red/ka khyed rang tsho bod yig basbab mkhan yin pas/kha nga tsho tshang ma bod yig bslab mkhan yin/ka bod yig dang bod skad bslabs nas ga re byed 87

yas yin pa/ kha rjes mar bod la slebs dus bod rigs dang skad cha shod thub pa'i ched du yin /zhes pa las gor thig brgyab pa'i yig 'bru gnyis po ma gtogs gzhan tshang ma yig skad kyi tshig sbyor dang kha 'grig so 'greg tu grub yod pa ni mngon sum tshad mas grub pa 'di yin/ 'on kyang / de la a mdo'i kha skad kyi tshig sbyor du/ka 'di su'i slob deb red/kha nga'i red/ka slob deb chi zig red/ kha bod yig slob deb zig red / ka chi cha bo bod yig slob mkhan yin nas/ kha ji cha bo tshang ma bod yig slob mkhan yin/ka bod yig ra bod skad slob bas rdi zig yed rgyus/kha ltag ga nas bod la thon dras bod dra ༷ sdo kha brda zig yed thub byo'i ched yin/88

yas yin pa/ kha rjes mar bod la slebs dus bod rigs dang skad cha shod thub pa'i ched du yin/zhes pa las gor thig brgyab pa'i yig 'bru gnyis po ma gtogs gzhan tshang ma yig skad kyi tshig sbyor dang kha 'grig so 'grig tu grub yod pa ni mngon sum tshad mas grub pa 'di yin/ 'on kyang / de la a mdo'i kha skad kyi tshig sbyor du/ka 'di su'i slob deb red/kha nga'i red /ka slob deb chi zig red/ kha bod yig slob deb zig red/ka chi cha bo bod yig slob mkhan yin nas/kha ji cha bo tshang ma bod yig slob mkhan yin/ka bod yig ra bod skad slob bas chi zig yed rgyus/kha ltag ga nas bod la thon dras bod dra 'a yo kha brda zig yed thub rgyo'i ched yin/88

zhes 'byung ba bod kyi yig skad kyi tshig sbyor dang mi mthun pa ni mngon gsal gyis mthong pas/ 'di'i steng nas lha sa'i skad kyi tshig sbyor am skad las bzang ba shes sla'o/ / —da rung / a mdo'i skad kyi tshig sbyor rnams bod yig gi bkas bcad rim pa'i rjes chod med pa dper na/ ske dkris la ske dkyis dang / sha khrag la sha khyag grib ma la gyib ma/ ci zhig la chi zig mi la rmya/ mid pa la m+bid pa/ sring mo la hring mo/ zer ba lta bu sogs dang / yang la don gyi thob thang rnams bod kyi brda sgod gzhung dang mi mthun pa dper na/ gang nga 'gyo rgyu/ pe cin na 'gyo rgyu/chi zig ga 'gyo rgyu/ lta skor ra 'gyo rgyu/ nam zig ga yong nga /nyin bcu gsum ma mi thon lta bu/ yang byed 'byel gyi job thang brda sprod gzhung dang mi mthun pa dper na/ dpe cha 'di khyed gi e red/ khyed gi min na blo rgyam gi e red/ tshe brtan gi e red/ lha dpal gi e red lta bu dang / nga'i dpe cha de bkra shis gis e rig bsam 89

'grub gis e rig rig sgron gis e rig sogs lta bu/yang rgyan sdud kyi thob thang gzhung dang mi mthun pa dper na/ bltas rung ma rig bshad drong mi nyan/ lta bu dang / 'byed sdud gzhung dang mi mthun pa dper na/ myig ra/rna ra/ sna ra/ lce ra/ lus rnams ni dbang bo'o/ /lta bu dang /yang gdams ngag gi dang sgra dang mi mthun pa dper na/ zos ra/ nyon dra/ ltos ra/ shod dra/ lta bu sogs mtha' yas pa zhig yod pa 'di dag ni yig skad kyi tshig sbyor dang mthun thabs gtan nas med do/ / gnyis/ a mdo'i skad kyi bzang cha dang lha sa'i skad kyi zhan cha bshad pa/tshig sbyor gyi thad nas lha sa'i skad de am skad las bzang yang / sgra gdangs kyi thad nas am skad de lha sa'i skad las ldab 'gyur gyis bzang ba 'di lta ste/ 〈 lha sa'i kha skad klog deb 〉(89mi rigs sha15pha4)las bkod pa ltar du 90

'grub gis e rig rig sgron gis e rig sogs lta bu/yang rgyan sdud kyi thob thang gzhung dang mi mthun pa dper na/ bltas rung ma rig bshad drong mi nyan/ lta bu dang / 'byed sdud gzhung dang mi mthun pa dper na/ khyag ra/rna ra/ sna ra/ bye ra/ lus rnams ni dbang bo'o/ /lta bu dang /yang gdams ngag gi dang sgra dang mi mthun pa dper na/ zos ra/ nyon dra/ ltos ra/ shod dra/ lta bu sogs mtha' yas pa zhig yod pa 'di dag ni yig skad kyi tshig sbyor dang mthun thabs gtan nas med do/ /gnyis/ a mdo'i skad kyi bzang cha dang lha sa'i skad kyi zhan cha bshad pa/tshig byer gye thad nas lha sa'i skad de am skad las bzang yang / sgra gdangs kyi thad nas am skad de lha sa'i skad las ldab 'gyur gyis bzang ba 'di lta ste/ 〈 lha sa'i kha skad 4ga deb 〉(89 mi rigs sha 15 pha 4)las bkod pa ltar du 90

'grub gis e rig rig sgron gis e rig sogs lta bu/yang rgyan sdud kyi thob thang gzhung dang mi mthun pa dper na/ bltas rung ma rig bshad drong mi nyan/ lta bu dang / 'byed sdud gzhung dang mi mthun pa dper na/ myig ra/rna ra/ sna ra/ lce ra/ lus rnams ni dbang bo'o/ /lta bu dang /yang gdams ngag gi dang sgra dang mi mthun pa dper na/ zos ra/ nyon dra/ ltos ra/ shod dra/ lta bu sogs mtha' yas pa zhig yod pa 'di dag ni yig skad kyi tshig sbyor dang mthun thabs gtan nas med do/ / gnyis/ a mdo'i skad kyi bzang cha dang lha sa'i skad kyi zhan cha bshad pa/tshig sbyor gyi thad nas lha sa'i skad de am skad las bzang yang / sgra gdangs kyi thad nas am skad de lha sa'i skad las ldab 'gyur gyis bzang ba 'di lta ste/ 〈 lha sa'i kha skad klog deb 〉(89mi rigs sha15pha4)las bkod pa ltar du 90

drangs shing sdom rtsis byas na/ da lta'i lha sa'i skad kyis/ ka kwa dka ྾ bka ྾ rka lka ska brka bska bcas yig 'bru dgu bo la klog byed kyi sgra gdangs gcig ma gtogs nyams nas brjod mi thub la/ de bzhin du kya dkya bkya rkya skya brkya bskya bdun la yang sgra gdangs gcig ma gtogs med/ de bzhin du kra dkra bkra bskra pra spra dpra tra ṭa dgu dang / kha khwa mkha ྾ 'kha ྾ ṣa lnga/ khya mkhya 'khya gsum/ khra mkhra 'khra phra 'phra thra drug dag ྾bag ྾ rga sga brga bsga drug mag ྾ 'ag ྾ lga gsum/ dgya brgya rgya brgya bsgya lnga/ mgya 'gya gnyis/ gra grwa bra dra bzhi/ dgra bgra sgra bsgra sbra lnga/ mgra 'gra 'bra 'dra ṭa lnga/ dang ྾ mang ྾rnga lnga snga brnga bsnga bdun/ ca gca ྾ bca ྾ lca dpya spya drugacha mcha ྾ 'cha ྾ phya 'phya lnga/ ja bya gnyis/ rja brja sbya gsum/nya nywa mya gsum/ gnya ྾ mnya ྾ rnya snya brnya bsnya dmya rmya smya dgu/ta gta ྾ bta ྾ rta lta sta brta blta bsta dgu/ tha mtha ྾ 'tha྾ gsum/ da dwa gnyis/ gad ྾ bad ྾ rda sda brda bsda drugamad ྾ 'ad ྾ lda blda zla bzla drug gan ྾ man ྾ rna sna brna 91

drangs shing sdom rtsis byas na/ da lta'i lha sa'i skad kyis/ ka kwa dka rki bka mo rka lka ska brka bska bcas yig 'bru dgu bo la klog byed kyi sgra gdangs gcig ma gtogs nyams nas brjod mi thub la/ de bzhin du kya dkya bkya rkya skya brkya bskya bdun la yang sgra gdangs gcig ma gtogs med/ de bzhin du kra dkra bkra bskra pra spra dpra tra ṭa dgu dang / kha khā mkha sko 'kha sko ṣa lnga/ khya mkhya 'khya gsum/ khra mkhra 'khra phra 'phra thra drug dag rkibag ma rga sga brga bsga drug mag sko 'ag sko lga gsum/ dgya brgya rgya brgya bsgya lnga/ mkhya 'gya gnyis/ gra grwa bra dra bzhi/ dgra bgra sgra bsgra sbra lnga/ mgra 'gra 'bra 'dra ṭa lnga/ dang mo mang mornga lnga snga brnga bsnga bdun/ ca gca sko bca mo lca dpya spya drugacha mcha mo 'cha rki phya 'phya lnga/ ja bya gnyis/ rja brja sbya gsum/nya nywa mya gsum/ gnya mo mnya rki rnya snya brnya bsnya dmya rmya smyu dgu/ta gta mo bta sko rta lta sta brta blta bsta dgu/ tha mtha mo 'thamo gsum/ da dwa gnyis/ gad mo bad mo rda sda brda bsda drugamad sko 'ad sko lda blda zla bzla drug gan mo man sko rna sna brna 91

bsna snra ṇa brgyad/ pa spa lpa dpa ྾ bzhi/ pha 'pha ྾ gnyis/ rba sba gnyis/ 'ab ྾ lba gnyis/ rma sma dam dze gsum/ tsa gtsa྾btsacho྾ rtsa stsa brtsa rtswa bstsa brgyad/ tsha mtsha྾ 'tsha྾ tshwa bzhi/rdza brdza gnyis/ mdza྾ 'dza྾ gnyis/ zha gzha ྾ bzha ྾ zhwa bzhi/ za gza ྾ bza ྾ zwa bzhi/ g.ya ྾ dbya gnyis/ la lwa gnyis/ kla bkla gla bla rla sla bsla bdun/ sha shwa gsha ྾ bsha ྾bzhi/ sa gas ྾ bas ྾ sra bsra lnga/ ha hwa gnyis/ bcas sde tshan62bo la khyon yig 'bru218yod kyang / dngos su klog byed kyi sgra gdangs62ma gtogs med/yang de bzhin du lha sa'i skad kyi dbyangs la rjes 'jug zhugs pa'i sgra gdangs rmes kyang / ar ā gnyis/ ag ags gnyis/ ang angs gnyis/ ab abs gnyis/ am ams gnyis/ al a'i ad as bzhi/ an aṇa gnyis/ i id is ig igs lnga/ ib ibs gnyis/ im ims gnyis/ u ug ugs gsum/ ur u'u gnyis/ ung ungs gnyis/ ub ubs gnyis/ um ums gnyis/ ul u'i ud 92

bsna snra ṇa brgyad/ pa spa lpa dpa ra bzhi/ pha 'pha mo gnyis/ rba sba gnyis/ 'ab ma lba gnyis/ rma sma dam sko gsum/ tsa gtsa mo—btsa sko rtsa stsa brtsa rtswa bstsa brgyad/ tsha mtshasko 'tshamo tshwa bzhi/rdza brdza gnyis/ mdzasko 'dzarki gnyis/ zha gzha sko bzha sko zhwa bzhi/ za gza mo bza mo zwa bzhi/ g.ya sko dbya gnyis/ la lwa gnyis/ kla bkla gla bla rla sla bsla bdun/ sha shwa gsha rki bsha skobazhi/ sa gas sko bas rki sra bsra lnga/ ha hwa gnyis/ bcas sde tshan 62 bo la khyon yig 'bru218 yod kyang / dngos su khrog byed kyi sgra gdangs62 ma gtogs tsed/yang de bzhin du lha sa'i skad kyi dbyangs la rjes 'jug zhugs pa'i sgra gdangs rmes kyang / ar ā gnyis/ ag ags gnyis/ ang angs gnyis/ ab abs gnyis/ am ams gnyis/ al a'i ad as bzhi/ an aṇa gnyis/ i id is ig igs lnga/ ib ibs gnyis/ im ims gnyis/ u ug ugs gsum/ ur u'u gnyis/ ung ungs gnyis/ ub ubs gnyis/ um ums gnyis/ ul u'i ud 92

us bzhi/ e ed es eg egs lnga/ er el e'i e'e bzhi/ eng engs gnyis/ eb ebs gnyis/ em ems gnyis/ khro khrog khrogs gsum/ khro'o khror gnyis/ ong khrongs gnyis/ ob khrobs gnyis/ khrom oms gnyis/ o'i khrol ad as bzhi/ bcas sde tshan 51 po la khyon yig 'bru99 yod kyang /dngos su klog byed kyi sgra gdangs51 ma gtogs med la/ des na gong gi gsal byed kyi gdangs nyams pa'i sde tshan 62la dbyangs rten gyi sde tshan 51 po zhugs na khyon sgra nyams pa'i sde tshan 3162 yod la/ de la khyon bsdoms yig 'bru21582 yod cing / gtan nas klog mi thub pa'i yig 'bru 18420yod pa red/gzhan yang / lha sa'i skad kyis mgo 'dogs 'phul rten gyi sgra gdangs mi thon yang / rtags 'jug gi dgongs pa dang mthun par sgra mtho dman rmi sgo nas bod yig bod skad klog thub zer ba ni bden par mi gnas te/ rtags 'jug gi dgongs pa ni 'phul ming dbyangs rten mgo 'dogs dang 93

bcas pa'i sgra zur cung zad tsam yang ma nyams pa gzhir bzhag gi steng nas sgra'i drag zhan gyi dbye ba 'byed dgos pa la/ lha sa'i skad la ming gzhi'i sgra tsam ma gtogs brjod rgyu med pas na/ rtags 'jug gi dgongs pa dad ji ltar mthun/yang lha sa'i skad kyi gdangs mtho dman gyi nga ros yi ge so sor brjod thub zer ba yang zhib 'jug ma byas pa'i gtam du zad de/ dper na/ ki zhes pa'i sgra 'di la'ang /〈 lha sa'i kha skad 1ga deb //(89 mi rigs sha 15—20)las gsal ba ltar na/ de dang sgra gcig pa'am phyogs mtshungs pa'i yi ge ki dki bki rki shi ski brki bani kid kid dkid bkid rkid lkid k+kid baṭid bak+kid kis kis dkis bkis rkis k+kis k+kis brkis bzhis kig kig dkig bkis rkig lkig nig brkig bak+kig kigs kigs dkigs bkigs rkigs 4gas skegs brkigs bskegs bcas khyon zhe lnga 'byung la/de las yig 'bru bzhi ni lha sa'i skad la nga ro bzhi yod zer ba des ngos 'dzin thub pa'i dbang du btang yang / lhag ma 94

bcas pa'i sgra zur cung zad tsam yang ma nyams pa gzhir bzhag gi steng nas sgra'i drag zhan gyi dbye ba 'byed dgos pa la/ lha sa'i skad la ming gzhi'i sgra tsam ma gtogs brjod rgyu med pas na/ rtags 'jug gi dgongs pa dad ji ltar mthun/yang lha sa'i skad kyi gdangs mtho dman gyi nga ros yi ge so sor brjod thub zer ba yang zhib 'jug ma byas pa'i gtam du zad de/ dper na/ ‘‘ki’’zhes pa'i sgra 'di la'ang /〈 lha sa'i kha skad klog deb 〉(89mi rigs sha15—20)las gsal ba ltar na/ de dang sgra gcig pa'am phyogs mtshungs pa'i yi ge‘‘ki dki bki rki lki ski brki bski kid kid dkid bkid rkid lkid skid brkid bskid kis kis dkis bkis rkis lkis skis brkis bskis kig kig dkig bkis rkig lkig skig brkig bskig kigs kigs dkigs bkigs rkigs lkigs skigs brkigs bskigs’’bcas khyon zhe lnga 'byung la/de las yig 'bru bzhi ni lha sa'i skad la nga ro bzhi yod zer ba des ngos 'dzin thub pa'i dbang du btang yang / lhag ma 94

zhe gcig po la ngos 'dzin byed kyi sgra gdangs so so ba zhig gtan nas 'byung thub med do/ /khams skad la yang / 〈 khams skad kyi bod kyi skad yig gzhi rtsa'i slob deb 〉(87khrin tu sha93pha4)las gsal ba ltar du sdom rtsis byas na/ ming gzhi la 'phul dang mgo 'dogs zhugs ma zhugs kyi sgra gcig pa'i sde tshan49la yiga'abru215yod la/ dbyangs la rten zhugs ma zhugs kyi sgra gcig pa'i sde tshan28la yig 'bru84yod/ de ltar na/ sde tshan49po la sde tshan28po zhugs na/ khyon sgra gcig pa'i sde tshan1372yod cing / de la khyon bsdoms pas yig 'bru18060yod pa las/gtan las klog mi thub pa'i yig 'bru 16688yodado/ /a mdo'i skad ni de dag las ldab 'gyur gyis bzang ba yin te/ gsal byed las ka kwa gnyis/ dka྾ rka lka ska bzhi/brka bska gnyis/ rkya skya lca gsum/ brkya bskya gnyis/ dkra skra gnyis/ bkra pra bra gsum/ kha khwa gnyis/ dga' rga lga sga bzhi/brga bsga gnyis/ 'gra 'dra gnyis/ rnga lnga gnyis/ mcha྾ 'phya 95

zhe gci ga po la ngos 'dzin byed kyi sgra gdangs so so ba zhig gtan nas 'byung thub med do/ /khams skad la yang / 〈 khams skad kyi bod kyi skad yig gzhi rtsa'i slob deb /〉(87khrin tu sha93 pha 4)las gsal ba ltar du sdom rtsis byas na/ ming gzhi la 'phul dang mgo 'dogs zhug sa ma zhugs kyi sgra gcig pa'i sde tshan49la yig 'bru215yod la/ dbyangs la rten zhugs ma zhugs kyi sgra gcig pa'i sde tshan28 la yig 'bru84 yod/ de ltar na/ sde tshan 49 po la sde tshan 28 po zhugs na/ khyon sgra gcig pa'i sde tshan 1372yod cing / de la khyon bsdoms pas yig 'bru18060yod pa las/gtan las klog mi thub pa'i yig 'bru 16688yod do/ /a mdo'i skad ni de dag las ldab 'gyur gyis bzang ba yin te/ gsal byed las ka kwa gnyis/ dka ra rka lka ska bzhi/brka bska gnyis/ rkya skya lca gsum/ brkya bskya gnyis/ dkra skra gnyis/ bkra pra bra gsum/ kha khā gnyis/ dga' rga be+e sga bzhi/brga bsga gnyis/ 'gra 'dra gnyis/ rnga lnga gnyis/ mcha mo 'phya 95

gnyis/ ca ja kya gya bzhi/ brgya brja sbya gsum/ mja ma mgya 'bya gsum/ nya pho gnyis/ rta lta sta gsum/ brta blta bsta gsum/ da dwa gnyis/ rda lda sda gsum/ brda blda bsda bzla bzhi/spa lnga gnyis/ rba lba sba gsum/ rtsa stsa gnyis/ brtsa bstsa gnyis/tsha tshwa gnyis/ zha zhwa gnyis/ g.ya mo dbya gnyis/ la lwa gnyis/kla gla gnyis/ sha shwa gnyis /bcas sgra gcig pa'i sde tshan 37la khyon yig 'bru91yod cing // dbyangs rten las/ ag ags gnyis/ ang angs gnyis/ ab abs gnyis/ am ams gnyis/ ig igs gnyis/ ug ugs gnyis/ ing ings gnyis/ ib ibs gnyis/ im ims gnyis/ ung ungs gnyis/ ub ubs gnyis/ eg egs gnyis/ eng engs gnyis/ eb ebs gnyis/ em ems gnyis/ og ogs gnyis/ ong ongs gnyis/ ob khrobs gnyis/ om oms gnyis/ bcas sde tshan 19la yig 'bru38yod la/ de ltar na/ sde tshan37po la sde tshan 19bo zhugs na/ khyon sgra gcig pa'i sde tshan703yod 96

gnyis/ ca ja kya gya bzhi/ brgya baja sbya gsum/ mja྾ mgya 'bya gsum/ nya nywa gnyis/ rta lta sta gsum/ brta blta bsta gsum/ da dwa gnyis/ rda lda sda gsum/ brda blda bsda bzla bzhi/spa lpa gnyis/ rba lba sba gsum/ rtsa stsa gnyis/ brtsa bstsa gnyis/tsha tshwa gnyis/ zha zhwa gnyis/ g.ya ྾ dbya gnyis/ la lwa gnyis/kla gla gnyis/ sha shwa gnyis’’/bcas sgra gcig pa'i sde tshan37la khyon yig 'bru91yod cing // dbyangs rten las/ ‘‘ag ags gnyis/ ang angs gnyis/ ab abs gnyis/ am ams gnyis/ ig igs gnyis/ ug ugs gnyis/ ing ings gnyi sa/ ib ibs gnyis/ im ims gnyis/ ung ungs gnyis/ ub ubs gnyis/ eg egs gnyis/ eng engs gnyis/ eb ebs gnyis/ em ems gnyis/ og ogs gnyis/ ong ongs gnyis/ ob obs gnyis/ om oms gnyis/’’bcas sde tshan19la yig 'bru38yod la/ de ltar na/ sde tshan37po la sde tshan19bo zhugs na/ khyon sgra gcig pa'i sde tshan703yod 96

cing / de la bsdoms pas yig 'bru3458yod pa las/ gtan nas klog mi thub pa'i yig 'bru2755tsam yod//des na de dag tshe tan zhabs drung gis brtsams pa'i〈 gangs can sgra rig le tshan phyogs bsdus 〉(55mtsho sngon33pha1)las/ ‘bod yig la bklag tu rung ba'i yi ge chig khri bdun stong lnga brgya so gnyis 'byung /’’zhes pa de rtsis gzhir byas nas bsdur na/ lha sa'i skad kyis sgra gdangs phal cher dag par mi thon la/ khams skad kyis kyang mang po zhig dag par mi thon/ 'on kyang / am skad kyis mang shos dag par thon gyin 'dug pas na/ am skad de sgra gdangs kyi thad nas lha sa'i skad las ldab 'gyur gyis bzang ba yin no/ / gsum/ bzang zhan blang dor byas nas bod kyi spyi skad 'jog tshul/nga tshos gong gsal du shes pa ltar/ lha sa'i skad kyi tshig sbyor de/ pas dang / tsang / yas/ na'i/ ga'i/ yo'o/ gag 97

cing / de la bsdoms pas yig 'bru3458yod pa las/ gtan nas klog mi thub pa'i yig 'bru2755 tsam yod//des na de dag tshe tan zhabs drung gis brtsams pa'i〈 gangs can sgra rig le tshan phyogs bsdus 〉(55mtsho sngon 33pha 1)las/ bod yig la bklag tu rung ba'i yi ge chig khri bdun stong lnga brgya so gnyis 'byung / zhes pa de rtsis gzhir byas nas bsdur na/ lha sa'i skad kyis sgra gdangs phal cher dag par mi thon la/ khams skad kyis kyang mang po zhig dag par mi thon/ 'on kyang / am skad kyis mang shos dag par jon gyin 'dug pas na/ am skad de sgra gdangs kyi thad nas lha sa'i skad las ldab 'gyur gyis bzang ba yin no/ / gsum/ bzang zhan blang dor byas nas bod kyi spyi skad 'jog tshul/nga tshos gong gsal du shes pa ltar/ lha sa'i skad kyi tshig sbyor de/ pas dang / tsang / yas/ na'i/ ga'i/ yo'o/ gag 97

sogs kyi tshig sgros 'ga' re ma gtogs/ tshig sbyor thams cad bod kyi bkas bcad rim pa'i rjes chod de bod kyi yig skad kyi tshig sbyor dang ha cang mthun po 'dug pas/ tshig sbyor gyi thad nas bshad na/ lha sa'i skad de bod kyi spyi skad du bzhag na 'grig snyam/ 'on kyang / yang lha sa'i skad kyis bod yig gi sgra phal che ba dag par thon gyin med pas na/ sgra gdangs kyi thad nas de bod kyi spyi skad du bzhag na 'grig gi med par sems so/ /de bzhin du khams skad kyang de dang 'dra bas spyi skad du mi rung ngo / / 'o na a mdo'i skad de bod kyi spyi skad la 'os sam zhe na/a mdo'i skad kyis phal cher bod yig gi yig 'bru mang che ba'i sgra dag par bklag thub pas/ sgra gdangs kyi thad nas brtag na am skad 'di bod kyi spyi skad du bzhag chog snyam zhing / yang a mdo'i skad cha'i nang du kha skad kyi tshig sgros mang ba dang / la don dang byed 'brel/ 'byed sdud/ rgyan sdud sogs kyi thob thang gzhung dang mi mthun pa/ mye myi myed sogs pyi8

sogs kyi tshig sgos 'ga' re ma gtogs/ tshig sbyor thams cad bod kyi bkas bcad rim pa'i rjes chod de bod kyi yig skad kyi tshig sbyor dang ha cang mthun po 'dug pas/ tshig sbyor gyi thad nas bshad na/ lha sa'i skad de bod kyi spyi skad du bzhag na 'grig snyam/ 'on kyang / yang lha sa'i skad kyis bod yig gi sgra phal che ba dag par thon gyin med pas na/ sgra gdangs kyi thad nas de bod kyi spyi skad du bzhag na 'greg gi med par sems so/ /de bzhin du khams skad kyang de dang 'dra bas spyi skad du mi rung ngo / / 'o na a mdo'i skad de bod kyi spyi skad la 'os sam zhe na/a mdo'i skad kyis phal cher bod yig gi yig 'bru mang che ba'i sgra dag par bklag thub pas/ sgra gdangs kyi thad nas brtag na am skad 'di bod kyi spyo skad du bzhag chog snyam zhing / yang a mdo'i skad cha'i nang du kha skad kyi tshig sgros mang ba dang / la don dang byed 'byel/ 'byed sdud/ rgyan sdud sogs kyi thob thang gzhung dang mi mthun pa/ bye rmya myed sogs pyi8

sogs kyi tshig sgros 'ga' re ma gtogs/ tshig sbyor thams cad bod kyi bkas bcad rim pa'i rjes chod de bod kyi yig skad kyi tshig sbyor dang ha cang mthun po 'dug pas/ tshig sbyor gyi thad nas bshad na/ lha sa'i skad de bod kyi spyi skad du bzhag na 'grig snyam/ 'on kyang / yang lha sa'i skad kyis bod yig gi sgra phal che ba dag par thon gyin med pas na/ sgra gdangs kyi thad nas de bod kyi spyi skad du bzhag na 'grig gi med par sems so/ /de bzhin du khams skad kyang de dang 'dra bas spyi skad du mi rung ngo / / 'o na a mdo'i skad de bod kyi spyi skad la 'os sam zhe na/a mdo'i skad kyis phal cher bod yig gi yig 'bru mang che ba'i sgra dag par bklag thub pas/ sgra gdangs kyi thad nas brtag na am skad 'di bod kyi spyi skad du bzhag chog snyam zhing / yang a mdo'i skad cha'i nang du kha skad kyi tshig sgros mang ba dang / la don dang byed 'brel/ 'byed sdud/ rgyan sdud sogs kyi thob thang gzhung dang mi mthun pa/ mye myi myed sogs pyi8

bkas bcad rim pa'i rjes chod med pa sogs bod kyi yig skad kyi tshig spyor dang thag ha cang ring ba la bltas na/ a mdo'i skad kyi tshig spyor 'di bod kyi spyi skad du 'jog mi rigs par 'dod do/ / 'o na bod kyi spyi skad ji ltar 'jog ce na/ 'di ltar 'jog ste/ lha sa'i tshig sbyor de yig skad dang mthun pas blang la lha sa'i sgra gdangs de spra mi dag pas dor/ a mdo'i sgra gdangs de brjod dag pas blang la a mdo'i tshig sbyor de yig skad dang mi mthun pas dor rjes/ lha sa'i tshig sbyor dang a mdo'i sgra gdangs gnyis las grub pa'i skad cha de bod gangs can gyi spyo skad du 'jog dgos pa yin no/ /de ltar bzhag na/ lha sa dang a mdo gnyis la cig shos kyi tshig dang cig shos kyi gdangs blangs pas bsam 'char cher 'byung mi thub la/ khams pa la lha sa dang a mdo gnyis ka'i skad cha'i khyad chos dang ldan phyir rjes su yi rangs par nges pas na/ 'di ni bod kyi spyi skad gtan 'be+ebs byed pa'i 99

bkas bcad rim pa'i rjes chod med pa sogs bod kyi yig skad kyi tshig sbyor dang thag ha cang ring ba la bltas na/ a mdo'i skad kyi tshig sbyor 'di bod kyi spyi skad du 'jog mi rigs par 'dod do/ / 'o na bod kyi spyi skad ji ltar 'jog ce na/ 'di ltar 'jog ste/ lha sa'i tshig sbyor de yig skad dang mthun pas blang la lha sa'i sgra gdangs de smra mi dag pas dor/ a mdo'i sgra gdangs de brjod dag pas blang la a mdo'i tshig sbyor de yig skad dang mi mthun pas dor rjes/ lha sa'i tshig sbyor dang a mdo'i sgra gdangs gnyis las grub pa'i skad cha de bod gangs can gyi spyi skad du 'jog dgos pa yin no/ /de ltar bzhag na/ lha sa dang a mdo gnyis la cig shos kyi tshig dang cig shos kyi gdangs blangs pas bsam 'char cher 'byung mi thub la/ khams pa la lha sa dang a mdo gnyis ka'i skad cha'i khyad chos dang ldan phyir rjes su yi rangs par nges pas na/ 'di ni bod kyi spyi skad gtan 'be+ebs byed pa'i 99

thabs lam nyag gcig pu'ang yin nges snyam mo/ /des na/ lha sa'i skad la lob pa'i tshig sbyor dang / /a mdo'i ngag la byung ba'i sgra gdangs gnyis/ /khams pa'i kha nas sdeb sbyor legs bsgrigs nas/ /gangs can bod kyi spyi skad byed par 'tshal/ /ces kyang smon no / /(dpyad rtsom 'di1998lo'i〈 rtser snyeg /〉deb dang bo'i steng du bkod pa ltar drangs pa'o//)

thabs lam nyag gcig pu'ang yin nges snyam mo/ /des na/ lha sa'i skad la lob pa'i tshig sbyor dang / /a mdo'i ngag la byung ba'i sgra gdangs gnyis/ /khams pa'i kha nas sdeb sbyor legs bsgrigs nas/ /gangs can bod kyi spyi skad byed par 'tshal/ /ces kyang smon no/ /(dpyad rtsom 'di1998lo'i〈 rtser snyeg〉deb dang bo'i steng du bkod pa ltar drangs pa'o//) 100

༄༅ / /rma rgyab tsho drug gi lo rgyus rags bsdus mes po'i zhal lung zhes bya ba/spra dang zag khyan dag la mched pa ye/ /snga rabs mes po'i zhabs la gus btud nas/ /rma rgyab bod kyi lha sgo tsho drug gi/byung rabs mes po'i zhal lung bri bar bya/ /de yang rma rgyab tsho drug ces pa 'di ni/ spyir reb gong rong bo blon chos nas chad pa yin la/ snga rabs pa dag gis/sgog la ra lag gsum yod// blon chos chad stangs gsum yin//mchar ru mchar long drug yod//sha sbrang tsho ba drug yin//ske dkris tshigs dkris bco brgyad// 101

༄༅ / /rma rgyab tsho drug gi lo rgyus rags bsdus mes po'i zhal lung zhes bya ba/spra dang brag srin dag la mched pa yi//snga rabs mes po'i zhabs la gus btud nas//rma rgyab bod kyi lha spre tsho drug gi/byung rabs mes po'i zhal lung bri bar bya/ /de yang rma rgyab tsho drug ces pa 'di ni/ spyir reb gong rong bo blon chos nas chad pa yin la/ snga rabs pa dag gis/sgrog la ra lag gsum yod// blon chos chad stangs gsum yin//mchar ru mchar long drug yod//sha sbrang tsho ba drug yin//ske dkris tshigs dkris bco brgyad// 101

bong stag tsho chen bco brgyad//dkyil gyi mdud pa gcig po// rgya bza'i ta min ching hu(chaṭha)// zhes rang rigs kyi brgyud pa'i grol tshul gyes lugs de rta'i sgrog la dpe blangs nas phyi rabs pa la ngag rgyun du bzhag pa ltar/ rang 'e lha sde tsho drug 'di ni sgrog la ra lag gsum yod pa'i blon chos chad stangasahogasum nas chad pa yin/chad stangs gsum po ni‘‘rta bo dme tshang sgur ru gsum/ /lo ba rgya bza' dme glang gsum/ /bal bza' skya ra sngags sa gsum/ /’’zhes pa dag yin la/ chad stangs gsum po de/ ‘‘sgar ba/ dme tshang / lo ba/ rgya bza'/ 'ba'/ rta bor/ bal bza'/sngags sa/ skya ra/ gyang dmar/ bong stag tsho chen bco brgyad/spyi nyin lung tsho chen drug bcas la blon chos chad stangs gsum ’zhes kyang bgrang bar gsungs so//rma rgyab tsho drug gi ming thogs tshul ni/ bod gangs can gyi gnas mchog dam pa ri a mye rma rgyal gyi rgyab rol na/ bod 102

bong stag tsho chen bco brgyad //dkyil gye mdud pa gcig po// rgya bza'i ta min ching hu( ṣ+peṭha)// zhes rang rigs kyi brgyud pa'i grol tshul gyes lugs de rta'i sgog la dpe blangs nas phyi rabs pa la ngag rgyun du bzhag pa ltar/ rang 'e lha sde tsho drug 'di ni sgrog la ra lag gsum yod pa'i blon chos chad stangs gsum nas chad pa yin/chad stangs gsum po ni rta bo dme tshang sgur ru gsum/ /lo ba rgya bza' dme glang gsum/ /bal bza' skya ra sngags sa gsum/ / zhes pa dag yin la/ chad stangs gsum po de/ sgar ba/ daske tshang / lo ba/ rgya bza'/ 'ba'/ rta bor/ bal bza'/sngags sa/ skya ra/ gyang dmar/ bong stag tsho chen bco brgyad/spyi nyin lung tsho chen drug bcas la blon chos chad stangs gsum zhes kyang bgrang bar gsungs so/ /rma rgyab tsho drug gi ming thogs tshul ni/ bod gangs can gyi gnas mchog dam pa ri a bye rma rgyal gyi rgyab rol na/ bod 102

sde tsho ba drug chags yod pas na rma rgyab tsho drug ces ming thogs pa yin la/ da lta mtsho sngon zhing chen mgo log khul rma chen rdzong gangs ri zhang dang rta bo zhol ma zhang du gnas yod/de la sgur ru brtsis pas tsho ba drug yod pas na sgur ru tsho drug ces dang / yang na rong bo blon chos chad stangs gsum las chad stangs gcig gi sde rgan chen po sgur ru gtso byas pas tsho ba drug yod pas na sgur ru tsho drug ces kyang zer ro//rma rgyab kyi tsho bo drug po ni/ dang po 'ba' go na gnyis/gnyis pa bu mang / gsum pa mkhar/ bzhi ba 'od dpal/ lnga ba gros/ drug pa sgur ru dang rong bo bcas yin te/ rgan rabs pa'i ngag rgyun du'ang 'ba' bu mang / mkhar 'od dpal/ gros sgur ru/ zhes pa'i go rim ngag la bde bo zhig kyang chags yod ces bu mang chos 'phel dang sgur ru sngags pa gnyis zhal mthun par gsungs/de yang ha lam bod rab byung bco lnga ba'i nang du sgur ru bla ma gsang los ka tsha'i mdo nas sgur ru dgon a ti dar 103

sde tsho ba drug chags yod pas na rma rgyab tsho drug ces ming thogs pa yin la/ da lta mtsho sngon zhing chen mgo log khul rma chen rdzong gangs ri zhang dang rta bo zhol ma zhang du gnas yod/de la sgur ru brtsis pas tsho ba drug/ yod pas na sgur ru tsho drug ces dang / yang na rong bo blon chos chad stangs gsum las chad stangs gcig gi sde rgan chen po sgur ru gtso byas pas tsho ba drug yod pas na sgur ru tsho drug ces kyang zer ro//rma rgyab kyi tsho bo drug po ni/ dang po 'ba' go na gnyis/gnyis pa bu mang / gsum pa mkhar/ bzhi ba 'od dpal/ lnga ba gros/ drug pa sgur ru dang rong bo bcas yin te/ rgan rabs pa'i ngag rgyun du'ang‘‘'ba' bu mang / mkhar 'od dpal/ gros sgur ru/’’zhes pa'i go rim ngag la bde bo zhig kyang chags yod ces bu mang chos 'phel dang sgur ru sngags pa gnyis zhal mthun par gsungs/de yang ha lam bod rab byung bco lnga ba'i nang du sgur ru bla ma gsang los ka tsha'i mdo nas sgur ru dgon a ti dar 103

rgyas gling btab ste sgur ru'i sde sne tsho drug gi nang du zin pa dang / bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i nang du gros tshang rma 'dabs su thon pa nas bzung / da gzod tsho ba drug gi ming thogs pa yin la/ de'i sngon du da rung tsho ba drug gi ming thogs med par grags so/ / dang po/ 'ba' tsho ba'i lo rgyus rags bsdus/de yapre 'ba' tsho ba 'di ni/ thog mar bod kyi rus chen sga 'bru sbra ldong bzhi las phu bo ldong gi rigs las mched cing /ldong la dkar bo ldong dang / nag po ldong / khra bo ldong / smug po ldong sogs dang / yang ldong la ldong gi nga chen bco brgyad/ldong gi tsha chen bco brgyad/ ldong gi shul chen bco brgyad sogs mang du gyes pa las/ ldong gi shul chen bco brgyad ni/sman shul/ yul shul/ bdud shul/ rag shul/ phan shul/ chos shul/ ban shul/ mgon shul/ phyag shul/ dpal shul/ chu shul/ri shul/ nyan shul/ khyi shul/ lo shul/ 'go shul/ yab shul/ rta 104

rgyas gling btab ste sgur ru'i sde ste tsho drug gi nang du zin pa dang / bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i nang du gros tshang rma 'dabs su thon pa nas bzung / da gzod tsho ba drug gi ming thogs pa yin la/ de'i sngon du da rung tsho ba drug gi ming thogs rnged par grags so/ /dang po/ 'ba' tsho ba'i lo rgyus rags bsdus/ de yang 'ba' tsho ba 'di ni/ thog mar bod kyi rus chen sga 'bru sbra ldong bzhi las phu bo ldong gi rigs las mched cing /ldong la dkar bo ldong dang / nag po ldong / khra bo ldong / smug po ldong sogs dang / yang ldong la ldong gi nga chen bco brgyad/ldo nga gi tsha chen bco brgyad/ ldong gi shul chen bco brgyad sogs mang du gyes pa las/ ldong gi shul chen bco brgyad ni/sman shul/ yul shul/ bdud shul/ rag shul/ phan shul/ chos shul/ ban shul/ mgon shul/ phyag shul/ dpal shul/ chu shul /ri shul/ nyan shul/ khye shul/ lo shul/ 'go shul/ yab shul/ rta 104

shul bcas te/ 'ba' tsho ba 'di dkar bo ldong gi shul chen bco brgyad kyi dpal shul la chad par gsungs //de yang ldong dpal se skyabs kyi sku ring nas khams phyogs su song ste gzhi bzung bas/ ldong dpal se skyabs kyi shul thogs pa la ldong dpal shul du thogs/ ('dir da dung dpyad dgos snyam/)de'i sras ldong skya sang rdo rje la sras ldong skyabs se 'ba' rdor dang / de la sras ldong skyabs se 'ba' lo 'khrungs/ 'ba' rdor dang 'ba' lo gnyis kyis khams li thang gi phyogs nas gnas gzhi yun ring du bzung bar brten/yab mes dam pa 'di gnyis kyi mtshan sde ming yul ming du chags te/ 'ba' gzhung dang / 'ba' sde/ 'ba' tsho ba zhes rus ming dang / 'ba' thang dang / 'ba' li thang zhes sa ming yul ming du thogs par grags so/ / ldong dpal se skyabs nas mi rabs bcu gcig pa 'ba' rdo rje a skyabs kyi sku ring la/ 'ba' rdo rje a skyabs khong dgung lo zhe lnga'i steng yul reb gong gser mo ljongs kyi rta bo 105

shul bcas te/ 'ba' tsho ba 'di dkar bo ldong gi shul chen bco brgyad kyi dpal shul la chad par gsungs //de yang ldong dpal se skyabs kyi sku ring nas khams phyogs su song ste gzhi bzung bas/ ldong dpal se skyabs kyi shul thogs pa la ldong dpal shul du thogs/ ('dir da dung dpyad dgos snyam/)de'i sras ldong skya sang rdo rje la sras ldong skyabs se 'ba' rdor dang / de la sras ldong skyabs se 'ba' lo 'khrungs/ 'ba' rdor dang 'ba' lo gnyis kyis khams li thang gi phyogs nas gnas gzhi yun ring du bzung bar brten/yab mes dam pa 'di gnyis kyi mtshan sde ming yul ming du chags te/ 'ba' gzhung dang / 'ba' sde/ 'ba' tsho ba zhes rus ming dang / 'ba' thang dang / 'ba' li thang zhes sa ming yul ming du thogs par grags so/ / ldong dpal se skyabs nas mi rabs bcu gcig pa 'ba' rdo rje a skyabs kyi sku ring la/ 'ba' rdo rje a skyabs khong dgung lo zhe lnga'i steng yul reb gong gser mo ljongs kyi rta bo 105

shul bcas te/ 'ba' tsho ba 'di dkar bo ldong gi shul chen bco brgyad kyi dpal shul la chad par gsungs / /de yang ldong dpal se skyabs kyi sku ring nas khams phyogs su song ste gzhi bzung bas/ ldong dpal se skyabs kyi shul thogs pa la ldong dpal shul du jogs/ ('dir da dung dpyad dgos snyam/)de'i sras ldong skya sang rdo rje la sras sdong skyabs se 'ba' rdor dang / de la sras ldong skyabs se 'ba' lo 'khrungs/ 'ba' rdor dang 'ba' lo gnyis kyis khams li thang gi phyogs nas gnas gzhi yun ring du bzung bar brten/ yab mes dam pa 'di gnyis kyi mtshan sde ming yul ming du chags te/ 'ba' gzhung dang / 'ba' sde/ 'ba' tsho ba zhes rus ming dang / 'ba' thang dang / 'ba' li thang zhes sa ming yul ming du thogs par grags so/ / ldong dpal se skyabs nas mi rabs bcu gcig pa 'ab 'a rdo rje a skyabs kyi sku ring la/ 'ba' rdo rje a skyabs khong dgung lo zhe lnga'i steng yul reb gong gser mo ljongs kyi rta bo 105

sde ba'i nang du 'ong nas rta bo'i bu mo 'jam dbyangs 'tsho dang gnyen bsdebs te sras 'ba' lha skyabs rdo rje mgon 'khrungs/ 'ba' lha skyabs rdo rje mgon gyi rigs rgyud rnams 'ba' mang ra'i 'ba' thang chen por gnas gzhi yun ring du chags par brten/ 'di nas kyang rus ming yul la thogs te/'ba' thang dang / 'ba' gzhung / 'a ba' khyag 'ba' chu/'ba' stod/ 'ba' mang ra sogs su grags/ ngag rgyun du/ stod du mang 'ba' zha gsum/ /smad du 'ba' rta bor dme tshang gsum/ / zhes pa dang / 'ba' le thang 'ba' gi mes po'i sa/ /'ba' mang ra 'ba' gi tsha bo'i sa/ / zhes grags pa sogs 'byung la/ yang rong bo tshe ring rgyal gyis/ sgar ba/dme tshang / lo ba/ rgya bza'/ 'ba'/ rta bor/ bal bza'/sngags sa/ skya ra/ gyang dmar/ bong stag tsho chen bco brgyad/spyi nyin lung tsho chen drug bcas la blon chos chad stangs gsum zhes grags/ zhes gsungs pa la bltas na/ 'ba' rdo rje a skyabs blon chos su phebs rjes/ 'ba' tsho ba de blon 106

sde ba'i nang du 'ong nas rta bo'i bu mo 'jam dbyangs 'tsho dang gnyen bsdebs te sras 'ba' lha skyabs rdo rje mgon 'khrungs/ 'ba' lha skyabs rdo rje mgon gyi rigs rgyud rnams 'ba' mang ra'i 'ba' thang chen por gnas gzhi yun ring du chags par brten/ 'di nas kyang rus ming yul la thogs te/'ba' thang dang / 'ba' gzhung / 'ba' khug 'ba' chu/'ba' stod/ 'ba' mang ra sogs su grags/ ngag rgyun du/ ‘‘stod du mang 'ba' zha gsum/ /smad du 'ba' rta bor dme tshang gsum/ /’rizhes pa dang / ‘‘'ba' li thang 'ba' gi mes po'i sa/ /'ba' mang ra 'ba' gi tsha bo'i sa/ /’’zhes grags pa sogs 'byung la/ yang rong bo tshe ring rgyal gyis/ ‘‘sgar ba/dme tshang / lo ba/ rgya bza'/ 'ba'/ rta bor/ bal bza'/sngags sa/ skya ra/ gyang dmar/ bong stag tsho chen bco brgyad/spyi nyin lung tsho chen drug bcas la blon chos chad stangs gsum zhes grags/’’zhes gsungs pa la bltas na/ 'ba' rdo rje a skyabs blon chos su phebs rjes/ 'ba' tsho ba de blon 106

chos chad stangs gsum gye gras su brtsi srol yod par gda' 'o snyam mo/ / yang 'ba' rdo rje a skyabs nas zam ma chad pa'i mi rabs dgu ba 'ba' rnam rgyal tshe ring sogs kyi sku ring la/ snga phyi thengs gsum byas te/ rong bo'i blon chos nas rma 'dabs su chas par bshad/ yin na'ang / rong bo blon chos nas rma 'dabs su chas pa'i lam bar du lo mang po 'gor te/rma rgyal gyi 'dabs 'dir thon dus rma pha rol kha ja bu lnga zer ba zhig gi brgyud pa yin par grags la/ kha ja bu lnga zer don ni kha ja sde ba'i mag pa 'ba' tshe mkhar ring mo zer ba la bu lnga 'khrungs par kha ja bu lnga'am tshe mkhar bu lnga zer/ bu lnga bo ni che ba 'ba' rko ring dang / gnyis pa 'ba' bon skyabs/gsum pa'i ming ma shes/ bzhi ba 'ba' sman pa dang / lnga ba 'ba' 'jam dbyangs bcas yin/ 'ba' rko ring dang bon skyabs gnyis kyis kha ja sde bar mi gyod bzos te thog mar rma 'dabs su phebs la/ bu spun gzhan gsum pos gyod bshad 107

chos chad stangs gsum gyi gras su brtsi srol yod par gda' 'o snyam mo/ / yang 'ba' rdo rje a skyabs nas zam ma chad pa'i mi rabs dgu ba 'ba' rnam rgyal tshe ring sogs kyi sku ring la/ snga phyi thengs gsum byas te/ rong bo'i blon chos nas rma 'dabs su chas par bshad/ yin na'ang / rong bo blon chos nas rma 'dabs su chas pa'i lam bar du lo mang po 'gor te/rma rgyal gyi 'dabs 'dir thon dus rma pha rol kha ja bu lnga zer ba zhig gi brgyud pa yin par grags la/ kha ja bu lnga zer don ni kha ja sde ba'i mag pa 'ba' tshe mkhar ring mo zer ba la bu lnga 'khrungs par kha ja bu lnga'am tshe mkhar bu lnga zer/ bu lnga bo ni che ba 'ba' rko ring dang / gnyis pa 'ba' bon skyabs/gsum pa'i ming ma shes/ bzhi ba 'ba' sman pa dang / lnga ba 'ba' 'jam dbyangs bcas yin/ 'ba' rko ring dang bon skyabs gnyis kyis kha ja sde bar mi gyod bzos te thog mar rma 'dabs su phebs la/ bu spun gzhan gsum pos gyod bshad 107

cing ming mi shes pa'i spun 'bring ba de'i thugs bkod ltar kho rang nyid sme rol tu byin nas gyod 'greg par byas/ lo shas kyi rjes nas khos phu bo gnyis blos ma jongs par nu bo gnyis kyang phu bo gnyis kyi rjes su 'gro ru bcug nu bo 'ba' sman dang 'ba' 'jam gnyis rma 'dabs 'dir thon dus ming la 'ba' chom tshang sman pa dang 'ba' chom tshang 'jam dbyangs zer ba zhig thogs nas yong bar skad do/ /rma 'dabs 'dir thon rjes/ 'ba' tshang la mi rabs bdun la dpon rabs bzhi song ba ste mi rabs gnyis pa nas dpon rabs dang po byung / dpon rabs dang po 'ba' rko ring yin la/ dpon rabs gnyis pa ni rko ring gi bu 'ba' dge slong dang bon skyabs kyi bu 'ba' ban de gnyis yin te/ dpon thob dge slong la yod kyang dbang thang ban de la mtho zhes kyang zer/ phyi rabs pa tshos a bye 'ba' ban 'ba' dge tshang mkhyen/ zhes 'jigs skrag byung dus 'bod yul zhig tu gyur yod par yang bshad/ dpon rabs gsum 108

pa be+e 'a ba' sman pa'i bu rin chen gyi sras 'ba' dbyangs 'bum yin la/ dpon rabs bzhi ba ni rko ring gi bu mo che ba'i bu 'ba' kun ris yin/ bcings grol byas rjes 'ba' kun ris kyis gangs ri zhang(chu'u)gi chu'u krang gzhon pa'i 'gan bzhes la/ skabs der 'ba' tshang la khyim grangs zhe gcig dang mi grangs brgya dang zhe bzhi yod par bshad do/ /go na ni spyir rong bo blon chos nas chad cing ka ring dang a tshogs sogs kyi yul mang du brgyud mthar tsho skor nyung shas re rma rgyal gyi 'dabs su thon pa red/ go na'i ngag rgyun du/ 'ba' tshang gser mo ljongs nas chad/ go na ka ring khog nas chad/ sogs zer la/ rma 'dabs 'dir thon kha mar a tshogs sa nas yar yong bar nges te/ a tshogs byang sems zer ba zhig rma 'dabs la yong nas go na'i nye 'byel rnams la 'byel gtugs mang du byed myong zer/ smad phyogs nas go na la go na'i sde rgan zhig yod par ma zad/ go na'i dgon pa'ang yod la/ dpa' bo dang mkhas pa/ bla ma dang dpon 109

po'ang 'byung myong ba ni tsho sde gzhan dag gi lo rgyus bris yod pa'i nang du'ang sa gnam la phyar3 gser lhang la 'bud pa/ ltar mngon sum du grub bzhin pa de rang lags/ rma 'dabs su thon rjes/ 'asa' go na gnyis la sha nye 'byel gyi 'byel ba med kyang gnyen nye 'byel gyi 'brel ba zab la nang shin tu mthun pas/ khral mgo stong mgo dang sde mgo dpon mgo gcig ste tsho ba drug gi tsho mgo gcig tu gyur pa red/ /go na'i rgad po tshos yar 'ded thub tshod kyis mi rabs drug la thug pa ste/ mi rabs dang po ni go na'i lha ba cog ge'am lha ba cog zer ba de red/ mi rabs gnyis pa ni go na'i lha ba cog gi bu go na'i lha mgon bu spun dag red/ mi rabs gsum pa ni go na'i chig ris bu spun dang / go na'i seng dung ming sring / go na'i bsod dar ming sring rnams yin la/ mi rabs bzhi ba ni go na'i rang grol ming sring dang / go na'i lung rigs ming sreng / go na'i dbang rdor ming sring / go na'i ban kho ming sring / go na'i snying rje ming sring / go na'i 110

rdor tshe ming sring sogs yin/ mi rabs lnga ba dang drug pa shin tu gsal ba ste zhib par 'ba' don grub rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i〈 'ba' go na'i rus mdzod //la khongs gtugs par mdzod cig / des na ngag rgyun du/ 'ba' tsho ba'i 'ba' khongs ma shes na/ /'ba' dang bo dkar bo ldong la chad/ /'ba' bar ma li thang khams la chad/ /'ba' tha ma gser mo ljongs la chad/ / ces pa dang / ‘'ba' tshang ma chad 'ba' tshang chad/ /'ba' tshang gser mo ljongs la chad/ /go na ma chad go na chad/ /go na ka ring khog nas chad/ / ces sogs su grags pa ni legs bshad rma med du snang ngo // //gnyis pa/ bu mang tsho ba'i lo byus rags bsdus/ de yang rma rgyab tsho drug gi nang du phebs pa'i bu mang tsho ba 'di ni/ spyir rong bo blon chos chad stangs gsum gyi chad stangs gcig ste/ rta bo dme tshang sgur ru gsum/ zhes pa'i 111

dme tshang tsho ba nas chad pa yin la/ dme tshang zhes pa ni sngon rong bo blon chos na yod dus/ sgar ba'i rdo rje khro nag ces pa sku mdog nag la lus spus gang ba/ seng ge'i mgo la spyan rtsa dmar ba/ khros tshe kha nas khrag 'byung ba/ so sgra ldir cing ngar skad can/ g.yul la zhugs tshe mgo la zhwa mi gon pa/ rkang la lham mi gon pa/ sku stod dmar lha nga nger 'thab sar 'gro ba'i dpa' rgod thog 'dra ba zhig yod pa des/ rong bo nang so'i rje 'bangs kyi don du khri ka'i rgya sog gi jag pas nyen tshe g.yul la chas te phar dgra bo'i dpung la khrag gi 'khor lo bskor nas ming gi lha ga mar bskrad cing‘‘rdo rje khro nag mi yi spyang ki 'dra’’zhes pa'i mtshan snyan yongs su grags/ de nas bzung blon chos sgar ba'i rdo rje khro nag gi khyim de la rdo rje dme bo tshang dang khro nag dme bo tshang zhes 'bod pa de tshig bsdus nas dme tshang dme tshang zhes yongs khyab tu song ba yin no/ / dme tshang bu mang zhes pa ni rdo rje khro nag dme bo tshang 112

nas brgyud pa'i dme tshang zla ba rgya mtsho la‘ gnam na skar ma smin drug sa na dme tshang bu drug ces pa'i bu drug 'khrungs pa'i che ba rab brtan/ lha mkhar don 'grub/ g.yung drung rgyal/ thar lo/ dbang chen thar/ a pa rgya ma ma rnams te/ khong rnams ni sa dgu stod du yong ba'i darnge tshang bu drug tu grags pa rnams yin/ de las darnge tshang lha mkhar don 'grub la bu bu mo nyi shu las bu bcu gcig 'khrungs pas dme tshang lha mkhar don 'grub bu mang tshang zhes grags pa la tshig bsdus nas darnge tshang lha tho bu mang tshang zhes pa dang / dme tshang bu mang tshang dang / rjes nas bu mang tshang zhes dar khyab tu song ba yin no/ /dme tshang lha mkhar don 'grub kyi bu bcu gcig po ni/ dang bo bu mang blo brtan/ gnyis pa bu mang rgyal mo tshe ring / gsum pa bu mang tshe brtan rgyal/ bzhi ba bu mang slob sems/ lnga ba bu mang dpal chen rdo rje/ drug pa bu mang rdor sems/ bdun pa bu mang g.yang rgyal byams/ brgyad pa bu mang lha mo tshe brtan/ dgu ba bu mang dkon mchog 'jigs 113

nas brgyud pa'i dme tshang zla ba rgya mtsho la‘‘gnam na skar ma smin drug sa na dme tshang bu drug ’’ces pa'i bu drug 'khrungs pa'i che ba rab brtan/ lha mkhar don 'grub/ g.yung drung rgyal/ thar lo/ dbang chen thar/ a pa rgya ma ma rnams te/ khong rnams ni sa dgu stod du yong ba'i dme tshang bu drug tu grags pa rnams yin/ de las dme tshang lha mkhar don 'grub la bu bu mo nyi shu las bu bcu gcig 'khrungs pas dme tshang lha mkhar don 'grub bu mang tshang zhes grags pa la tshig bsdus nas dme tshang lha tho bu mang tshang zhes pa dang / dme tshang bu mang tshang dang / rjes nas bu mang tshang zhes dar khyab tu song ba yin no/ /dme tshang lha mkhar don 'grub kyi bu bcu gcig po ni/ dang bo bu mang blo brtan/ gnyis pa bu mang rgyal mo tshe ring / gsum pa bu mang ts+tsha brtan rgyal/ bzhi ba bu mang slob sems/ lnga ba bu mang dpal chen rdo rje/ drug pa bu mang rdor sems/ bdun pa bu mang g.yang rgyal byams/ brgyad pa bu mang lha mo tshe brtan/ dgu ba bu mang dkon mchog 'jigs 113

med/ bcu ba bu mang ban de rgya zhis/ bcu gcig pa bu mang blo po grags rgyam bcas yin no/ / de yang dme tshang lha mkhar don 'grub nas mi rabs 'ga'i rjes su/ ha lam bod rab byung bco lnga bcu drug gi nang du dme tshang bu mang nas gar te rma g.yas g.yon tsho drug gi nang du phebs la/ de dus tsho drug bu mang gi dpon rabs dang po bu mang sngags pa 'brug 'bum zer ba de yin zhing /dpon rabs gnyis pa bu mang g.yung drung sel le'i bu bu mang 'bum lo yin/ dpon rabs gsum pa ni bu mang 'bum lo'i bu bu mang na na'am bu mang tshe pa zhu ba de yin/ bu mang na nas bcings grol bar du dpon sa bzung ste bcings grol byas rjes gangs ri chu'u chu'u krang gzhon pa'i 'gan bzhes pa red/ de'i skabs su bu mang la khyim grangs zhe gsum dang mi grangs brgya dang zhe gcig yod par bshad do/ / // 114

gsum pa/ mkhar tsho ba'i lo byus rags ba1sa/rma rgyab tsho drug gi nang du phebs pa'i mkhar tsho ba 'di ni/—thog mar mdzod dge nas mgo log brgyud de— rma 'dabs su phebs par bshad pa dang / sa skya nas rong bo blon chos brgyud de rma 'dabs su phebs par bshad pa'i bshad srol gnyis byung / mdzod dge na sa mgo log brgyud par smra ba bas la mkhar tsho ba'i ming gi thogs tshul la ci yang bshad rgyu ma byung la/ sa skya nas blon chos brgyud de 'ong bar bshad pa dag gis/ mkhar tsho ba de thog mar sa skya'i mkhar dkar bo'am mkhar dkar nas 'ong bas tsho ming la mkhar tshang zhes grags par bshad do/ /rma 'dabs 'dir phebs thengs snga phyi rim gnyis byas nas phebs pas/ phebs jengs snga ma la mkhar rnying ba dang phebs thengs phyi ma la mkhar so ma zer/ rma rgyab tsho drug las mkhar so rnying gnyis ka mkhar tsho ba gcig tu brtsi ba yin/ / 115

gsum pa/ mkhar tsho ba'i lo rgyus rags bsdus/rma rgyab tsho drug gi nang du phebs pa'i mkhar tsho ba 'di ni/thog mar mdzod dge nas mgo log brgyud de— rma 'dabs su phebs par bshad pa dang / sa skya nas rong bo blon chos brgyud de rma 'dabs su phebs par bshad pa'i bshad srol gnyis byung / mdzod dge na sa mgo log brgyud par smra ba ngaspu la mkhar tsho ba'i ming gi thogs tshul la ci yang bshad rgyu ma byung la/ sa skya nas blon chos brgyud de 'ong bar bshad pa dag gis/ mkhar tsho ba de thog mar sa skya'i mkhar dkar bo'am mkhar dkar nas 'ong bas tsho ming la mkhar tshang zhes grags par bshad do// rma 'dabs 'dir phebs thengs snga phyi rim gnyis byas nas phebs pas/ phebs thengs snga ma la mkhar rnying ba dang phebs thengs phyi ma la mkhar so ma zer/ rma rgyab tsho drug las mkhar so rnying gnyis ka mkhar tsho ba gcig tu brtsi ba yin// 115

de yang mkhar snying 'bum byams kyi bu skal mkhar tshe brtan la bu mo byams ris skyes la/ bu mo byams ris dang mkhar tshe brtan gyi bu skal mkhar tshe don gnyis la bu mo dbang mo dang tshe mtsho/ da de gsum skyes/ dbang mo la bu mang bo skyes kyang ma 'tshams/ da de shul chad yin/ tshe mtsho la bu ting 'dzin 'khrungs la/ ting 'dzin gyi yab dme tshang mthu rdor yin par bshad//mkhar 'bum tho la bu mo gnyis dang bu mkhar byams rgyal dang mkhar zur rgyal/ mkhar dge slong rnams 'khrungs/mkhar byams rgyal la bu gcod pa dang 'brug lha/ bu mo dpa' li dang mtsho rgyal/ zon kho/ g.yu mtsho/ kun ne sogs skyes/mkhar zur rgyal la bu rdo rje(ta rdor)dang mthu po gnyis dang /bu mo gcod thur dang / sgrol po/ dkon mchog dam mtsho rnams skyes//yang mkhar mkha' 'gro dang mkhar lha skyabs rgyal/mkhar bkra tshe gsum las/ mkhar mkha' 'gro la bu a brtan 116

de yang mkhar snying 'bum byams kyi bu skal mkhar tshe brtan la bu mo byams ris skyes la/ bu mo byams ris dang mkhar tshe brtan gyi bu skal mkhar tshe don gnyis la bu mo dbang mo dang tshe mtsho/ da de gsum skyes/ dbang mo la bu mang bo skyes kyang ma 'tshams/ da de shul chad yin/ tshe mtsho la bu ting 'dzin 'khrungs la/ ting 'dzin gyi yab dme tshang mthu rdor yin par bshad/ /mkhar 'bum tho la bu mo gnyis dang bu mkhar byams rgyal dang mkhar zur rgyal/ mkhar dge slong rnams 'khrungs/mkhar byams rgyal la bu gcod pa dang 'brug lha/ bu mo dpa' li dang mtsho rgyal/ zon kho/ g.yu mtsho/ kun ṣ+pe sogs skyes/mkhar zur rgyal la bu rdo rje(ta rdor)dang mthu po gnyis dang /bu mo gcod thur dang / sgrol po/ dkon mchog dam mtsho rnams skyes/ /yang mkhar mkha' 'gro dang mkhar lha skyabs rgyal/mkhar bkra tshe gsum las/ mkhar mkha' 'gro la bu a brtan 116

dang lha rong / bsod bkra/ 'brug bha rnams 'khrungs la/ a brtan dang lha rong / 'brug bha gsum la shul ma thogs/mkhar bsod bkra la bu thub sher dang bu mo gdugs dkar dang khra ris gnyis byung / mkhar lha skyabs rgyal la bu rta bhe dang bstan pa rab rgyas/ u lo gsum dang bu mo klu mtsho dang dbang sgron gnyis 'khrungs/ mkhar bkra tshe la bu bla tho dang gdugs dkar gnyis dang bu mo bkra shis dang sgron lo/ rdor 'ba' gsum skyes//yang mkhar tshe rgyal zer ba la bu dbang pa dang snyan tho/stod pa dang klu phyug rnams skyes la/ dbang pa la bu skal bzang dang bu mo lha dkar/ bkra shis lha mo/ nor 'ba'/ jo mo/ sgron lha rnams byung / mkhar snyan tho la bu kun 'grub dang blo bzang / rtag bha/ tshe rig bla skyabs/ zla ba/ hu pa/ bu mo g.yu ris sogs skyes/ mkhar stod pa la bu rta mgrin dang bu mo ka po/ la po/ yi bha/ a phyug/ tshe po sogs skyes la/ klu phyug la shul ma thogs par grags so/ / 117

dang lha rong / bsod bkra/ 'brug bha rnams 'khrungs la/ a brtan dang lha rong / 'brug bha gsum la shul ma thogs/mkhar bsod bkra la bu thub sher dang bu mo gdugs dkar dang khra ris gnyis byung / mkhar lha skyabs rgyal la bu rta bhe dang bstan pa rab rgyas/ u lo gsum dang bu mo klu mtsho dang dbang sgon gnyis 'khrungs/ mkhar bkra tshe la bu bla tho dang gdugs dkar gnyis dang bu mo bkra shis dang sgon lo/ sdor 'ba' gsum skyes/ /yang mkhar tshe rgyal zer ba la bu dbang pa dang snyan tho/stod pa dang klu phyug rnams skyes la/ dbang pa la bu skal bzang dang bu mo lha dkar/ bkra shis lha mo/ nor 'ba'/ jo mo/ sgron lha rnams byung / mkhar snyan tho la bu kun 'grub dang blo bzang / rtag bha/ tshe rig bla skyabs/ zla ba/ hu pa/ bu mo g.yu ris sogs skyes/ mkhar stod pa la bu rta mgren dang bu mo ka po/ la po/ yi bha/ a phyug/ tshe po sogs skyes la/ klu phyug la shul ma thogs par grags so/ / 117

de yang mkhar tsho ba'i dpon rabs dang po mkhar snying 'bum byams yin la/ khong la bu ma 'khrungs pas mkhar tshe brta na bu skal du blangs pa de dpon rabs gnyis pa yin/ mkhar tshe brtan la yang bu ma 'khrungs pas bu skal mkhar tshe don gyis dpon rabs gsum pa bzung / dpon rabs bzhi ba ni mkhar 'bum tho la bu gsum yod pa'i chung ba mkhar dge slong yin la/ mkhar dge slong grwa pa yin pas rigs rgyud ma 'khrungs/ mkhar tshe rgyal dang de'i bu mkhar snyan tho ni mkhar gong ma'i dpon rabs yin par bshad la/ mkhar a pha sogs kyang mkhar tsho ba'i dpon po re yin par bshad do/ /bcings grol byed dus mkhar dpon po snyan tho yin la/skabs der mkhar tshang la khyem grangs so bdun dang mi grangs brgya dang nyer gsum yod do// //bzhi ba/ 'od dpal tsho ba'i lo rgyus rags bsdus/ 'od dpal gyi tsho ba 'di ha lam bod rab byung bco lnga 118

de yang mkhar tsho ba'i dpon rabs dang po mkhar snying 'bum byams yin la/ khong la bu ma 'khrungs pas mkhar tshe brta na bu skal du blangs pa de dpon rabs gnyis pa yin/ mkhar tshe brtan la yang bu ma 'khrungs pas bu skal mkhar tshe don gyis dpon rabs gsum pa bzung / dpon rabs bzhi ba ni mkhar 'bum tho la bu gsum yod pa'i chung ba mkhar dge slong yin la/ mkhar dge slong grwa pa yin pas rigs rgyud ma 'khrungs/ mkhar tshe rgyal dang de'i bu mkhar snyan tho ni mkhar gong ma'i dpon rabs yin par bshad la/ mkhar a pha sogs kyang mkhar tsho ba'i dpon po re yin par bshad do/ / bcings grol byed dus mkhar dpon po snyan tho yin la/skabs der mkhar tshang la khyim grangs so bdun dang mi grangs brgya dang nyer gsum yod do// // bzhi ba/ 'od dpal tsho ba'i lo rgyus rags bsdus/'od dpal gyi tsho ba 'di ha lam bod rab byung bco lnga 118

ba'i mjug dang bcu drug pa'i dbu tsam la rma rgyab tsho drug gi nang du phebs la/ 'od dpal tsho ba'i ming thogs tshul la bshad srol 'bri lugs mang du mchis kyang yin ngo ma ni 'di lta ste/ thog mar 'od dpal sde ba 'di rma pha rol rong bo blon chos nas chad cing / rim bzhin hang chung kha ya'am hang nga'i wob 'og zer ba'i gnas nas yun ring du bsdad/ rma 'dabs 'dir hang nga'i 'ob 'og wob 'og nas thad kar yar phebs pas 'ob wob pa dang 'ob wob tsho ba zhes zer/ rim bzhin 'ob wob kyi sgra 'gyur te 'o wob dang 'o wi/ bo wi/bo wod/ 'o wod sogs su 'bod/ da lta tsho drug sde ba yongs rdzogs kyis 'o wod 'o wod ces 'bod pa yin/ yin na'ang /de sngar rong bo lha rgyal dpal sogs kyis tsho ba drug gi lo rgyus 'bri dus 'o wod ces pa de 'od dpal gyi sgra ma dag pa yin par snyam te 'od dpal zhes bris par brten/ da lta yig thog nas tshang mas 'od dpal zhes 'bri la/ ngag thog nas da dung 'o wod wob ru ma zhes 'bod kyin yod do//119

ba'i mjug dang bcu drug pa'i dbu tsam la rma rgyab tsho drug gi nang du phebs la/ 'od dpal tsho ba'i ming thogs tshul la bshad srol 'bri lugs mang du mchis kyang yin ngo ma ni 'di lta ste/ thog mar 'od dpal sde ba 'di rma pha rol rong bo blon chos nas chad cing / rim bzhin hang chung kha ya'am hang nga'i yob 'og zer ba'i gnas nas yun ring du bsdad/ rma 'dabs 'dir hang nga'i 'ob 'og wob 'og nas thad kar yar phebs pas 'ob yob pa dang 'ob yob tsho ba zhes zer/ rim bzhin 'ob yob kyi sgra 'gyur te 'o yob dang 'o byu/ bo byu/bo wod/ 'o wod sogs su 'bod/ da lta tsho drug sde ba yongs rdzogs kyis 'o yod 'o yod ces 'bod pa yin/ yin na'ang /de sngar rong bo lha rgyal dpal sogs kyis tsho ba drug gi lo rgyus 'bri dus 'o yod ces pa de 'od dpal gyi sgra ma dag pa yin par snyam te 'od dpal zhes bris par brten/ da lta yig jog nas tshang mas 'od dpal zhes 'bri la/ ngag thog nas da dung 'o yod yob ru ma zhes 'bod kyin yod do/ /119

'o wod la rma 'dabs 'dir yong snga 'phyis 'o wod ru rnying ma dang 'o wod ru gsar ma zhes 'o wod gsar rnying gnyis su phye la/ 'o wod mdor bsdus skor ba la 'o wod ru rnying ma dang 'o wod thub dga' skor ba la 'o wod ru gsar ma zer//de yang 'o wod thub dga' skor ba'i mi rabs dang po ni 'o wod ja la dang 'o wod 'jigs byed skyabs/ 'o wod lha srung mgon/ 'o wod chos bzang / 'o wod gzungs skyabs rgyal/zhe sring mo mkhar mo ming sring rnams yin la/ mi rabs gnyis pa ni 'o wod ja la'am 'jam dbyangs kyi bu 'o wod thub dga' dang bsam 'phel/ tshong dpon ming sring rnams dang / 'jigs byed skyabs kyi bu nos lo/ mkhar mo'i bu shes rab sogs yin/ mi rabs gsum pa ni tshong dpon gyi bu rdo thar ming sring dang / bsam 'phel gyi bu ba sangs/ shes rab kyi bu rdor tshe bu spun dag yin/ mi rabs bzhi ba ni ba sangs kyi bu rgyal mtshan ming sring dang / rdor tshe'i bu chos kho bu spun 120

'o yod la rma 'dabs 'dir yong snga 'phyis 'o yod ru rnying ma dang 'o wod ru gsar ma zhes 'o yod gsar rnying gnyis su phye la/ 'o yod mdor bsdus skor ba la 'o yod ru rnying ma dang 'o wod thub dga' skor ba la 'o yod ru gsar ma zer / /de yang 'o yod thub dga' skor ba'i mi rabs dang po ni 'o yod ja la dang 'o yod 'jigs byed skyabs/ 'o yod lha srung mgon/ 'o yod chos bzang / 'o yod gzungs skyabs rgyal/— sreng mo mkhar mo ming sring rnams yin la/ mi rabs gnyis pa ni 'o yod ja la'am 'jam dbyangs kyi bu 'o yod thub dga' dang bsam 'phel/ tshong dpon ming sring rnams dang / 'jigs byed skyabs kyi bu nos lo/ mkhar mo'i bu shes rab sogs yin/ mi rabs gsum pa ni tshong dpon gyi bu rdo thar ming sring dang / bsam 'phel gyi bu ba sangs/ shes rab kyi bu rdor tshe bu spun dag yin/ mi rabs bzhi ba ni ba sangs kyi bu rgyal mtshan ming sring dang / dor tshe'i bu chos kho bu spun 120

dag yin/ 'o wod ja la dang mnyam du ru yong ba ni 'o yod a pu ge bu spun rnams yin par bshad/ / 'o yod mdor bsdus skor ba la 'o yod mdor bsdus dang 'o yod yi be+es/ 'o yod dbang kho rnams spun yin la/ 'o yod mdor bsdus la bu bzang bo dang chos chas/ — 'od kho gsum dang bu mo tshe ring lha mo dang sgol ma(zhi rgan)gnyis 'khrungs/'o yod yi pis kyi bu gcod pa dang / 'o yod dbang kho'i bu ston po yin par bshad do/ /'o wod tsho ba'i dpon rabs dang bo 'o yod ja la'am 'o yod 'jam dbyangs zer ba de yin la/ 'o yod kyi dpon rabs gnyis pa ni 'o yod thub dga' yin/ gzhan yang 'o yod mdor bsdus dang de'i brgyud pa 'o wod gcod pa dang ston pa sogs kyang 'o yod kyi dpon rabs brgyud myong bar ba shad/ /'o yod la dpon rabs mang bo brgyud ma pyong yang 121

dag yin/ 'o wod ja la dang mnyam du ru yong ba ni 'o wod a pu ge bu spun rnams yin par bshad// 'o wod mdor bsdus skor ba la 'o wod mdor bsdus dang 'o wod yi pis/ 'o wod dbang kho rnams spun yin la/ 'o wod mdor bsdus la bu bzang bo dang chos chas/ 'od kho gsum dang bu mo tshe ring lha mo dang sgrol ma(zhi rgan)gnyis 'khrungs/'o wod yi pis kyi bu gcod pa dang / 'o wod dbang kho'i bu ston po yin par bshad do/ /'o wod tsho ba'i dpon rabs dang bo 'o wod ja la'am 'o wod 'jam dbyangs zer ba de yin la/ 'o wod kyi dpon rabs gnyis pa ni 'o wod thub dga' yin/ gzhan yang 'o wod mdor bsdus dang de'i brgyud pa 'o wod gcod pa dang ston pa sogs kyang 'o wod kyi dpon rabs brgyud myong bar bshad// 'o wod la dpon rabs mang bo brgyud ma myong yang 121

dag yin/ 'o wod ja la dang mnyam du ru yong ba ni 'o wod a pu ge bu spun rnams yin par bshad// 'o wod mdor bsdus skor ba la 'o wod mdor bsdus dang 'o wod yi pis/ 'o wod dbang kho rnams spun yin la/ 'o wod mdor bsdus la bu bzang bo dang chos chas/ 'od kho gsum dang bu mo tshe ring lha mo dang sgrol ma(zhi rgan)gnyis 'khrungs/'o wod yi pis kyi bu gcod pa dang / 'o wod dbang kho'i bu ston po yin par bshad do/ /'o wod tsho ba'i dpon rabs dang bo 'o wod ja la'am 'o wod 'jam dbyangs zer ba de yin la/ 'o wod kyi dpon rabs gnyis pa ni 'o wod thub dga' yin/ gzhan yang 'o wod mdor bsdus dang de'i brgyud pa 'o wod gcod pa dang ston pa sogs kyang 'o wod kyi dpon rabs brgyud myong bar bshad// 'o wod la dpon rabs mang bo brgyud ma myong yang 121

thabs mkhas snying stobs dang ldan pa'i dpa' bo chen po 'o chad thub dga' tshang 'khrungs rjes/ khong gis 'o yod tsho ba'i mi tshad sgur ru sde rgan kyang bla ma gsang lo tshang gis khong la gtad par brten/ tsho ba drug gi dpon po dang gangs ri chu'u chu'u krang gzhon pa dang bor gyur/ skabs der 'o yod tsho ba la khyim grangs brgyad dang mi grangs so bzhi tsam yod par grags so////lnga ba/ gros tsho ba'i lo rgyus rags bgyas/de yang gros tsho ba 'di thog mar rma pha rol rong bo blon chos nas chad cing / rim bzhin sog yul dang hod kha/ rog shod sogs su gnas phar spo tshur spo mang du byas rjes/ ha lam spyi lo 1940—1949 bar te bcings grol ma byas pa'i gong du rma rgyab tsho drug gi nang du phebs pa red/ hod kha'i man chad kyi sgo mo'i yul bya ba na gros tshang gi nye 'byel yod pas/da dung phan tshun bar nye 'brel la thug 'phrad byed kyin 122

thabs mkhas snying stobs dang ldan pa'i dpa' bo chen po 'o cha wod thub dga' tshang 'khrungs rjes/ khong gis 'o wod tsho ba'i mi tshad sgur ru sde rgan kyang bla ma gsang lo tshang gis khong la gtad par brten/ tsho ba drug gi dpon po dang gangs ri chu'u chu'u krang gzhon pa dang bor gyur/ skabs der 'o wod tsho ba la khyim grangs brgyad dang mi grangs so bzhi tsam yod par grags so//// lnga ba/ gros tsho ba'i lo rgyus rags bsdus/de yang gros tsho ba 'di thog mar rma pha rol rong bo blon chos nas chad cing / rim bzhin sog yul dang hod kha/ rog shod sogs su gnas phar spo tshur spo mang du byas rjes/ ha lam spyi lo1940—1949bar te bcings grol ma byas pa'i gong du rma rgyab tsho drug gi nang du phebs pa red/ hod kha'i man chad kyi sgo mo'i yul bya ba na gros tshang gi nye 'brel yod pas/da dung phan tshun bar nye 'brel la thug 'phrad byed kyin 122

'dug / gros tshang zhes pa de rma pha rol na yod dusajirgyun par‘‘ gros’’zhes pa'i 'bru rigs shig 'debs sdud kyis 'tsho ba rol bzhin 'dug pas na‘‘gros za tshangami’dang‘‘gros tshang’’zhes 'bru rigs kyi ming rus la thogs par bshad/gros tshang rma 'dabs tsho drug gi nang du thon rjes yar 'ded thub tshod kyis mi rabs ba zhi la gtugs/ de yang mi rabs dang po ni gros g.yung drung rgyal yin la/ mi rabs gnyis pa ni gros g.yung kho'am gros g.yung drung rgyal gyi bu gros skyabs po(skya bo)dang / gros khyung rtse/ gros bsod po bu spun rnams yin/ mi rabs gsum pa ni gros skya bo'i bu gros tshe bo dang / gros mkha' 'gro thar/ gros lha skyabs rgyal/ gros nor rgyal/ gros bstan 'dzin bu spun dang / gros khyung rtse'i bu gros dar rgyas dang gros bde dpon/ gros bsod po'i bu gros sangs nam dang bu mo sgron lo dang khu lo rnams yin/ mi rabs bzhi ba ni gros tshe bo'i bu u rgyan skyabs dang ge tho/123

'dug / gros tshang zhes pa de rma pha rol na yod dus rgyun par gros zhes pa'i 'bru rigs shig 'debs sdud kyis 'tsho ba rol bzhin 'dug pas na gros za tshang dang‘ gros tshang zhes 'bru rigs kyi ming rus la thogs par bshad/gros tshang rma 'dabs tsho drug gi nang du thon rjes yar 'ded thub tshod kyis mi rabs ba zhi la gtugs/ de yang mi rabs dang po ni gros g.yung drung rgyal yin la/ mi rabs gnyis pa ni gros g.yung kho'am gros g.yung drung rgyal gyi bu gros skyabs po(skya bo)dang / gros khyung rtse/ gros bsod po bu spun rnams yin/ mi rabs gsum pa ni gros skya bo'i bu gros tshe bo dang / gros mkha' 'gro thar/ gros lha skyabs rgyal/ gros nor rgyal/ gros bstan 'dzin bu spun dang / gros khyung rtse'i bu gros dar rgyas dang gros bde dpon/ gros bsod po'i bu gros sangs namartedang bu mo sgon lo dang khu lo rnams yin/ mi rabs bzhi ba ni gros tshe bo'i bu u rgyan skyabs dang ge tho/123

gros mkha' 'gro thar rmi bu gros gnam po/ gros lha skyabs rgyal gyi gu dbu po ming sring / gros bstan 'dzin gyi bu rdo thur ming sring / gros dar rgyas kyi bu mo sgo kho dang gnu ra/ gros sangs nam gyi bu bkra po ming sring sogs yin no/ /de yang gros tshang gi dpon rabs dang po gros g.yung drung rgyal yin la/ dpon rabs gnyis pa gros skya bo yin/dpon rabs gsum pa gros mkha' 'gro thar yin la/ gros mkha' 'gro thar gyis bcings 'grol bar du dpon sa bzung /khong gis gangs ri zhang(chu'u)chu'u krang gzhon pa'i 'gan bzhes myong la/ skabs der gros tshang la khyim grangs nyi shu dang mi grangs don gsum yod par bshad do// // drug pa/ sgur ru tsho ba'i lo rgyus rags bsdus/de yang sgur ru zhes pa rong bo blon chos chad stangs gsum ste/ rta bo dme tshang sgur ru gsum/ /lo ba rgya bza' dme glang gsum/ /bal bza' skya ra sngags sa gsum/ / rngozhes 124

gros mkha' 'gro thar gyi bu gros gnam po/ gros lha skyabs rgyal gyi bu dbu po ming sring / gros bstan 'dzin gyi bu rdo thur ming sring / gros dar rgyas kyi bu mo sgro kho dang gnu ra/ gros sangs nam gyi bu bkra po ming sring sogs yin no/ /de yang gros tshang gi dpon rabs dang po gros g.yung drung rgyal yin la/ dpon rabs gnyis pa gros skya bo yin/dpon rabs gsum pa gros mkha' 'gro thar yin la/ gros mkha' 'gro thar gyis bcings 'grol bar du dpon sa bzung /khong gis gangs ri zhang(chu'u)chu'u krang gzhon pa'i 'gan bzhes myong la/ skabs der gros tshang la khyim grangs nyi shu dang mi grangs don gsum yod par bshad do// // drug pa/ lgur ru tsho ba'i lo rgyus rags bsdus/de yangartsosgur ru zhes pa rong bo blon chos chad stangs gsum ste/ ‘‘rta bo dme tshang sgur ru gsum/ /lo ba rgya bza' dme glang gsum/ /bal bza' skya ra sngags sa gsum/ /’’zhes 124

pa'i chad stangs gcig gi sde rgan gcig yin la/ blon chos sgar ba'i stong dpon chen po bstan skyong ngam sgar ba'i bla ma 'jam pa zhes grags pa'i skyes bu chen po de'i bu sgar ba'i kun bzang rgyal bya brang sgur ru zhes pa de'i rigs rgyud rnams yin par grags/ de yang sgar ba'i kun bzang rgyal gyi lus nang du sgur la brang shin tu chung bas/ sgar ba'i kun bzang rgyal bya brang sgur ru zhes ming thogs la/ de nas bzung khong gi phyi thogs pa rnams la'ang sgur ru tshang zhes grags/des na de sngar rgu ru zhes pa dang dgu ru zhes pa sogs ni yi ge ma dag pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /sgur ru kun bzang rgyal bya brang sgur log gis chung ma bse bza' rin mo byams blangs pas sras dpa' ya med rdo rje rgyal skya 'bur dang sras mo mdzes ma bltas pas chog mi shes pa lha mdzes klu mo yag gnyis 'khrungs pa la sgur ru kha gnyis zhes grags/ sgur ru rdo rje rgyal skya 'bur la bu lnga dang bu mo gcig 'khrungs/ bu che ba bsod nams lhun 'grub/125

pa'i chad stangs gcig gi sde rgan gcig yin la/ blon chos sgar ba'i stong dpon chen po bstan skyong ngam sgar ba'i bla ma 'jam pa zhes grags pa'i skyes bu chen po de'i bu sgar ba'i kun bzang rgyal bya brang sgur ru zhes pa de'i rigs rgyud rnams yin par grags/ de yang sgar ba'i kun bzang rgyal gyi lus nang du sgur la brang shin tu chung bas/ sgar ba'i kun bzang rgyal bya brang sgur ru zhes ming thogs la/ de nas bzung khong gi phyi thogs pa rnams la'ang sgur ru tshang zhes grags/des na de sngar rgu ru zhes pa dang dgu ru zhes pa sogs ni yi ge ma dag pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /sgur ru kun bzang rgyal bya brang sgur log gis chung ma bse bza' rin mo byams blangs pas sras dpa' ya med rdo rje rgyal skya 'bur dang sras mo mdzes ma bltas pas chog mi shes pa lha mdzes klu mo yag gnyis 'khrungs pa la sgur ru kha gnyis zhes grags/ sgur ru rdo rje rgyal skya 'bur la bu lnga dang bu mo gcig 'khrungs/ bu che ba bsod nams lhun 'grub/125

gnyis pa gnam rgyal tshe ring / gsum pa dkon mchog bkra shis/ bzhi ba g.yang skyabs rgyal/ lnga ba bde legs rnam rgyal bcas dang bu mo gcig po'i ming la gnam mtsho skyid zer//sgur ru bsod nams lhun 'grub dang chung ma hor bza' g.yang skyid gnyis la sras sgur ru tshe brtan rgyal dang sgur ru mkha' 'bum yag sgur ru lha rgyal tshe ring / bu mo dpa' dar skyid dang bzhi 'khrungs/ sgur ru gnam rgyal tshe ring dang chung ma bse bza' mkhar mo byams gnyis la sras gnyis byung ba'i che ba sgur ru lha 'bum rgyal dang chung ba ni sgur ru'i dpa' bo chen po seng stag rnam rgyal yin/ sgur ru dkon mchog rnam rgyal dang chung ma kun dar skyid la sras mo rgya mo skyid dang chos mo yag sras sgur ru'i khro bo skyabs bcas ming sring gsum 'khrungs/ sgur ru'i g.yang skyabs rgyal dang chung ma tshe dar skyid gnyis la sras mo lha mo mtsho dang mgon mo skyid/ klu mo byams/ kun bzang skyid/ sras sgur ru tshe 'bum bkra shis dang lnga 'khrungs/ sgur ru'i mkhas grub chen po bde legs 126

gnyis pa gnam rgyal tshe ring / gsum pa dkon mchog bkra shis/ bzhi ba g.yang skyabs rgyal/ lnga ba bde legs rnam rgyal bcas dang bu mo gcig po'i ming la gnam mtsho skyid zer/ /sgur ru bsod nams lhun 'grub dang chung ma hor bza' g.yang skyid gnyis la sras sgur ru tshe brtan rgyal dang sgur ru mkha' 'bum yag sgur ru lha rgyal tshe ring / bu mo dpa' dar skyid dang bzhi 'khrungs/ sgur ru gnam rgyal tshe ring dang chung ma bse bza' mkhar mo byams gnyis la sras gnyis byung ba'i che ba sgur ru lha 'bum rgyal dang chung ba ni sgur ru'i dpa' bo chen po seng stag rnam rgyal yin/ sgur ru dkon mchog rnam rgyal dang chung ma kun dar sprid la sras mo rgya mo sprid dang chos mo yag sras sgur ru'i khro bo skyabs bcas ming sring gsum 'khrungs/ sgur ru'i g.yang skyabs rgyal dang chung ma tshe dar skyid gnyis la sras mo lha mo mtsho dang mgon mo skyid/ klu mo byams/ kun bzang skyid/ sras sgur ru tshe 'bum bkra shis dang lnga 'khrungs/ sgur ru'i mkhas grub chen po bde legs 126

rnam rgyal dang chung ma dkar mo rgyal gnyis la sras ming sring drug 'khrungs par grags so/ /de yang sgar ba'i kun bzang rgyal bya brang sgur ru'i sras sgur ru rdo rje rgyal skya 'bur gyi bu lnga'i brgyud pa rnams mi rabs mang du 'phel rjes/ ha lam bod rab byung bcu ba rdzogs kha ma'i me stag lor/ sgur ru'i khya ra rdo rje rkang ring gis gtso mdzad de/ sgur ru'i lha chen sog mgo dang / sgur ru'i pad+ma skyabs/ sgur ru'i spyod pa skyabs/ sgur ru'i bsod nams rgyal mtshan mgo ltig sgur ru'i dpa' mgon rnam rgyal/ sgur ru'i ho dong 'jigs med tshe ring / sgur ru'i bsod nams dbang phyug ho dong mkhar rtse byams/ sgur ru'i ha zha'i rta mgrin tshe ring / sgur ru pe tsha'i snying dkar rgyal/sgur ru pe tsha'i rig 'dzin 'gyur med/ sgur ru go na'i klu dar 'bum/ sgur ru go na'i bsod dar rgyal mtshan sogs kyis/ blon chos kyi tsho sde mang bo zhig nub dang byang brgyud nas stod phyogs kyi sa bzung bar mthong thos mngon sum du 127

rnam rgyal dang chung ma dkar mo rgyal gnyis la sras ming sring dru ga 'khrungs par grags so/ /de yang sgar ba'i kun bzang rgyal bya brang sgur ru'i sras sgur ru rdo rje rgyal skya 'bur gyi bu lnga'i brgyud pa rnams mi rabs mang du 'phel rjes/ ha lam bod rab byung bcu ba rdzogs kha ma'i me stag lor/ sgur ru'i khya ra rdo rje rkang ring gis gtso mdzad de/ sgur ru'i lha chen sog mgo dang / sgur ru'i pad+ma skyabs/ sgur ru'i spyod pa skyabs/ sgur ru'i bsod nams rgyal mtshan mgo ltig sgur ru'i dpa' mgon rnam rgyal/ sgur ru'i ho dong 'jigs med tshe ring / sgur ru'i bsod nams dbang phyug ho dong mkhar rtse byams/ sgur ru'i ha zha'i rta mgrin tshe ring / sgur ru pe tsha'i snying dkar rgyal/sgur ru pe tsha'i rig 'dzin 'gyur med/ sgur ru go na'i klu dar 'bum/ sgur ru go na'i bsod dar rgyal mtshan sogaso kyis/ blon chos kyi tsho sde mang bo zhig nub dang byang brgyud nas stod phyogs kyi sa bzung bar mthong thos mngon sum du 127

shar bas nga tshos ci byed ces gros mdzad skabs/ sgur ru'i bkra shis dar rgyas dang / sgur ru'i snying lcags tshe ring / sga gong skyes zhes pa'i sring mo bcas khyem kha gsum po gar yang 'gro ma 'dod pas blon chos sar bsdad/ gzhan sgur ru tsho ba yongs rdzogs kyi gros kha mthun te rma chu'i rab kha nas byang phyogs bskor te nub phyogs tu'u lan(dur lam)sgur ru'i sa thog tu bskyod par grags so/ /de nas phal cher sgur ru'i dpon rabs lnga tsam song ba ste/ dpon rabs dang po sgur ru'i dpon po sgom pa yin la /dpon rabs gnyis pa sgur ru'i dpon po gda' drag yin/dpon rabs gsum pa sgur ru'i dpon po stag lha yin la/dpon rabs bzhi ba sgur ru'i dpon po btsan chen mgon gyi sku ring la sgur ru zhol ma nas gong mar chad de sgur ru gong zhol gnyis la khral mgo stong mgo gcig pa las dpon mgo mi gcig par gyur/ dpon rabs bzhi ba sgur ru gong ma nas sgur ru'i dpon po btsan chen mgon yin la/ sgur ru zhol 128

shar bas nga tshos ci byed ces gros mdzad skabs/ sgur ru'i bkra shis dar rgyas dang / sgur ru'i snying lcags tshe ring sga gong skyes zhes pa'i sring mo bcas khyim kha gsum po gar yang 'gro ma 'dod pas blon chos sar bsdad/ gzhan sgur ru tsho ba yongs rdzogs kyi gros kha mthun te rma chu'i rab kha nas byang phyogs bskor te nub phyogs tu'u lan(dur lam)sgur ru'i sa thog tu bskyod par grags so/ /de nas phal cher sgur ru'i dpon rabs lnga tsam song ba ste/ dpon rabs dang po sgur ru'i dpon po sgom pa yin la/dpon rabs gnyis pa sgur ru'i dpon po gda' drag yin/dpon rabs gsum pa sgur ru'i dpon po stag lha yin la/dpon rabs bzhi ba sgur ru'i dpon po btsan chen mgon gyi sku ring la sgur ru zhol ma nas gong mar chad de sgur ru gong zhol gnyis la khral mgo stong mgo gcig pa las dpon mgo mi gcig par gyur/ dpon rabs bzhi ba sgur ru gong ma nas sgur ru'i dpon po btsan chen mgon yin la/ sgur ru zhol 128

ma nas sgur ru'i dpon po dbang phyug gnyis dus mnyam/dpon rabs lnga ba sgur ru gong ma nas sgur ru bla ma gsang lo tshang dang zhol ma nas sgur ru thugs mchog gnyis dus mnyam// —sgur ru bla ma gsang lo'i sku ring la/ khong gis rma rgyab ka tsha'i mdo nas sgur ru dgon a ti dar rgyas gling btab ste sgur ru'i sde sne tsho drug gi nang du zin par brten/ da gzod 'ba' bu mang / mkhar 'od dpal/ gros sgur ru/ zhes tsho ba drug gi ming gzhi nas chags pa yin la/ de'i sngon du tsho ba drug gi ming thogs med par grags/ sgur ru la nang gses rong bo dang nag skor/ sgar skor/ sgom skor/ dom skor bcas shog chung lnga yod la/ bcings 'grol skabs su sgur ru gong ma la khyim grangs don drug dang mi grangs nyis brgya dang don gsum yod par grags so//de ltar rma rgyab kyi tsho ba drug po la gong gsal ltar rang rang gi tsho dpon sde dpon re rim par brgyud myong mod/ 'o 129

ma nas sgur ru'i dpon po dbang phyug gnyis dus mnyam/dpon rabs lnga ba sgur ru gong ma nas sgur ru bla ma gsang lo tshang dang zhol ma nas sgur ru thugs mchog gnyis dus mnyam// —sgur ru bla ma gsang lo'i sku ring la/ khong gis rma rgyab ka tsha'i mdo nas sgur ru dgon a ti dar rgyas gling btab ste sgur ru'i sde sne tsho drug gi nang du zin par brten/ da gzod 'ba' bu mang / mkhar 'od dpal/ gros sgur ru/ zhes tsho ba drug gi ming gzhi nas chags pa yin la/ de'i sngon du tsho ba drug gi ming thogs med par grags/ sgur ru la nang gses rong bo dang nag skor/ sgar skor/ sgom skor/ dom skor bcas shog chung lnga yod la/ bcings 'grol skabs su sgur ru gong ma la khyim grangs don drug dang mi grangs nyis brgya dang don gsum yod par grags so//de ltar rma rgyab kyi tsho ba drug po la gong gsal ltar rang rang gi tsho dpon sde dpon re rim par brgyud myong mod/ 'o 129

na tsho ba drug po la thun mong gi bla ma dang dpon po byon myong ngam zhe na/ myong ste/ spyir sgur ru ni rong bo blon chos chad stangs gsum gyi chad stangs gcig gi sde rgan gcig yin pas sgur ru gong zhol gnyis su gyes pa'i sgur ru gong ma kho na la'ang tsho ba drug gi tsho ba gzhan gang las kyang ldab 'gyur gyis mang bas na/ sde mgo dpon mgo'ang de bzhin mtho/khyad par du sgur ru bla ma gsang lo tshang gis rma rgyab ka tsha'i mdo nas sgur ru dgon a ti dar rgyas gling btab par brten/ lha sde tsho ba drug po'i 'bangs sems gcig tu mthun te bla ma tshang tsho ba drug po'i 'di phyi gnyis ka'i skyabs re sa'i bla dpon gcig lcogs su gyur/ /sgur ru bla ma gsang lo tshang gis da dung mtsho lho khul gyi srid gros u yon dang / zhin he rdzong gi rdzong dpon gzhon pa'i 'gan yang bzhes myong ba red /de rjes srid phyogs nas tsho ba drug gi dpon po 'od dpal thub dga' dang / chos phyogs nas tsho ba drug gi bla ma thub bstan tshe ring(thub bhe)tshang gis bskyangs la/ sgur ru bla ma 130

na tsho ba drug po la thun mong gi bla ma dang dpon po byon spyong ngam zhe na/ myong ste/ byer sgur ru ni rong bo blon chos chad stangs gsum gyi chad stangs gcig gi sde rgan gcig yin pas sgur ru gong zhol gnyis su gyes pa'i sgur ru gong ma kho na la'ang tsho ba drug gi tsho ba gzhan gang las kyang ldab 'gyur gyis mang bas na/ sde mgo dpon mgo'ang de bzhin mtho/khyad par du sgur ru bla ma gsang lo tshang gis rma rgyab ka tsha'i mdo nas sgur ru dgon a ti dar rgyas gling btab par brten/ lha sde tsho ba drug po'i 'bangs sems gcig tu mthun te bla ma tshang tsho ba drug po'i 'di phyi gnyis ka'i skyabs re sa'i bla dpon gcig lcogs su gyur/ /sgur ru bla ma gsang lo tshang gis da dung mtsho lho khul gyi srid gros u yon dang / zhin te rdzong gi rdzong dpon gzhon pa'i 'gan yang bzhes myong ba red/de rjes srid phyogs nas tsho ba drug gi dpon po 'od dpal thub dga' dang / chos phyogs nas tsho ba drug gi bla ma thub bstan tshe ring(thub bhe)tshang gis bskyangs la/ sgur ru bla ma 130

thub tshe tshang gigo d+mā chen rdzong dang mgo log khul srid gros u yon gyi phyag las gnang myong ba dang bcas rma rgyab tsho drug gi lo rgyus rags tsam brjod zin no// // smras pa/ rang gi rigs la zhen pa'i snang ba 'jis/ / rang rigs kun la phan pa dka' mod kyang / /rang gi pha yi pha yang mi shes pa'i/ /rang sde'i tsha bo dag la phan nam snyam/ /tsho drug lo rgyus rags tsam brjod pa la/ /mang nyung rags zhib byung re sgor ba dag /cha rgyus yod dang med pa'i khyad par las/ /phyogs zhen snang ba spu tsam yod re skan/ /zhes pa 'di yang pha sprel ma srin las mched pa'i ldong rigs kyi gyi na pa/ 'ba' don grub rgyal lam ming gzhan dbyangs can rdo rje'i go cha ru 'bod pas/ rang rigs lha sde 131

thub tshe tshang gisu rmu chen rdzong dang mgo log khul srid gros u yon gyi phyag las gnang myong ba dang bcas rma rgyab tsho drug gi lo rgyus rags tsam brjod zin no// // smras pa/ rang gi rigs la zhen pa'i snang ba 'des/ / rang rigs kun la phan pa dka' mod kyang / /rang gi pha yi pha yang mi shes pa'i / /rang sde'i tsha bo dag la phan nam snyam/ /tsho drug lo rgyus rags tsam brjod pa la/ /mang nyung rags zhib cung re shor ba dag / cha rgyus yod dang med pa'i khyad paracelas phyogs zhen snang ba spru tsam yod re ska na/ /zhes pa 'di yang pha sprel ma srin las mched pa'i ldong rigs kyi gyi na pa/ 'ba' don grub rgyal lam ming gzhan dbyangs can rdo rje'i go cha ru 'bod pas/ rang rigs lha sde 131

tsho drug gi phyi rabs pa rnams la cung zad e phan snyam pa'i lhag bsam rmis/ bod rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu rta lor sbyar ba dge'o/ / // zur bkod/ khungs gtug sa'i dpe gzhung dang blo 'dre sa'i rgan rabs gsal bshad/dang bo/ khungs gabyug sa'i dpe gakhyang gi skor/1 〈 rong bo blon chos kyi rus mdzod lta ba mkha' khyab phyogs bral las rta bo dme tshang gi rus rgyud bshad pa mthong ba kun gsal /〉zhes bya ba/ (phyag bris skyar dpar ma/)2 〈 rong bo blon chos kyi rus mdzod lta ba mkha' khyab phyogs bral las darnge tshang gi 'byung khungs dang rus rgyud gnad bsdus ljon pa'i yal 'dab /〉 ces bya ba/ (phyag bris skyar dpar ma/) 3 〈 rong bo blon chen nam blon chos sgur ru tsho ba dang pha 'og 'ga'i rus mdzod // ces bya ba/ (phyag bris skyar dpar 132

tsho drug gi phyi rabs pa rnams la cung zad e phan snyam pa'i lhag bsam gyis/ bod rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu rta lor sbyar ba dge'o/ / // zur bkod/ khungs gtug sa'i dpe gzhung dang blo 'dri sa'i rgan rabs gsal bshad/dang bo/ khungs gtug sa'i dpe gzhung gi skor/1 〈 rong bo blon chos kyi rus mdzod lta ba mkha' khyab phyogs bral las rta bo dme tshang gi rus rgyud bshad pa mthong ba kun gsal 〉zhes bya ba/ (phyag bris skyar dpar ma/)2 〈 rong bo blon chos kyi rus mdzod lta ba mkha' khyab phyogs bral las dme tshang gi 'byung khungs dang rus rgyud gnad bsdus ljon pa'i yal 'dab 〉ces bya ba/ (phyag bris skyar dpar ma/) 3 〈 rong bo blon chen nam blon chos sgur ru tsho ba dang pha 'og 'ga'i rus mdzod 〉 ces bya ba/ (phyag bris skyar dpar 132

ma ) 4 〈 rong bo blon chen nam blon chos 'ba' tsho ba'i rus mdzod lo rgyus 〉/zhes bya ba/ (phyag bris skyar dpar ma/) 5 rong bo lha rgyal dpal byus brtsams pa 'i〈 rma yul rong bo blon chos //(mtsho sngon lcags dpar ma/) gnyis pa/ blo 'arnge sa'i rgan rabs kyi skor/spyor tsho ba drug po'i lo rgyus yongs khyab tu rang sde'i phyi rabs pa la blo sems mchog tu dkar zhing sku drin brjod mtha' bral ba7dpal mgon po lha chen tshang la lo rgyus kyi khungs yongs su bcol zhing / sgos su sgur ru tsho ba'i phyogs nas sgur ru sngags pa dang / bu mang gi phyogs nas bu mang chos 'phel(chos chos)dang bu mang bstan 'phel/ mkhar tsho ba'i phyogs nas mkhar chos 'phel dang stobs chen/ 'ba' tsho ba'i phyogs nas 'ba' gnam lha dang mtha' yas 'od dpal phyogs nas 'od dpal nos lo dang chos kho/ byams 133

rgyal sogs/ gros tsho ba'i phyogs nas gros sangs nam sogs la kho bos ched du khungs gtugs dang blo 'dri mang tsam byas pa yin la/ phyi rabs pa dag gis kyang gong gsal rgan rabs rnam pa tsho bzhugs yod pa'i go skabs dang bstun nas myur du bcar 'dri byas te rang re'i lo rgyus la go thos mang du byed pa ra snying thag pas re ba zhu'o// // 134 —

bod kyi skung yig 'bri tshul byis pa dga' ba'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba/ bde legs rgya mtsho rab rgyas pa'i/ /bla ma dam pablu zhabs btud nas/ /skal ldan ṅkub bu du ma'i ngor/ /bod kyi mang yig zi bar bya/ / bod kyi mabyugs bris mang yig la/ /thun mong thun min mang lugs gnyis/ /thun mong thun min lugs rer yang / /skung lugs mi 'dra drug re yod/ /dang po thun mong skung lugs ni/ rjo phyi ma'i sngon 'jug yi ge lnga/ /snga ma'i rjes 'jug rang 'drar mang / /dper na/yig gzugs la yigazugs/ lag gdub la lagadub/ stag gzig la stagazig dpyid dpal la dpyidapal/ srid dbang la sridabang / 'dod dgu la 'dodagu/ thub bstan la thubastan /135
